Du berichtest direkt an den CEO und arbeitest eng mit dem COO zusammen. Mittelfristig besteht die Perspektive, die Leitung unseres Tech-Teams zu übernehmen. jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

What you’ll be doing

As part of Wolt’s Platform department (Core Group), you’ll help improve and automate operations for our storage access platform - our real time database abstraction layer solution designed with scale and resiliency in mind . The product you will build enforces best practices by design, abstracts database infrastructure, and supports Multi-Region architecture through data sharding and replication. You join a team of highly skilled engineers in designing, building and optimizing this platform and ensuring smooth developer onboarding, constant improvement and optimization.

As an engineer on the Storage access platform team, you’ll work on platform features such as UI for developer teams, storage abstraction layer, database automation, client SDK and proxy, Change Data Capture pipelines, caching and ephemeral storage, Hot & Cold storage management and more.

Our humble expectations

You’ll be a great fit for this role if you have the following skills and experience:

  • A strong developer-to-developer mindset, with a genuine enjoyment of building for internal customers and treating other engineers as your primary users.
  • Adaptability and strong motivation for working with distributed systems.
  • A data-driven approach to decision-making and a collaborative mindset, with the ability to navigate disagreements constructively and deliver consistently.
  • Autonomy in dynamic, fast-paced environments with frequent change.
  • A product- and platform-oriented approach to engineering challenges.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • A collaborative spirit and experience contributing to diverse and inclusive work environments.

Technical proficiencies:

  • Expertise in NoSQL databases, particularly Cassandra or DynamoDB.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed systems, emphasizing both velocity and scalability.
  • Familiarity with SRE principles; however, a background in Backend Development is essential.
  • Practical knowledge of Kubernetes, including EKS, as an end user.

You don’t need to tick every box, but if you see yourself in many of these points, we’d love to hear from you!


What we offer

At Wolt, we’re committed to building an environment where engineers can make an impact while enjoying meaningful challenges. As a member of the the team you’ll enjoy:

  • Working on solutions that support millions of users
  • Solving complex problems in performance, reliability and automation
  • A collaborative and inclusive culture that supports your professional and personal well-being

We also offer flexible work arrangements, competitive compensation, and ongoing learning opportunities to help you thrive.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Du machst den konkreten Nutzen und Mehrwert von Foodji sichtbar und schaffst damit die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften. Deine Mission bei Foodji (Enterprise-) Kund:innen begleitest du von der Testphase über den Vertragsabschluss durch die gesamte Customer Lifetime. Für dein Kundenportfolio übernimmst du Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Kund:innen Foodji erfolgreich nutzen, langfristig bleiben, wachsen und uns weiterempfehlen. Stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Entscheider:innen und dezentralen Stakeholdern baust du gezielt auf und entwickelst sie weiter. Verantwortung für die Gesundheit und Weiterentwicklung deines Enterprise-Kundenportfolios – von der KPI-basierten Analyse der Account Health bis zur Ableitung gezielter Maßnahmen. Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten. Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs. Das bringst du mit Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg. Strukturierte, datengetriebene und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Gespür für Kundenbeziehungen sowie der Fähigkeit, Risiken, Kundenpotenziale und nächste Schritte selbstständig zu priorisieren. Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse. Kommunikationsstärke auf Entscheider:innenebene – auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen – sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Multi-Standort-Accounts mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern strategisch zu betreuen. Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen. Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise. NOCH FRAGEN? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. jobs.title: (Senior) Business & Financial Analyst (all genders)
jobs.description: Foodji macht frisches, gutes Essen im Büro jederzeit verfügbar. Unsere autonomen Foodjis stehen in bald tausend Unternehmen in Deutschland, jede Transaktion, jede Lieferung und jedes Gericht erzeugt Daten. Diesen Datenschatz wollen wir noch konsequenter nutzen und die ganze Organisation befähigen, mit starkem AI-Enablement selbst mit Daten zu arbeiten. Dafür suchen wir dich. Du wirst Teil unseres Finance & BI Teams und arbeitest eng mit Controlling und BI. Wir bauen zusammen die Zahlenbasis, auf der Foodji gesteuert wird und gehen Fragen aus dem Business gemeinsam an: schnell, präzise und mit dem Anspruch, jede Frage bis zur Entscheidung durchzudenken. Deine Mission bei Foodji Ist-Zahlen & Treiber: Du analysierst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling die operativen Treiber hinter den Ist-Zahlen und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen ab für alle Teams. Planung: Du baust treiberbasierte Modelle für Budget und rollierenden Forecast, inklusive Szenarien und Annahmen aus den Fachbereichen. Reporting: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling das Management-, Board- und Investorenreporting weiter, mit Fokus auf Treiber und Ausblick. Business Cases & Unit Economics: Du bewertest neue Standorte, Kundensegmente, Pricing und Initiativen und findest die Hebel für Marge und Wachstum. Metriken: Gemeinsam mit dem BI-Team definierst du Metriken und Business-Logik im Semantic Layer, damit alle mit denselben Zahlen arbeiten. Business Partnering: Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Geschäftsführung, Sales, Account Management, Operations, Culinary und Marketing und begleitest die Umsetzung deiner Empfehlungen. AI-native arbeiten AI ist bei uns das Werkzeug, mit dem wir Analytics bauen. Wir arbeiten täglich mit AI-Tools wie Claude und Claude Code, direkt auf unserem Snowflake Data Warehouse. Du nutzt AI, um Daten zu explorieren und zu analysieren sowie für die Automatisierung von wiederkehrenden Tasks. Du prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch, auch die zugrunde liegenden Abfragen, bevor sie in eine Entscheidung gehen, und befähigst andere Teams, selbst mit Daten und AI zu arbeiten. Das bringst du mit 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung in FP&A, Controlling, Corporate Finance, Beratung oder Investment Banking, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen. Ein sehr gutes Studium in Wirtschaft, Finance, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach. Sehr gute Modellierungsskills in Excel und Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Tableau. Nachweisbare Praxis mit AI-Tools für Analytics, z.B. Claude Code, Claude oder vergleichbaren Tools. Zeig uns, was du damit gebaut hast. Tempo und Ownership: Du wartest nicht auf Aufträge, siehst die nächste Frage, bevor sie gestellt wird, und bringst Dinge zu Ende. Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Zahlen, Operations und Go-to-Market zusammenhängen. Du übersetzt komplexe Analysen in eine klare Botschaft, für das Management genauso wie für Kolleg:innen ohne Finance-Hintergrund und sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch. Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Ein Plus: Erfahrung in einem Startup oder Scale-up und ein Hintergrund in Food, Retail, Logistik oder einem anderen operativ geprägten Geschäftsmodell sowie Erfahrung mit einem Data Warehouse (z. B. Snowflake), SQL oder einem Semantic Layer. DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Echte Wirkung: Deine Analysen fließen direkt in Entscheidungen von Geschäftsführung und Fachbereichen. Kurze Wege und enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern. Einen modernen Stack (Snowflake, Tableau, NetSuite, AI-Tools) und den Freiraum, ihn weiterzuentwickeln. Ein Team, das gerade neu aufstellt, wie FP&A mit AI und Semantic Layer arbeitet, und dich dabei mitgestalten lässt. Ein Unternehmen, das Hardware, Food und Software verbindet, mit Büro in München. jobs.title: Werkstudent Videoschnitt und Content Marketing (m/w/d) mit Übernahmeperspektive
jobs.description: Schneide Content, der Kanzleien sichtbar macht. Und wachse danach mit uns weiter. Kanzlei Brands unterstützt Kanzleien in ganz Deutschland bei der Gewinnung von Fachkräften, der Positionierung als Arbeitgeber und der Mandantengewinnung. Dafür entstehen bei uns jede Woche Videos, Social-Media-Posts, Anzeigen und Reports. Wir suchen Dich als Werkstudent, der Videos schneiden kann und ein Gefühl für gute Inhalte hat. Diese Stelle ist auf langfristige Zusammenarbeit ausgelegt: Wenn es passt, übernehmen wir Dich nach Deinem Studium in eine Festanstellung im Content- und Performance-Marketing. Deine Aufgaben Du schneidest Videos aus unseren Dreh- und Foto-Tagen, für unsere Kunden und für Kanzlei Brands. Du erstellst Reels, Carousels und Anzeigen-Creatives in mehreren Varianten. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - F/H

Un passage par le commerce, le e-commerce ou la supply chain, en particulier sur les sujets d'offre et de référencement, est un vrai plus. Une familiarité avec un progiciel de gestion de type SAP également. Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une posture conseil assumée, une excellente communication client et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve. Anglais professionnel. jobs.title: Staff Design Verification Engineer, AI HW
jobs.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Our Tensix team is building custom AI compute cores, RISC-V CPUs, and chiplet-based architectures for datacenter, edge, and automotive AI. Design Verification Engineers on this team validate compute IP and subsystems and build scalable DV infrastructure to keep verification fast, automated, and production-grade.

This role is hybrid, based out of Toronto, ON, Austin, TX or Belgrade, Serbia.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are

  • Experienced in modern verification methodologies with strong SystemVerilog skills and exposure to structured testbench development.
  • Comfortable working from block-level to system-level verification and reasoning about microarchitecture behavior from specs and waveforms.
  • Proficient in Linux environments with Python, or Bash scripting for automate builds, parse logs, manage CI pipelines.
  • Skilled in coverage-driven verification and confident debugging across RTL, testbench, and workload scenarios.
  • Motivated by AI hardware and eager to learn verification strategies for new architectures and domains.

What We Need

  • Contribute to verification of Tensix IP and subsystems from early planning through tape-out, owning coverage goals and driving them to closure.
  • Build and maintain reusable verification environments, agents, scoreboards, and supporting infrastructure in SystemVerilog and Python.
  • Develop constrained-random and directed tests and close functional, code, and assertion coverage using data-driven approaches.
  • Debug complex issues across RTL and testbench while collaborating with design, firmware, compiler, and architecture teams.
  • Help evolve DV infrastructure including regression flows, CI/CD integration, EDA compute environments, and reproducible setups.
  • Nice to have: Exposure to functional safety (FuSa) verification concepts for automotive AI workloads.
  • Nice to have: Familiarity with formal verification methodologies, SVA (SystemVerilog Assertions), or formal property verification for complex control logic and microarchitectural corner cases.

What You Will Learn

  • How Tenstorrent verifies AI-native compute architectures including Tensix cores, RISC-V CPUs, matrix units, vector units, and datapath.
  • How simulation, emulation, and software-driven workloads combine to validate both functional correctness and performance.
  • How numerical precision formats such as BF16, FP4, and INT8 and on-chip dataflow impact verification complexity and coverage strategy.
  • How to build scalable DV infrastructure across hybrid compute environments including containerized regression systems.
  • How data analytics and modern AI tooling can enhance verification workflows and accelerate convergence.

Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made.

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.

This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology. Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2). These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S. As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency. If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.

jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner (f/m/d)
jobs.description: About Focused Energy Focused Energy is building laser-driven inertial fusion as a commercial source of clean power. Our $240M Series A is the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, and we are using it to grow teams in Germany and the US at the same time. Your Role As the Senior HR Business Partner, you will be the People partner for our Engineering department, one of the fastest growing parts of the company. It brings together mechanical, electrical, hardware and other engineering disciplines, led by people who are hiring faster than their structures can keep up. Many of them are leading at this scale for the first time. They do not need HR explained to them. They need someone who understands what their team is trying to deliver and helps them decide how to organize, grow and lead it. This year we ran our first formal performance review and introduced a career framework. Both are in place and neither is finished. You will take what exists and make it hold as the company grows: calibration that leaders trust, levels that mean the same thing in Darmstadt and in Austin, promotion decisions that can be explained to the person who did not get one. You will have room to do that work. People Operations runs contracts, payroll and HR administration. Talent Acquisition runs hiring. You join a team of Business Partners, and your time goes into partnering and building. A background in fusion is not required. We expect you to want to learn how the business works, because your advice is only as good as your understanding of it. *This position is based in Darmstadt and requires onsite presence three days a week. This role reports to the Director People. German and English fluency are required. What you will own in your first year The people agenda for your client groups. How the teams are structured, where the next leaders come from, and which roles the business cannot afford to lose. The next performance and calibration cycle in your areas, from manager preparation through to the conversations that follow. The career framework for the business areas you support. Our company-wide framework sets the levels and the principles. You build the specific version underneath it with your leaders, so that a mechanical engineer and an electrical engineer can each see what growth looks like in their own discipline. Manager capability in your groups. By the end of the year, your leaders set clearer expectations and have the difficult conversation earlier than they do today. What You'll Do Most weeks start with a leader and a problem that is not yet well defined. A team that has doubled and stopped delivering. A strong engineer who is struggling as a manager. Two groups that both believe they own the same work. You ask enough questions to find what is underneath, bring options with a recommendation, and stay with the decision until it has landed. Alongside that you will: Coach managers on expectations, direct feedback and conversations they would rather postpone. Handle employee relations cases with care and sound judgment, within German employment law. Work with Talent Acquisition on hiring priorities and with People Operations on everything from contract type to exit, so leaders get one joined-up answer. Use people data to show leaders what is happening in their teams and what you would do about it. Priorities move here, and some processes are still being built. You will often be the person building them. What You Bring Experience as an HR Business Partner in a deep-tech or engineering-heavy company while it was growing fast. Something you built yourself. A performance process, a leveling framework, compensation bands. We will ask what you personally designed, what you would do differently, and what happened after rollout. Strong German employment law and GDPR, plus a working knowledge of People Operations, including how contract types and payroll deadlines shape a decision. Fluent German and English. Based in or near Darmstadt, or ready to relocate. The leaders you will work with are engineers. They respond to a precise question and a clear recommendation backed by evidence, and they notice quickly when either is missing. If that sounds like a room you enjoy, you will do well here. It helps if you have seen both a well-run large company and a scale-up, or have partnered with technical and scientific leaders before. What We Offer A competitive salary and stock options, so you hold a stake in what we build. A company contribution of 20% on top of your own payments into a private pension plan, plus loyalty incentives. 30 days of vacation. A mobility budget through NAVIT for public transport, car sharing or taxi, and access to gyms and studios across Europe through Wellhub. A canteen with daily lunch in Darmstadt, and the laptop and equipment of your choice from day one. A seat close to the leadership team, in a People function that is still being shaped. jobs.title: Senior Incident Response & Digital Forensics Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Who are we? It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents. All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS! Tasks As our Senior Incident Response Consultant (m/w/d) , you will support the NVISO incident response team (CSIRT) in responding to a wide range of cyber incidents. In addition to incident response and forensic engagements, you will work closely with the rest of the team to build & automate incident response processes, analytical capabilities, including threat hunting. You act as Incident Lead by setting investigative questions, delegating technical analysis tasks, and steer containment and eradication strategies. You produce high-quality forensic and executive reports to present findings to technical stakeholders and executives. You occasionally peer-review case notes, artifacts, and draft reports. Your responsibilities Perform host forensics (Magnet AXIOM Cyber, X-Ways, Autopsy), network forensics (Wireshark, tshark), memory forensics (Volatility, MemProcFS), and log analysis , including cloud telemetry (Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS, Google Cloud/Workspace), in support of cyber incident investigations. Lead single-system forensic analysis and contribute meaningfully to complex intrusions, including those with lateral movement, perform timeline analysis of compromised hosts and conduct live response artifact capture, volatile data collection, containment to support eradication and recovery efforts. Perform basic malware triage of executables and malicious scripts (static and behavioral) to inform containment and eradication strategies. Lead customer calls during incidents and contribute to cyber crisis management, and deliver status reports, planning for containment, eradication and recovery efforts, and input to executive-ready communications. Support improvement projects related to automation in digital forensics and further develop NVISO tools and incident response processes. Perform threat hunting engagements within customer environments, including technical planning, requirements definition, execution, and reporting. Assist in other engagements such as tabletop exercises, incident and forensic readiness assessments, and threat-intelligence-related briefings. Requirements You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states. 4+ years of hands-on experience, including acting as an incident response case lead. Strong knowledge of cyber intrusion analysis, incident response, digital forensics on Windows/MacOS/Unix, with demonstrated expertise in memory forensics (Volatility, MemProcFS), timeline analysis (e.g., MFTECmd, KAPE, Plaso/Timesketch), and disk forensics (Magnet AXIOM Cyber, X-Ways, Autopsy). Proficiency with live response tooling (e.g., Velociraptor, GRR Rapid Response, EDR live response) and coordinating remediation actions. Up-to-date on the latest cybersecurity threats and attacker TTPs. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail in documentation. Effective communication and interpersonal skills to work collaboratively with clients and cross-functional teams. Ability to remain calm during crisis situations and prioritize effectively under pressure. Language: German and English at C1+ proficiency for client-facing work across DACH. Your availability We have an On-call rotation, typically one week per month. Travel Some limited travel within DE/AT/CH (~10–20%) for onsite response, workshops, and stakeholder meetings. Benefits At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components: Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc); An entrepreneurial and agile company, where you will be stimulated and supported in driving new initiatives (either through internal innovation or by improving our service offering), without losing sight of having fun! Regular team-building and fun events; Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career! A training budget of 10,000 EUR plus 10 days paid time off rolling over two years; An annual gross base salary between 69,000 EUR and 87,000 EUR, depending on your experience; Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad options within the EU); Reimbursement of Deutschlandticket + BahnCard 50 1st Class; Business Bike Leasing; Company Pension Scheme; 30 holidays. Disclaimer on the Use of AI Tools in the Application Process Please be aware that the creation and submission of application documents (e.g. CV, cover letter, case studies, etc.) using AI-powered tools is only permitted to a limited extent . Our expectations: Application documents must authentically reflect your own qualifications, personality, and motivation. The use of AI for supportive purposes (e.g. spell-checking, improving wording) is acceptable. Fully generated application documents created by AI without personal adaptation or review are not permitted. Under no circumstances may NVISO information, data, or documents be uploaded to or processed by external AI tools. We reserve the right to exclude applications from the selection and interview process that are clearly created primarily or exclusively by AI and show no recognizable personal input. jobs.title: Founders Associate Internship (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Founders Associate Internship (m/f/d), 6 Months — ALPAMI Location: Munich (HQ), with regular visits to our properties and development sites Reports to: Founders / Managing Director Type: Full-time internship, 6 months, starting January/February 2027, ideally as a mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum) About ALPAMI At ALPAMI we're building a boutique hospitality brand. ALPAMI operates 250+ units across four countries: Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Italy. Our focus is the outdoors, with Tiny Houses and Cabins in nature, while our City Boutique Houses are our flagships. We also run Properties as a Service. We're not chasing stars; we're chasing 5-star experiences delivered in our own, unmistakably boutique way. We're bootstrapped, founder-led, and growing fast with a clear target of 500+ units 2027. That means there is more to build, analyse and decide than our founders can handle alone, and that's exactly where you come in. The Role We're looking for a Founders Associate intern who works side by side with our founders for six months and takes work off their desk, whatever it is. One week you're finding and qualifying new sites for our Tiny Houses, the next you're building the financial model for a new location or visiting a construction site, and in between you make sure our books are in order. You'll see every part of a growing hospitality company: deals, finance, development, expansion and operations. This is a hands-on role. You won't just prepare slides for others to act on. You'll own projects from the first analysis to the first guest, and you'll use AI to get there faster: we're looking for someone who builds with AI, not someone who only writes texts with it. If you want to learn how a hospitality company is built from the inside and take on real responsibility early, this is it. What You'll Do Source new sites with AI - find and qualify plots, municipalities, campsites and landowners for our Tiny Houses and prepare the first outreach. Sites are our biggest bottleneck, so this is your core task Analyse deals - screen and evaluate new properties, sites and management mandates, and prepare investment memos and decision papers for the founders Build financial models - business cases, budgets, financing and rent scenarios for new projects and existing properties Support our expansion - market and location research, preparation of investor and partner meetings, pitch materials, data rooms and documents for investors and banks Support our Tiny House developments - work with manufacturers, landowners, authorities and contractors, keep track of permits, budgets and timelines, and accompany site visits from groundwork to the first guest Help finding the right operational partners and calculate and negotiate terms Support bookkeeping tasks - manage invoices and receipts, prepare documents for our tax advisors, track costs and keep the liquidity overview up to date Own founder projects - from contract preparation and process setup to new tools and internal structures, you take on whatever matters most that week Automate with AI — turn processes that still run manually into workflows with AI tools and agents, such as our lead pipeline, reporting and contract database Be the founders' right hand — prepare meetings, follow up on decisions and make sure nothing falls through the cracks What You Bring (Must-Haves) Currently enrolled in a degree program, ideally a Master's, in business, industrial engineering, computer science, real estate, hospitality, finance or a related field First practical experience through internships or working student roles, ideally in a startup, real estate, hospitality, consulting or finance Strong analytical skills and confidence with numbers, Excel or Google Sheets You build with AI, not just write with it: workflows, automations or small tools, for example with Claude, n8n/Make, Python or no-code tools A genuine hands-on mentality — you get things done yourself instead of waiting for instructions A structured, reliable way of working and the ability to juggle several topics at once Bilingual in German and English (spoken and written) A driver's license and willingness to travel to our properties and development sites Discretion in handling confidential information Nice-to-Have First experience with financial modelling, real estate transactions or project development Basic knowledge of bookkeeping and accounting software Interest in hospitality, architecture and Tiny Houses Experience with Notion or similar tools What We Offer Direct collaboration with the founders - der im Fahrdienst eingesetzten Betriebsdienstmitarbeitenden liegt in deiner Hand Mitfahrberechtigungen sowie Strecken- und Ortskenntnis-Erwerbsaufträge gibst du aus und verwaltest die zugehörigen Zusatzbescheinigungen Per Stichprobe kontrollierst du Dienstpläne und Schichten hinsichtlich der Einhaltung von Lenk- und Ruhezeiten sowie der Planungsvorgaben gemäß BRW Bei Unfall- und Regelwerks arbeitest du aktiv mit und pflegst die Safety-internen digitalen Anwendungen Im Rahmen der ECM-Aufgaben überprüfst du die Einhaltung gesetzlicher und ECM-interner Vorgaben für den betriebssicheren Einsatz der Fahrzeuge Über Dich Du bringst einen Triebfahrzeugführerschein mit gültiger Zusatzbescheinigung sowie mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung (ohne Anrechnung der Ausbildungszeit) mit Das eisenbahnbetriebliche Regelwerk beherrschst du sehr sicher, idealerweise inklusive europäischer Regelungen und des grenznahen Auslands Eine Tauglichkeit gemäß TfV und mindestens ein Realschulabschluss sind bei dir gegeben, sowie nachweisbare Deutschkenntnisse mindestens C1-Niveau Mit mindestens 100 Fahrstunden als Triebfahrzeugführer:in im Kalenderjahr und einem PKW-Führerschein bist du bestens aufgestellt Deutschlandweit bist du gerne unterwegs und zeigst Bereitschaft zur Arbeit an Wochenenden, Feiertagen und nachts sowie zur Übernahme von Rufbereitschaften Im Umgang mit Reisenden und sicherheitsrelevanten Situationen bist du erfahren Ausgeprägte kommunikative Sensibilität im Umgang mit Mitarbeitenden und Behörden zeichnet dich aus Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Was Wir Bieten Mobilität: Mit deiner BahnCard100 bist du jederzeit flexibel unterwegs - auch in deiner Freizeit. Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie. Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten. Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen - für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige. Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen. Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen. Warum Teil von Flix werden? Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten - sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. jobs.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

Senior Marketing Manager – Mirakl Ads, EMEA

📍 Munich

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our EMEA Marketing team led by Hélène Kehren, VP of Marketing EMEA. You will also work closely with our EMEA VP of Sales for Mirakl Ads and his GTM teams. Together, you'll be driving awareness and pipeline growth for Mirakl Ads across the region.

2. Your Impact

  • Craft the regional marketing strategy to spread awareness, create demand, and accelerate pipeline growth for Mirakl Ads
  • Develop the regional marketing plan in collaboration with the sales and marketing team, across all marketing channels, trade shows, in-person and virtual events, and industry programmes
  • Develop account-based marketing plans for target accounts in collaboration with sales, and work with the digital marketing team to build campaign and advertising strategy for Mirakl Ads
  • Own the execution and management of all regional programmes, including project and budget management, in cooperation with regional field and digital marketing teams
  • Track and analyse the efficiency of marketing campaigns and events to determine ROI, prioritise resources, and ensure alignment between marketing investment and sales requirements across all Mirakl Ads programmes

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • 7+ years of experience in field marketing, ideally within a high-tech environment; experience in the e-commerce or advertising industries is a plus
  • Proven track record of building and executing impactful marketing programmes for both executive and practitioner audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to partner closely with sales teams on overall strategy, goals, and follow-up motions for field marketing initiatives
  • Experience with marketing reporting and the ability to demonstrate the ROI of events and programmes
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field
Skills:
  • Strong communication skills — interpersonal, written, and verbal
  • Outcomes-driven and analytical mindset
  • Ability to organise, prioritise, and multitask under tight deadlines
  • Familiarity with a range of mar-tech tools
  • Willingness to travel across the region

4. Tools Used

  • HubSpot
  • Salesforce
  • Dust
  • Google Workspace suite

5. Languages

  • English: advanced fluency required
  • German: fluency is a nice to have

6. Compensation, Perks & Benefits

  • Pay Range: Competitive; to be discussed during the recruiter screening call
  • Perks & Benefits: Details available on our careers page

7. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. jobs.title: Director of Engineering, KYX
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found.

You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring & ML team whose models power decisions across both domains.

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.

jobs.description:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

The role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building the Capacity and Quota Management control plane — the system that decides who gets compute, when, and how much.

Idle GPUs are waste. Overallocated ones are a contract you can't keep. Our platform consists of two core components: a capacity reservation engine managing guaranteed GPU reservations and their lifecycle, including rebalancing and auto-reclamation logic; and a Quotas Control Plane that manages quotas across all Nebius services, handles customer quota requests, and runs the algorithms that distribute resources. Both are exposed through APIs that give external customers, internal users, and downstream services visibility and control over their limits.
This is a high-ownership role. You will define how Capacity and Quota Management matures, from the technical foundations to the tradeoffs that outlast any single feature.

Familiarity with vector search technologies (pgvector or similar). Hands-on experience with product analytics and observability tools (e.g. PostHog, Sentry) to measure usage and drive adoption. Hands-on experience building AI into products (structured extraction, automation, RAG, or agentic workflows), not just using AI coding assistants. Strong engineering quality mindset, with experience building reliable, maintainable products and validating them through appropriate testing. Strong product sense — you understand business processes and the user perspective, not just the code. Strong communication skills and experience working with stakeholders at all levels and driving adoption of the solutions you build. Flat hierarchies & real growth opportunities Take ownership of your role and develop personally alongside the company. We promote from within and value every voice, regardless of seniority or title. Company pension program (bAV) Smart pension plan with a 30% Buying Labs grant on your contribution—investing in your financial future together. Corporate Benefits membership Access exclusive discounts from a wide range of partner brands and retailers. Full "Deutschlandticket" coverage We cover the complete cost (ca. €60/month) so you can travel sustainably and conveniently throughout Germany. Complimentary food & beverages Free Friday lunch in the office, plus organic fruit & vegetables, drinks, snacks, coffee/tea, healthy shots and seasonal treats (e.g. ice cream, soups) throughout the week. jobs.title: Senior AI Architect & Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wer wir sind Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt. Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Dich erwartet ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit echter Verantwortung und flachen Strukturen – Entscheidungen triffst Du selbst, statt sie durch Freigabeschleifen zu schieben. Wir suchen Dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht nur konzipiert, sondern ihren Weg in die Produktion aktiv mitverantwortet. Von der Architekturberatung auf C-Level bis zum Produktivbetrieb: Du entwirfst die Lösung und bringst sie mit dem Team in den echten Einsatz. Was dich erwartet Anspruchsvolle Projekte mit LLMs, Agentic RAG und AI-Agent-Frameworks (z. B. LangGraph, PydanticAI, Mastra oder OpenAI Agents SDK) – inklusive Deep-Agent-Architekturen. Du baust Evaluation-Pipelines und Observability (Logging/Tracing mit LangSmith, Langfuse o. Ä.) auf und arbeitest mit modernem MLOps-Stack sowie Vector Databases. Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen für komplexe Kundenvorhaben – mit Security, Compliance, Skalierbarkeit und Datenschutz im Hinterkopf – von der ersten Skizze im Gespräch bis zur konkreten Roadmap. Gemeinsam im Team führst Du Deep-Dive-Calls und Workshops mit Kunden durch und bringst sie in die nächste Projektphase. Du begleitest die Anbahnung neuer Projekte und unterstützt unser Team im Pre-Sales mit technischer Glaubwürdigkeit. Du kommunizierst souverän auf C-Level – Du verstehst ökonomische Ziele, sprichst die Sprache von Entscheider:innen und verbindest technische Exzellenz mit Business-Impact. Der Schwerpunkt Deiner Rolle liegt mit etwa 50 % in Kundenprojekten, in intensiven Phasen auch darüber. Den übrigen Teil Deiner Zeit investierst Du in Pre-Sales-Gespräche und Workshops, die Du vorbereitest und durchführst, sowie in die strategische Unterstützung von Geschäftsführung und Sales. Konferenzen, Community-Events, Fachbeiträge: Präsenz ist ein Plus, keine Bedingung. Wichtig ist uns nur, dass Du bereit bist, Dich fachlich zu zeigen. Du reist 4–8 Tage im Monat zu Kunden und Kolleg:innen – Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands, bei Bedarf auch in Österreich und der Schweiz, ist Teil der Rolle. Das solltest du mitbringen Langjährige Erfahrung als Architekt:in oder Senior Engineer, idealerweise bei einem Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung. Projekterfahrung mit Agentic-AI-Implementierungen, die über Prototypen hinausgeht: LangChain, LangGraph und Deep Agents im echten Einsatz – oder vergleichbare Tiefe im TypeScript-Umfeld (Mastra) bzw. im Microsoft-Ökosystem (Semantic Kernel / Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry). Vector Databases und MLOps sind ein Plus. Die Kompetenz, Kunden AI-Konzepte und Architekturen anschaulich und praxisnah zu vermitteln. Du kannst Lösungen im Kundengespräch skizzieren und überzeugend vertreten – Storytelling und Präsenz sind Deine Stärken. Du begegnest C-Level auf gleicher Ebene – Du verstehst, welche Aspekte Entscheider:innen bewegen und wie Du technische Konzepte in wirtschaftliche Relevanz übersetzt. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1+) und konversationssicheres Englisch. Das haben wir zu bieten Kompetitive Vergütung: Attraktives, marktgerechtes Gehaltspaket, das zu Deiner Erfahrung und Kompetenz passt. Echte Produktionsverantwortung: Deine Systeme laufen produktiv bei großen Unternehmensgruppen - nicht in der Demo-Umgebung. Gute Software bauen: Hier wird echter Wert auf Code- und Softwarequalität gelegt. Kein 08/15: Abwechslung durch unterschiedliche Branchen, Use Cases und Technologien - vom GPU-Cluster bis zum Voice-Agenten. Kundenbeziehung auf Augenhöhe: Wir pflegen eine ehrliche und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden. Mache einen Unterschied: Viel Verantwortung, großer Gestaltungsspielraum - in einem Mittelständler, in dem dein Beitrag den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg direkt beeinflusst. Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche. Wie arbeiten selbstorganisiert: Wir geben dir den Freiraum, den Rahmen für gute Arbeit selbst mitzugestalten – im Team wie beim Kunden. Werde berühmt: Eine technische Redaktion unterstützt dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren, sodass du als Experte nach außen sichtbar wirst. Du musst nicht die klügste Person im Raum sein: Echte Sparring-Partner, die deine Ideen gemeinsam mit dir auf die Probe stellen und weiterentwickeln. Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet Erreichbarkeit nach Feierabend, im Urlaub oder trotz Krankmeldung. Viele Überstunden sind bei uns nicht üblich. Gut für die Psyche: Ersthelfer psychische Gesundheit, Employee Assistance Programm und ein offener Umgang mit mentaler Gesundheit. Freiraum für dein Privatleben: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu vier Tage Homeoffice die Woche, spontan einen Tag frei, Arbeiten aus dem EU-Ausland, Sabbatical oder 4 Wochen Urlaub am Stück. Bring dein +1 mit: Brave Bürohunde oder Kinder an schulfreien Werktagen sind herzlich willkommen. Finanzielle Benefits: Regelmäßige Teamevents, Wellpass, 30 Tage Urlaub, Kindergartenzuschuss, Deutsche Dienstrad. Der Kontakt zu uns Du hast Feedback oder Fragen zu der Stelle? jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Short Description SPREAD builds engineering intelligence for the world's most complex products. Our AI-native platform gives automotive OEMs, defense primes, and industrial manufacturers a single source of product truth so engineering teams can make confident product decisions, fast. We work with companies like Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Bosch, and Rheinmetall. Backed by HV Capital, DTCP, La Famiglia, and Salesforce, and recognized with the SPARK AI Innovation Award and a place among LinkedIn's Top Startups in DACH. Role In this role, you sit inside the Founders' Office and work on the decisions that set SPREAD's direction. You own the strategy cycle and translate it into company goals and OKRs; you drive the strategic and improvement initiatives that come out of it, and you run the operating rhythm that keeps the leadership team deciding and the company executing. Alongside that, you own SPREAD's ecosystem of partners and senior industry advisors. You shape how the whole company hears about strategy through the monthly Assembly, and you build the material founders and the leadership team decide on. You report to the VP Strategy & Finance and work daily with the founders, the leadership team, and the people delivering the outcomes you help define. Your Mission Own the strategy cycle from analysis through to a written strategy the leadership team commits to, then translate it into company OKRs, goals, and the quarterly review rhythm that keeps every team measured against them. Drive strategic and improvement initiatives end to end. Recent examples include improving our cross-functional delivery model, leveling up our performance management system, building out our competitor intelligence, and rolling AI agents out company-wide. Run the operating rhythm of the leadership team across the weekly leadership meeting, monthly workshops, and half-year offsites. Set the agenda, prepare the discussions and decisions, and track every decision and task. Own the monthly company Assembly, from storyline to deck, so every team leaves knowing where SPREAD stands, where we are going, and what it means for their work. Build and steer SPREAD's partner ecosystem across hyperscalers, systems integrators, strategy consultancies, and tech companies, and convert those relationships into commercial opportunities, co-marketing and integrated offerings. jobs.title: Senior Salesforce Administrator

About us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.

NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

Role Mandate

A seasoned, hands-on administrator who understands the business problem, scopes and implements complex solutions across Salesforce and connected systems with minimal guidance, and stays accountable for technical quality through delivery and ongoing support.

About the Role

NinjaOne is looking for a Senior Salesforce Administrator to help shape the systems and capabilities that support our growing global revenue organization. As part of Sales Operations, you'll translate complex business needs into practical, scalable solutions across Salesforce and our connected sales technology ecosystem.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong technical judgment with business curiosity and a builder's mindset. You'll look beyond the immediate request to understand the underlying problem, challenge unnecessary complexity, and design and build solutions that improve how our teams work. Partnering closely with Salesforce Architects, Admins, our broader Sales Operations teams, and Revenue Stakeholders you'll guide solutions from discovery and design through implementation and adoption. Your impact will extend beyond individual projects: you'll help strengthen the architecture, standards, and technical capabilities that allow NinjaOne to scale without continually adding manual work or one-off solutions.


Location - Berlin, Germany

What You'll be Doing

jobs.title: Engineering Lead, Germany
jobs.description: At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients. We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning. The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it! The role Context Parallel uses AI to take administrative work off hospital teams, starting with inpatient coding. Our agents read the full patient record before billing, find what was documented but not coded, and coders validate every suggestion. We work with around 100 hospitals and clinics in France and are launching in Germany in 2027. You will own our technical roadmap for Germany and be our first engineering leader in the country. You report to Chris Rydhal, CTO and co-founder, and work every day with our General Manager, Germany and our Head of Medical Coding, Germany. Berlin or Munich, hybrid, regular trips to pilot hospitals and to Paris. Missions Own the German technical roadmap: decide what we build for Germany and in what order, on top of the core engine we share with Paris. Adapt our engine to German coding (ICD-10-GM, OPS, aG-DRG, DKR) with our Head of Medical Coding and AI engineers, and measure its accuracy. Run our agents on German hospital information systems (Dedalus ORBIS first, then CGM, Nexus, Meierhofer, i.s.h.med , Avelios) through ScreenFlow, our computer-use technology, and handle German data (§21 KHEntgG, §301 SGB V, HL7, FHIR / ISiK). Own the technical side of security and compliance: C5 attestation, hospital security reviews (B3S, NIS2), EU hosting and on-premise deployments when pilots need them. Deploy our first German pilots with our Forward Deployed Engineer. Build the German engineering team , as one team with Paris. In your first months, you will get ScreenFlow running on Dedalus ORBIS at our first pilot hospital, ship the first version of our German engine with our Head of Medical Coding, drive the technical work for our C5 attestation, and hire our Forward Deployed Engineer. Who you are 8 to 12 years in software engineering, including at least 2 years leading a small team or as tech lead. Still hands-on. You have shipped software into German hospitals or another regulated health environment. You have built integrations with hospital information systems (HL7, FHIR, ideally ISiK) and worked with security certifications (C5, ISO 27001, B3S). LLMs or ML in production are a plus. Experience at a KIS, Medizincontrolling or billing software vendor is a big plus. A builder and an owner who keeps one product with Paris, not two. Native German, fluent English. Our values Play to Win : we're not here to just take part, deliver something "good enough" or simply enjoy the startup ride. We want to win. That means caring about results, moving fast and bringing the right intensity when it matters. High Trust, High Standards : trust is our starting point. If you join us, it's because we believe you can own your scope and make good decisions. We don't want a company built on approvals, control and micromanagement. But trust comes with accountability: the more freedom you have, the higher the bar. Low Ego, Hands-On : at Parallel, no one is above the work. No title, seniority or past success exempts anyone from getting involved in the actual work. Leading means taking responsibility, not distancing yourself from execution. Don't Take Yourself Too Seriously : we take our mission very seriously, not ourselves. Building a company is intense. We want Parallel to remain a place where people enjoy spending time together, laughing, celebrating and giving energy to others. High standards and a good atmosphere aren't opposites: we want both. Hiring process Intro call (30 min). Technical deep dive with Chris (60 min): a system you built and the hard calls you made. Design session (90 min, in person or by video): design our first German pilot, end to end. Meet the team (General Manager and Head of Medical Coding, Germany), then references. Why join us? Build the German product and engineering team from day one, on a founding team. A product already live in around 100 hospitals, an AI engine and computer-use technology built for hospitals that can't wait for long integration projects. A competitive package We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application. jobs.title: Legal Counsel - IT & Data Protection
jobs.description: Hi, we’re AMBOSS and we’re searching for a Legal Counsel to support our business in IT & Data Protection matters! About AMBOSS AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town. Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique Why can this position be exciting for you? In this role, you will be the core link between regulatory requirements and day-to-day operations. By partnering in early stages with product and engineering teams, you turn complex privacy rules – including emerging AI frameworks – into straightforward, actionable guidance that keeps projects moving forward & safely. From streamlining vendor reviews and data subject requests to mapping risks across our systems, your work lead to practical processes, ensuring AMBOSS expands into new markets with scalable compliance already built in. You will: Be a trusted data protection advisor for our teams. You partner with product and engineering from concept to launch, including on [AI-based features / new markets]. You give clear, pragmatic recommendations. Own data protection risk assessment across our systems and processes. You identify, assess and prioritise compliance risks and turn them into practical frameworks that teams can use. Keep us ahead of international requirements. You track data protection and related regulation in our markets, including AI-related rules, and turn them into pragmatic solutions for AMBOSS. Make vendors, tools and contracts easy to get right. You review and negotiate data processing agreements and assess new software and vendors, so the business gets fast, reliable answers. Build and improve our data protection operations. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Bei CloudFactory sind wir ein missionsgetriebenes Team mit der Leidenschaft, das Potenzial von KI zu erschließen, um die Welt zu verändern. Durch die Kombination fortschrittlicher Technologie mit einem globalen Netzwerk talentierter Menschen machen wir bisher nicht nutzbare Daten nutzbar und erzielen damit echten Impact in großem Maßstab. Wir sind mehr als nur ein Arbeitsplatz – wir sind eine globale Gemeinschaft, die auf starken Beziehungen und der Überzeugung basiert, dass sinnstiftende Arbeit Leben verändert. Unser Engagement für Earning, Learning und Serving treibt alles an, was wir tun. Gemeinsam verfolgen wir das Ziel, eine Million Menschen mit sinnstiftender Arbeit zu verbinden und Führungspersönlichkeiten aufzubauen, denen man gerne folgt. Unsere Kultur Bei CloudFactory glauben wir daran, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich alle ermächtigt, wertgeschätzt und inspiriert fühlen, ihr authentisches Ich einzubringen. Wir sind: Missionsgetrieben: Wir konzentrieren uns darauf, wirtschaftlichen und sozialen Impact zu schaffen. Menschenzentriert: Wachstum, Wohlbefinden und das Zugehörigkeitsgefühl unseres Teams liegen uns sehr am Herzen. Innovativ: Wir nehmen Veränderungen an und finden gemeinsam bessere Wege, Dinge umzusetzen. Global vernetzt: Wir fördern die Zusammenarbeit über verschiedene Kulturen und Perspektiven hinweg. Wenn Sie sich für Innovation, Zusammenarbeit und echten Impact begeistern, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie an Bord zu begrüßen! Rollenübersicht Als Site Reliability Engineer spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle dabei, alle Produktionssysteme reibungslos am Laufen zu halten. Sie arbeiten eng mit anderen Engineers und Operators zusammen, um Engineering-Prinzipien, Betriebswissen, Sicherheit und Automatisierung zu verbinden – mit dem Ziel von Production Excellence auf Plattform- und Service-Ebene aus Sicht von Infrastruktur, Zuverlässigkeit und Sicherheit. Das SRE-Team verantwortet das Fundament der Core-Plattform unserer AI Platform – die Services und Infrastruktur, die uns Deployments über verschiedene Public-Cloud-Anbieter hinweg ermöglichen und viele ML- und LLM-gestützte Funktionen antreiben. Wir geben jedem anderen Engineering-Team eine zuverlässige Basis, auf der es aufbauen kann, und wir verantworten den Software-Delivery-Lifecycle Ende-zu-Ende: das Tooling, die Patterns und die Automatisierung, die Reibungsverluste für das gesamte Unternehmen reduzieren. Dies ist eine spannende Gelegenheit, sich beruflich weiterzuentwickeln und gleichzeitig zu einer missionsgetriebenen Organisation beizutragen. Aufgabenbereiche: Was Sie verantworten Zuverlässigkeit der Plattform (einschließlich ML- und LLM-Workloads) – Infrastruktur für Model-Serving und Inferenz (GPU-gestützte Endpoints, Autoscaling, Latenz- und Kosten-Trade-offs), mit SLOs, Bereitschaftsdienst (On-Call) und Incident Response, die nicht nur Services, sondern auch Modelle abdecken Observability (einschließlich ML-Modellen) – Drift- und Performance-Monitoring für ML sowie LLM-spezifisches Tracing, Evals und Guardrails, angebunden an dieselben Metrik- und Logging-Stacks, die wir überall sonst einsetzen Unternehmensweite technische Ausrichtung: Mitgestaltung der Roadmap und Aufbau von Golden Paths, die den Standard für jedes Team anheben Developer-Tooling und Automatisierung, die sich multipliziert – wiederverwendbare GitHub Actions, GitOps-Workflows, Terraform-Module –, damit alle Engineers schneller ausliefern Wiederverwendbare Komponenten, die gängige Open-Source-Tools (Grafana, Istio, Cloud-Native-Stack sowie ML-Tools wie Model Registries und Feature Stores) bündeln, damit Teams sie in jeder Umgebung deployen können Secure-by-Default-Infrastruktur – Verankerung von Sicherheit, Compliance-Audits, Kosten-Governance und Audit-Trails in der Plattform in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Lead-, Backend- und Staff-Engineers. Vergütung Die anfängliche Vergütung für diese Position beträgt 55.140 € brutto pro Jahr. Konkrete Angebote werden anhand von Aufgabenbereich, Qualifikation und Erfahrung festgelegt. Requirements Wer Sie sind (Must-haves) 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Infrastructure Engineering, DevOps oder SRE im Betrieb groß angelegter, hochverfügbarer Produktionssysteme mit Kubernetes Operative Produktionserfahrung – ein Live-Cluster unter echter Last, kein Labor. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Helm sowie Terraform oder CloudFormation auf mindestens einem großen Cloud-Anbieter (AWS bevorzugt). Gute Kenntnisse in Python oder Go oder allgemeinem Scripting für Automatisierung und Tooling (Automatisierung mit einer höheren Programmiersprache bevorzugt) KI ist bereits Teil Ihres täglichen Loops – Agentic Tooling (Claude Code, Codex, Droid, interne Skills) gehört zu Ihrer Art auszuliefern und ist nichts, womit Sie nur experimentieren. Wir glauben, dass KI-Tools mit menschlichem Urteilsvermögen großartig sein können, und wir möchten, dass das SRE-Team die nächste Welle in den täglichen Betrieb bringt. Denken aus First Principles – Herleiten aus Rahmenbedingungen und Fehlermodi unter Benennung des Trade-offs in geschäftlichen Begriffen (Zuverlässigkeit vs. Geschwindigkeit, Kosten vs. Blast Radius, Standardisierung vs. Einzellösung) Mindestens ein Infrastruktur-Aufbau, den Sie Ende-zu-Ende verantwortet haben – mit der dazugehörigen Ergebniskennzahl (Deployment-Zeit, MTTR, Kosten, Adoption, Verfügbarkeit). Funktionsübergreifende Stärke. Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Product-, Backend-/Frontend-Teams, um gemeinsame Initiativen voranzutreiben. ML- & AI-Plattform (stark bevorzugt) Betrieb von ML-Workloads auf Kubernetes – GPU-Scheduling, Kapazitäts- und Kostenmanagement Model Serving und Inferenz im Produktionsmaßstab (z. B. KServe, RayServe, Triton, vLLM oder Ähnliches) mit realen Latenz- und Kostenvorgaben (RayServe bevorzugt) MLOps-Pipeline-Tooling – Training-Pipelines, Model Registries, Feature Stores und Lineage (Kubeflow, MLflow, Feast, Weights & Biases oder Äquivalente) LLMOps in Produktion – Inference Serving, Prompt-/Versionsmanagement sowie LLM-Observability (Tracing, Evals, Drift, Guardrails, Kosten pro Request) Governance von ML-/LLM-Workloads als Plattform-Capabilities: Data-Residency- und PII-Kontrollen sowie Audit-Trails Weitere allgemeine Anforderungen Globale Zusammenarbeit: Fähigkeit, über globale Teams und verschiedene Kulturen hinweg in verschiedenen Zeitzonen mit starker Kommunikationsfähigkeit zu arbeiten. Problemlösung: Fähigkeit, komplexe Probleme in einfache, umsetzbare Lösungen herunterzubrechen. Eigenverantwortung & Tatendrang: Neigung, über das Erwartete hinauszugehen, um Deadlines einzuhalten, eigene Ergebnisse zu steuern und Teammitglieder zu unterstützen. Verfügbarkeit: Bereitschaft, Prozesse für einen 24x7-Betriebssupport zu unterstützen. Benefits Bei CloudFactory glauben wir, dass Arbeit mehr sein sollte als nur ein Job – sie sollte eine Plattform für Wachstum, Impact und Gemeinschaft sein. Hier verdienen Sie mit Sinn, lernen jeden Tag dazu und dienen einer Mission, die wirklich zählt. Wenn Sie eine Karriere suchen, in der Sie sich beruflich weiterentwickeln, einen echten Beitrag leisten und Teil einer globalen Bewegung sein können, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie auf dieser Reise zu begleiten! Werden Sie noch heute Teil unserer Mission, Menschen und Technologie für eine bessere Welt zu verbinden! jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer - React
jobs.description: ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community. We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research. Objective of the role We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end. Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany. The team You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors. Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment. Responsibilites Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features. Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP. Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure. Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products. Requirements 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable. Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking. Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective. You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output. Knowledge of GraphQL. It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres). What we're looking for You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them. You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment. You focus on building a great product. You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information. The interview process We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry. There will be a longer discussion about your technical and professional experience and expectations with an Engineering Manager and another colleague. We’ll facilitate a technical interview with one or two engineers with some pair programming and technical discussion. You'll have a conversation with our VP of Product, Mark, and our VP of Engineering, Frank, to learn more about our product and engineering organization and discuss how your experience aligns with our goals. Last but not least, you will meet with our CEO, Ijad, and our VP of Finance & People team, Jess. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
