jobs.title: Staff Robot Control Software Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Your tasks Imagine fleets of autonomous forklifts, each weighing several tons, lifting heavy loads into racks up to 14 meters high, safely and around the clock, right next to people. That's what we build at Jungheinrich Robotics, and AI-assisted engineering plays an important role in how we do it. In this role, you ensure that every one of these vehicles moves exactly as intended. We are hiring at both Senior and Staff levels. Apply for the role that fits you best, and we'll find the right fit together! You take ownership of the control software for our autonomous forklifts, from a unified hardware abstraction layer and actuator control based on ros_control/ros2_control to the interfaces with localization and navigation. You model and implement vehicle kinematics for different forklift types, including acceleration- and jerk-limited motion. You integrate motor controllers, drives, and actuators using fieldbus systems, particularly CANopen. You integrate and calibrate robot sensors, including encoders, IMUs, laser scanners, cameras, and lift height sensors. You improve the reliability of our robots in real-world environments through intelligent error handling, automated recovery mechanisms, and logging and analysis tools. You define and execute integration and system-level tests on real robots, test benches, and in simulation. You shape and drive the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across the team, from coding and test generation to AI-supported log analysis. You develop technical concepts and architectures for robot control, analyze requirements and trade-offs, and align design decisions with system architects, safety experts, and navigation specialists. You drive cross-team initiatives and mentor colleagues, depending on your experience and expertise. Requirements You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field, or bring equivalent practical experience. You bring at least 6 years of professional experience in robotics software development, including at least 3 years working with real mobile robots. You actively use AI-based tools, such as coding assistants, in your daily work and are eager to explore their potential further. You have proven experience developing technical concepts and architectures for robotic systems. You have a solid understanding of mobile robot kinematics, including acceleration-limited motion, and how localization and navigation interact with the hardware. You bring extensive experience with ROS1/ROS2 or comparable middleware, as well as ros_control/ros2_control or similar frameworks. You have experience integrating sensors, actuators, and fieldbus systems, ideally CANopen. You have strong programming skills in C++ and solid knowledge of Python. Experience with Rust is a plus. You bring in-depth expertise in at least one of the following areas: Safety PLC applications, such as Siemens S7 / TIA Portal Safety, Beckhoff TwinSAFE, or SICK Flexi Soft. Low-level, hardware-related software development, including CAN drivers, PROFINET, timing, and synchronization in sensor networks, ideally combined with microcontroller or embedded systems knowledge. Autonomous software for real robots, such as localization, navigation, and motion planning, combined with an interest in developing deeper expertise in low-level control. You are passionate about developing software that enables heavy autonomous vehicles to move smoothly and safely, and want to help shape the future of large robotic fleets in real warehouse environments. You ideally have experience with jerk-limited motion, setting up complete mobile robot software stacks, or intralogistics applications involving automated forklifts, AGVs, or AMRs. You communicate fluently in English and have intermediate German language skills (B1 level or higher). You are willing to work on-site at our Munich location. What we have to offer Cutting-edge technology: As pioneers in robotics we can navigate and manipulate without rails and guides and offer solutions to processes that no one could automate ever before! Team: We are an international team with more than 25 nationalities. You’ll work in a team with exceptionally smart, humble, collaborative and hardworking individuals. Culture: Come as you are! Join a vibrant, inventive, and diverse team that values collaboration over hierarchy. To innovate you need to fail from time to time — we always learn and improve. Workplace: Our office is located near the S‑Bahn station “Hirschgarten”. We work in a loft-style office with great equipment, our own workshop and testing area. Full Board: You don’t feel like thinking about what you want to have for lunch tomorrow, not to mention preparing it? Luckily, our french cook treats us with a freshly cooked free lunch everyday! And as the cherry on top, there is a packed fridge with drinks, fresh fruits and of course coffee! Flexibility: Flexibility is a top priority for us. Our hybrid working model for positions where presence is dispensable helps to achieve a healthy work-life balance. Benefits : We offer attractive holiday, EGYM, health care, and compensation packages. Learn more about our current benefits here. Not sure if you meet every single requirement? That's okay. We know that great people don't always tick every box. If you're excited about the opportunity to help shape the future of robotics and believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Your experience may be a great fit for this role or another opportunity at Jungheinrich Robotics. At Jungheinrich Robotics, where Magazino GmbH found its place, fostering inclusivity is very important to us. We are dedicated to create an inclusive environment for all candidates and provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, national origin, sexual orientation, culture, or education. If you need any reasonable adjustments to make the application process accessible for you, we’ll do our best to accommodate you. Feel free to approach us for that! Du entwickelst und verantwortest Komponenten unserer Steuerungssoftware für autonome Gabelstapler, von der Hardware-Abstraktionsschicht und der Aktuatorsteuerung auf Basis von ros_control/ros2_control bis hin zu den Schnittstellen zur Lokalisierung und Navigation. Du definierst und führst Integrations- und Systemtests an realen Robotern, Prüfständen und in Simulationen durch. Du nutzt KI-gestützte Entwicklungstools in deinem Arbeitsalltag, von der Programmierung und Testgenerierung bis hin zur Loganalyse. Du bringst mindestens 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Robotik-Softwareentwicklung mit, davon mindestens 2 Jahre in der Arbeit mit realen mobilen Robotern. Du nutzt KI-basierte Tools, wie beispielsweise Coding-Assistenten, aktiv in deinem Arbeitsalltag und möchtest deren Einsatzmöglichkeiten weiter ausbauen. Du verfügst über ein fundiertes Verständnis der Kinematik mobiler Roboter, einschließlich beschleunigungsbegrenzter Bewegungen, sowie des Zusammenspiels von Lokalisierung, Navigation und Hardware. Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit ROS1/ROS2 oder vergleichbarer Middleware sowie mit ros_control/ros2_control oder ähnlichen Frameworks mit. Du hast Erfahrung in der Integration von Sensoren, Aktuatoren und Feldbussystemen, idealerweise CANopen. Du verfügst über sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in C++ und solide Kenntnisse in Python. Erfahrung mit Rust ist ein Plus. Du begeisterst dich dafür, mit deiner Software mehrere Tonnen schwere autonome Fahrzeuge sicher und präzise zu bewegen, und möchtest die Zukunft großer Roboterflotten in realen Lagerumgebungen mitgestalten. Du bringst idealerweise vertiefte Kenntnisse in mindestens einem der folgenden Bereiche mit: Sicherheitsgerichtete SPS-Anwendungen, beispielsweise Siemens S7 / TIA Portal Safety, Beckhoff TwinSAFE oder SICK Flexi Soft. Hardware-nahe Softwareentwicklung, beispielsweise CAN-Treiber, PROFINET, Timing und Synchronisation in Sensornetzwerken, idealerweise mit Kenntnissen im Bereich Mikrocontroller und Embedded Systems. Autonome Software für reale Roboter, beispielsweise Lokalisierung, Navigation und Bewegungsplanung, kombiniert mit dem Interesse, dein Wissen im Bereich Low-Level-Control weiter zu vertiefen. Du bringst idealerweise Erfahrung mit ruckbegrenzten Bewegungsabläufen, dem Aufbau vollständiger Software-Stacks für mobile Roboter oder Intralogistik-Anwendungen mit automatisierten Gabelstaplern, AGVs oder AMRs mit. Du kommunizierst fließend auf Englisch und verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf mittlerem Niveau (mindestens B1). Du bist bereit, vor Ort an unserem Standort in München zu arbeiten. Was wir bieten Spitzentechnologie: Als Pioniere der Robotik sind wir in der Lage, ohne Schienen und Leitlinien zu navigieren und zu manipulieren, und bieten Lösungen für Prozesse, die noch nie jemand zuvor automatisieren konnte! Team: Wir sind ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten. Du wirst in einem Team mit sehr smarten, bescheidenen, kooperativen und fleißigen Individuen arbeiten. Kultur : Sei einfach Du selbst! Werde Teil eines dynamischen, innovativen und vielfältigen Teams, das Zusammenarbeit über Hierarchie stellt. Um innovativ zu sein, muss man ab und zu scheitern – wir lernen und verbessern uns ständig. Arbeitsplatz: Unser Büro befindet sich in der Nähe der S‑Bahn-Station „Hirschgarten“. Wir arbeiten in einem Büro im Loft-Stil mit toller Ausstattung, eigener Werkstatt und Testbereich. Vollverpflegung: Du hast keine Lust, darüber nachzudenken, was Du morgen zu Mittag essen willst, geschweige denn, es vorzubereiten? Zum Glück verwöhnt uns unser französischer Koch jeden Tag mit einem frisch gekochten kostenlosen Mittagessen! Und als Sahnehäubchen gibt es einen gefüllten Kühlschrank mit Getränken, frischem Obst und natürlich Kaffee! Flexibilität: Flexibilität wird bei uns großgeschrieben. Unser hybrides Arbeitsmodell für Positionen, bei denen Anwesenheit verzichtbar ist, trägt zu einer gesunden Work-Life-Balance bei. Benefits: Wir bieten attraktive Urlaubs‑, EGYM‑, Gesundheits- und Vergütungsleistungen. Erfahren Sie hier mehr über unsere aktuellen Mitarbeiterbenefits. jobs.description: Your Mission: We are looking for a Senior Weight Management Engineer (all genders) to join our Central Engineering team and lead mass properties engineering activities for the Microliner aircraft. You will be responsible for establishing, maintaining, and communicating the aircraft mass properties baseline throughout the development lifecycle. Working closely with the Overall Aircraft Design, Airframe, Systems, Propulsion, Technology, Flight Physics, and Configuration Management teams, you will guide aircraft, system, and discipline owners in establishing reliable mass data and consolidate this information into a consistent, traceable, and configuration-controlled aircraft mass properties baseline. As a senior member of Central Engineering, you will provide mass properties expertise across the organization, support technical and programme decision-making, and ensure that mass properties objectives are consistently considered throughout design, verification, certification, and production. Your Day-to-Day: Lead mass properties engineering for the Microliner across aircraft, system, subsystem, and lower levels, ensuring reliable, traceable, and configuration-controlled mass data throughout design maturation, verification, certification, and transition into production. Maintain, further develop, analyse, and communicate the consolidated aircraft mass properties baseline. Manage and continuously refine mass targets, allocations, margins, and weight-saving objectives in collaboration with aircraft, system, and discipline owners. Guide aircraft, system, and discipline owners in estimating, substantiating, and maintaining mass properties data for their respective scope, providing methods, quality assurance, and configuration-control guidance. Perform aircraft weight and balance analyses, including operational loading conditions, centre-of-gravity envelopes, loading scenarios, and compliance with applicable airworthiness requirements. Evaluate mass properties across aircraft configurations, managing applicability, effectivity, and consistency within the aircraft mass model. Assess and communicate the mass-properties impact of design changes, technical trades, system integration decisions, and configuration changes. Define mass properties verification and weighing requirements, and coordinate with suppliers and system owners to ensure that measured data is appropriately substantiated, reconciled, and incorporated into the configuration-controlled aircraft mass properties baseline. Further develop and continuously improve mass properties processes, methods, tools, reporting, governance, and interfaces with configuration management and the wider engineering toolchain. Your Profile: Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline. Minimum 8 years of professional experience in aircraft mass properties engineering, preferably within the development and certification of civil aircraft under EASA CS-23 or FAA Part 23. Relevant experience from CS-25/Part 25, military or eVTOL development is also considered. Experience with the mass properties of battery-electric aircraft, electric propulsion systems, high-voltage systems, or other electric aviation technologies is a strong plus. Demonstrated experience managing aircraft mass properties throughout the product development lifecycle, including mass estimation, target setting, allocation, tracking, reporting, configuration control, and the incorporation of substantiated mass data into the aircraft baseline. Strong expertise in aircraft weight and balance, centre-of-gravity envelope development, loading analysis, moments of inertia, mass margins, uncertainty management, and mass-properties substantiation. Demonstrated experience working across the complete aircraft product hierarchy, from aircraft-level mass objectives and operational loading conditions through system, and lower-level hardware mass data, ensuring consistency and traceability between levels. Good understanding of aircraft design, systems integration, configuration management, certification, and the interaction between mass properties, aircraft performance, structures, stability and control, and operational capability. Proficiency with mass properties databases and analysis tools, as well as experience integrating mass data within product lifecycle management and configuration-controlled engineering environments; experience with Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE is a strong plus. Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented professional with strong ownership of aircraft-level outcomes, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate mass properties implications effectively across technical disciplines and programme stakeholders. jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description: Overview Physical AI, a real model of the world, is the next trillion dollar opportunity and a foundational pillar for energy, robotics and superintelligence. At Jua we are building it now. Our models already run on four continents and help power the energy buildout needed to support ever larger intelligence. We are assembling a world-class team of researchers and entrepreneurial minds to turn this model into reality at global scale. If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us. The Role You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. The pace is high, the context load is real, and you'll see everything. This is also a launchpad into an executive leadership role. This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone. What You Will Do Problem-solve directly with the leadership team on the highest-leverage issues across the business — from product, marketing and operations to fundraising and partnerships. Sit in high-stakes meetings with customers, investors, and strategic partners, and turn what happens there into clear next steps. Bring clarity to priorities and make sure decisions actually turn into action. Build lightweight dashboards and operating rhythms that help the team learn from data that's still evolving — without pretending it's cleaner than it is. Be the glue across the business: spot where cross-functional work is stuck and personally unblock it — including outside your core areas, whether that's a marketing crunch, a vendor issue, or whatever's fallen through the cracks. Write sharp briefs, investor materials, and internal notes. Handle practical execution when it matters — travel, schedules, logistics, on-site coordination. Who You Are A fast learner who can switch contexts without dropping quality — the mix of what you're doing will genuinely change over time, and you're energised by that rather than needing it to settle. Real depth in one or two areas, not experience scattered thinly across many — we'd rather see two or three things you've actually driven than a long list of things you've touched. Comfortable with data and analytical tools (vibe coding is enough) — precise enough to help the team make calls on metrics that are still taking shape, without waiting for perfect numbers. A clear, concise communicator who compresses complexity. High ownership and bias toward action. Comfortable with ambiguity — figuring things out as you go — and good at building real relationships across the team to get things done through others. Challenges directly — firm, honest input with no ego or personal agenda — then backs the CEO's call fully, including the ones that don't pan out. Spots problems before anyone else does, and gets ahead of them — not just reactive once something's already stuck. A professional background in a leadership position in one of the following domains, along with cross-functional experience in other parts of the business too : Product, Commercial, People and/or Engineering. Hands-on experience at an early-stage startup that is still building, still raising — or founder experience — is a strong plus over scale-up experience. Requirements Zurich-based strongly preferred - either current location or planning to relocate. Frequent short-notice travel to the UK, Nordics, US, and Asia. Comfortable operating at high speed with fast decision cycles. Professional experience, relationships or network relevant to Jua's industry and customer base preferred. At Jua, we foster a performance culture and value people who embody our beliefs of service and adventure. We prioritize agility, operating at the highest clock speed to adapt quickly to change. We innovate on behalf of our users and leverage data supremacy to maintain our competitive edge. Through clear communication and fact-based decision-making, we ensure alignment in our pursuit of excellence. With these principles, we aim to create a customer-focused, value-centric organization that sets new standards in the industry. We value the unique perspectives that each individual brings to the table and believe that embracing diverse backgrounds and experiences enriches our collective journey towards growth and success. jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships. Who We're Looking For A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. jobs.description: What you'll do At snke, we are building the digital infrastructure for the next generation of the operating room. You will define how our platform scales from individual operating rooms to entire hospital networks, enabling reliable data exchange, AI-powered workflows and future clinical applications in highly regulated healthcare environments. Define versioning and compatibility strategies that support customer environments operating on different upgrade cycles. Design observability and diagnostics capabilities that allow issues to be investigated and resolved remotely without direct access to hospital systems. Work closely with our Machine Learning team to define architectures for deploying AI workloads and processing clinical data across edge, on-premise and cloud environments. Design data exchange concepts that support a wide range of customer requirements, from connected environments to fully air-gapped installations. You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on mindset and are comfortable working across teams to turn architectural concepts into production-ready solutions. Ideally, you bring: 7+ years of experience designing and operating distributed systems in production environments. Strong expertise in distributed systems architecture, including partitioning, replication, consistency models, caching, messaging, backpressure mechanisms and fault tolerance. Experience evaluating and sizing distributed systems based on performance, throughput, capacity and operational requirements. Hands-on experience with large-scale real-time media, video processing or other high-volume data systems. Experience designing APIs, interfaces or protocols that must remain compatible across multiple versions and independently upgraded environments. Strong analytical skills and the ability to make complex technical trade-offs understandable, measurable and actionable. Experience with healthcare standards such as DICOM or HL7 FHIR, software deployed to customer-operated environments, or our current technology stack is beneficial, but we are primarily looking for the right architectural mindset and experience building complex distributed systems. jobs.title: Software Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
This role is located in Munich, Germany. TULIP is a hybrid work environment and we are in the office 3+ days/per week.

About TULIP

TULIP is the frontline operations platform that helps manufacturers digitize, connect and continuously improve how they run production, with AI at the core of the product. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries.

In January 2026, TULIP closed its $120M Series D, at a valuation of $1.3B. Leading global manufacturers run on TULIP, including VEKA, DMG Mori, Roche, AstraZeneca, Richemont, Saint-Gobain Aerospace and Mitsubishi Electric. We partner with NVIDIA, PwC, McKinsey, BCG and more than 160 technology partners worldwide. TULIP is part of the World Economic Forum's Global Innovator community, and our CEO, Dr. Natan Linder, co-chairs the Forum's Advanced Manufacturing Industry Governors Community.

The opportunity in DACH for TULIP

DACH is the heart of global manufacturing. Germany is Europe's largest industrial economy and the birthplace of Industrie 4.0. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Today, these companies face similar pressures: fewer skilled workers, rising quality and compliance demands, and the need to modernize existing plants without stopping production. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value.

TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP’s headquarters in Europe. The team covers sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, customer success, and R&D. Local customers trust our product in regulated, high-precision environments.

About You

You're an engineering leader who cares about getting security-critical systems right and who wants to reach customers fast, not sit buried in a backlog. You think in specs and failure modes, you stay close to the code, and you're already using AI tooling to change how your team builds, not just how quickly they move. You'll take over a small, strong team and own how the world's most demanding manufacturers authenticate, provision, and govern access for their people and, increasingly, the AI agents acting on their behalf.

What skills do I need?

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with direct involvement building and operating security-critical or identity/access systems in production
  • 3+ years of people management experience leading a software team, where you've hired, given constructive feedback, and grown engineers
  • Hands-on depth with OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, OIDC, and SCIM in enterprise environments — you understand the specs and their failure modes, not just the libraries
  • Experience building multi-tenant systems where tenant isolation is a hard requirement
  • Working knowledge of IAM, secrets management, and access policy across AWS and Azure, including the tradeoffs when customers span both
  • A track record of shipping clean, tested code and holding a team to the same standard
  • Active use of AI tooling in your own practice, with a point of view on how it changes the way teams build
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent working experience

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture and roadmap for identity & access — SSO/SAML/OIDC federation, SCIM provisioning, multi-tenant account structures, and the authorization layer across Tulip's multi-cloud infrastructure.
  • Represent Identity & Access in cross-functional architecture reviews and roadmap decisions.
  • Lead and grow a small, high-caliber team — run regular 1:1s, set quality standards, give direct feedback, and develop engineers on security-critical systems.
  • Protect operations where failures carry tangible stakes—from halted production lines to scrapped material and compliance risks. What you ship here has a direct impact on customers.
  • Drive adoption of AI tooling in how the team builds — code review, test generation, spec drafting, and agent loops — and share what works across engineering.
  • Create and own difficult tradeoffs on IAM and access policy where tenant isolation and enterprise compliance are non-negotiable.
  • Ship work that reaches customers quickly and reliably, with operational excellence as the default.

Key Collaborators

  • Security & Infrastructure
  • Platform Engineering
  • Product Management
  • Customer Success

Working At Tulip

We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. Even if you don’t match every requirement, applying gives you the opportunity to be considered.

We’re building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well-being. Benefits of working with us include:

    • Direct impact on product and culture
    • Company equity
    • Competitive benefits package including commuter benefits, learning and development stipend, team events, catered lunches 3 days a week
    • Flexible work schedule and unlimited vacation policy
    • An inclusive, dog-friendly office with diverse and inspiring colleagues
    • Virtual and in-office global company events and happy hours

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Please note that we may use AI-based tools to support parts of our hiring process. All data processing is carried out in compliance with local data protection laws, ensuring all personal candidate information is handled securely and ethically.

jobs.title: Personal Branding & CEO-Kommunikation Manager:in (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über uns Cléo Public Relations ist eine inhabergeführte PR-Agentur in Hamburg. Über 100 CEOs haben wir bereits in der Presse, auf Bühnen und in der Öffentlichkeit positioniert – für Start-ups, Scale-ups und VCs aus Food, Health, Interior, Beauty, Tech & Finance. Bei den PR Report Awards 2026 wurden wir in der Kategorie CEO-Kommunikation unter die Top 5 „Best in Class“ gewählt. Unsere Kund:innen verstehen uns als Sparringspartner auf Augenhöhe. Sie wollen sich als Thought Leader in ihrer Branche klar positionieren und ihre Expertise durch öffentliche Auftritte und Meinungsbildung sichtbar machen. Wir arbeiten nah an unseren Kund:innen, mit kurzen Wegen und viel Eigenverantwortung im Team. Die Rolle Wir suchen ab sofort eine Manager:in Personal Branding & CEO-Kommunikation (m/w/d) in Vollzeit in Hamburg. Du verantwortest Personal Branding und CEO-Kommunikation für Gründer:innen und Geschäftsführer:innen unserer Kund:innen – auf LinkedIn, in den Medien und auf Bühnen. Du bist Sparringspartner:in von Foundern, findest ihre Themen und ihre Stimme und sorgst dafür, dass sie sichtbar werden. Deine Aufgaben Du leitest Kick-off-Strategieworkshops, analysierst, wie Founder und CEOs heute wahrgenommen werden, vergleichst sie mit relevanten Wettbewerber:innen und entwickelst mit ihnen ihre Soll-Positionierung: Kernthemen, Tonalität, Kanäle, Formate. Du optimierst LinkedIn-Profile, schreibst Beiträge im Namen von Foundern nach einem gemeinsamen Style Guide, planst Redaktionskalender und übernimmst das Community Management. Du entwickelst Instagram-Strategien und Content-Ideen für Founder. Du konzipierst Fotoshootings und begleitest sie vor Ort. Du führst Interviews mit Foundern, um Themen, Haltungen und Geschichten herauszuarbeiten, die zu ihrer Positionierung und zur Unternehmensstory passen. Du platzierst sie in Medien, Podcasts und auf Panels – gemeinsam mit unserem PR-Team. Du vernetzt Founder über das Cléo-Netzwerk mit Journalist:innen, Meinungsführer:innen und Investor:innen und öffnest Türen zu ausgewählten Branchen-Events. Du bereitest sie auf Interviews, Vorträge und Videoformate vor (Briefings, Kernbotschaften) und organisierst bei Bedarf Medientrainings. Du wertest Reichweite und Resonanz aus und leitest daraus nächste Schritte ab. Du bist feste Sparringspartner:in von Foundern, mit regelmäßigen Abstimmungen, ehrlichem Feedback und Unterstützung in der Krisenkommunikation, und arbeitest eng mit den jeweiligen Account-Teams zusammen. Was du mitbringst 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung in PR, Corporate Communications, Content oder Journalismus – idealerweise mit Fokus auf Executive oder Founder Communications. Du schreibst sehr gut auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch und kannst dich in fremde Stimmen hineinversetzen. Du kennst LinkedIn als Plattform genau: Formate, Algorithmus, was funktioniert und was nicht. Du hast ein Gespür für Themen und Geschichten und erkennst, was eine Person relevant macht. Du trittst souverän gegenüber Gründer:innen und Geschäftsführer:innen auf und gibst auch kritisches Feedback. Du arbeitest strukturiert und behältst mehrere Kund:innen gleichzeitig im Blick. Gut zu haben: Netzwerk zu Redaktionen, Podcasts oder Veranstaltern. Was wir bieten Spannende Founder und Marken aus unterschiedlichen Branchen, von Startup bis Mittelstand. Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und direktem Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung. Raum, das Thema Personal Branding bei Cléo aktiv mitzugestalten. Ein Büro in Hamburg und Homeoffice nach Absprache. Gleitzeit, 30 Tage Urlaub, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Weiterbildung. Bewerbung Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, zwei bis drei Arbeitsproben (gern LinkedIn-Beiträge, die du für andere geschrieben hast) und sag uns in ein paar Sätzen, welche Founder-Persönlichkeit du gern positionieren würdest und warum. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Android Engineer- Hardware
jobs.description: Team description SumUp's Hardware Development team builds the physical products millions of small businesses rely on every day, and this role sits right at the start of a new chapter: moving our in-house hardware onto the Android platform for the first time. This isn't a typical Android device, it's a highly customised, security-first product built from scratch, which means the person joining will help define how the operating system, drivers, and secure processor come together rather than inheriting someone else's setup. The team works closely with hardware, software, and QA engineers across the bring-up process, so this role offers a rare chance to shape a product's foundations while working alongside experienced embedded and secure processor leads. Please note this role would require relocation to Berlin, Germany. What you'll do Support system bring-up for the new Android embedded platform, from bootloader through to kernel and framework Integrate and maintain kernel modules and drivers, including power management and connectivity components Contribute to build system integration across the platform Debug hardware and software issues at the protocol level and help resolve critical issues found during testing Carry out testing and validation to confirm the platform is stable and secure before release You'll be great for this role if… Experience developing embedded systems with a strong focus on Android OS, gained over several years in a professional setting Strong knowledge of the Android OS architecture, from bootloader (U-Boot, Little Kernel) and kernel through to framework and services Hands-on experience debugging hardware interfaces at protocol level, including I2C, SPI, UART, and SDIO Solid understanding of embedded security concepts such as Secure Boot, TrustZone (TEE), dm-verity, encryption, and hardware-backed key storage Comfort working with Qualcomm Snapdragon or MediaTek platforms, and expert-level C programming for embedded Linux environments Why you should join SumUp 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Identity Lifecycle
jobs.description: About the team: You'll join one of the teams within SumUp's Identity Lifecycle Mission, working on some of the most critical building blocks behind the merchant journey, from onboarding and identity verification to KYC/KYB, regulatory data collection, and managing customer identity throughout the entire lifecycle. Today, many of these capabilities live across different flows, legacy services, and tightly coupled integrations. We're on a journey to bring these pieces together into a more coherent, scalable platform, with shared data models, reusable services, and clear ownership boundaries. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you won't just be maintaining existing systems. You'll have the opportunity to shape how our identity platform evolves, modernise critical services, and help build foundations that can support new regulations, markets, and product requirements without reinventing the wheel every time. You'll be part of one dedicated team, but the challenges we tackle often cross team and domain boundaries. You'll work closely with Engineers, Product, Design, Compliance, Risk, and Operations, giving you the opportunity to influence solutions well beyond your own team. If you enjoy solving complex backend problems, working in a highly collaborative environment, improving reliability, and building scalable capabilities that enable other teams to move faster, this could be an exciting opportunity to make a real impact at SumUp. What you'll do: Design, build, and operate scalable backend services, APIs, event-driven workflows, and system integrations. Build reusable capabilities that power merchant onboarding, identity verification, and KYC/KYB regulatory data collection. Drive reliability and resilience across critical services through better observability, failure handling, incident response, and long-term risk reduction. Work primarily with Go, while maintaining and progressively modernising existing services written in Java. Evolve domain models and service boundaries while reducing legacy complexity, duplicated logic, and tightly coupled integrations, always with a pragmatic, incremental mindset. Own your work end-to-end, from technical design and implementation to rollout and production follow-up. Work across team and domain boundaries, turning ambiguous product and regulatory requirements into clear, scalable technical solutions. A strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take complex problems from definition through to production. Experience improving the reliability of business-critical systems and turning recurring incidents into lasting engineering improvements. Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to working across Engineering, Product, Compliance, Risk, and Operations. jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager, Regional Enterprise
jobs.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer. As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich . What you'll be doing In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth. Day-to-day in this role you'll: Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing. Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty. Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt. Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt's long-term business objectives. Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process. Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches. Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale. Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach. Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team. Our humble expectations You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers. You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature. You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides. You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams. You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact. You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail. You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions. You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English. What we offer This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch. You'll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business. You'll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact. Next steps If this sounds like an opportunity you'd be excited about, we'd love to hear from you. After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach. Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We'll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash . jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive DACH (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wir bei SoSafe haben das Ziel, der führende Anbieter für Human Risk Management Lösungen in Europa zu werden. Unsere preisgekrönte Awareness-Plattform unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, nachhaltige Verhaltensänderungen durch effektive, interaktive Trainings rund um Cyber-Sicherheit und Datenschutz zu erzielen. Cyberkriminalität kostet die Welt jährlich >$10 Billionen, mit steigenden Kosten um 15 % pro Jahr – werde Teil der Lösung und gestalte die Zukunft der Cybersicherheit aktiv mit! Als Mid-Market Account Executive (m/w/d) wirst du Teil eines dynamischen, ambitionierten und internationalen Teams von Account Executives, das auf Zusammenarbeit, täglichen Wissensaustausch und die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Vertriebsprozessen setzt. Erfolg treibt uns an – und mit unserer offenen, motivierenden Teamkultur macht das Erreichen von Zielen gleich doppelt so viel Freude! Gemeinsam mit dem Sales Development Representative (SDR) Team baust du täglich dein Kundennetzwerk aus und übertriffst deine Ziele. Du verstehst die Herausforderungen und Bedürfnisse deiner Kunden und weißt, wie du unser Cybersecurity-Angebot positionierst und eine Lösung präsentierst, auf die deine Kunden nicht verzichten können! Teamwork ist entscheidend – du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams wie Pre-Sales, Customer Success und Partner Managern zusammen, um ein reibungsloses und wirkungsvolles Kundenerlebnis zu gewährleisten. Deine Fähigkeit, Abschlüsse zu erzielen und neue Geschäftsfelder voranzutreiben, ist entscheidend für deinen Erfolg und dein Wachstum in dieser Rolle. So trägst du zum Erfolg bei: Akquise neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Mid-Market-Segment. Eigenverantwortliches Management des gesamten Sales-Zyklus – von der ersten Ansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss – mit dem Ziel, neue Kunden zu gewinnen und deine Vertriebsziele zu erreichen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit SDRs zur Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Leads und zur Sicherstellung einer stabilen Sales-Pipeline. Steuerung, Verhandlung und Abschluss von Cross- und Upselling-Möglichkeiten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Customer Success Managern. Aufbau und Pflege nachhaltiger Beziehungen zu Entscheidungsträgern potenzieller Kunden, um den Mehrwert der SoSafe-Cybersecurity-Lösungen überzeugend zu präsentieren. Durchführung von Online-Demos, Vor-Ort-Terminen und Events zur Präsentation unseres innovativen Produkts und zur Stärkung des Kundengeschäfts. Was dich auszeichnet: 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Closing-Rolle im SaaS-Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Fokus auf SMB- oder Mid-Market-Kunden. Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Ownership – du übernimmst die Initiative, behältst Ziele im Blick und bringst Deals mit Disziplin und Konsequenz zum Abschluss. Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit cross- funktionalen Teams. Proaktivität und Eigeninitiative mit der Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten. Anpassungsfähig und in der Lage, Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Start-up-Umfeld flexibel zu managen. Offen für Feedback und Bereitschaft, kontinuierlich zu lernen und dich weiterzuentwickeln. Erfahrung mit CRM-Tools (z. B. Salesforce, HubSpot), Prospecting-Software und LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Fließende Deutsch und Englisch- Kenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt. Standort: Köln/ deutschlandweit (Remote) - bei uns arbeitest du hauptsächlich remote und kommst für regelmäßige Teamtage nach Köln (z. B. monatlich). Was wir bieten*: Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 33 Tage Urlaub und zusätzliche finanzielle Unterstützung während der Elternzeit Well-being und finanzielle Unterstützung: Zugang zur Open-Up App, Mitarbeiterrabatte Verbindung & Gemeinschaft: Virtuelle Events, gemeinsame Teamaktivitäten und Möglichkeiten für lokale Treffen Und vieles mehr: Technische Ausstattung, Empfehlungsprämien, ein individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget, hundefreundliches Büro *Die oben genannten Vergünstigungen gelten für Vollzeitmitarbeiter und können je nach Standort leicht variieren. Dies ist nur eine Auswahl – mehr erfahren Sie im Verlauf des Bewerbungsprozesses. Über uns Wir bei SoSafe haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, die digitale Welt sicherer zu gestalten, indem wir den menschlichen Faktor in der Cybersicherheit in den Mittelpunkt stellen. Als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Security-Awareness-Scale-ups weltweit nutzen wir verhaltenswissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse und datengesteuertes Lernen, um Menschen effektiv gegen Cyber-Bedrohungen zu stärken. Unser Human Risk Management-Ansatz unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, ihre Mitarbeiter*innen zum wirkungsvollsten Schutzschild gegen Sicherheitsrisiken zu entwickeln. Mit der Unterstützung führender VCs wie Highland Europe und Global Founders Capital expandieren wir weltweit in rasantem Tempo. Wir suchen Teamplayer, die sinnvolle Veränderungen im Bereich Cybersicherheit vorantreiben, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen wollen. Wenn du in einem lebendigen, zielorientierten Umfeld aufblühst, das Innovation, Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit großschreibt – dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: Munich strongly preferred, remote from rest of Germany, Austria or the UK also ok for us. C2 German language is required. At Secfix, we’re at the forefront of automating security compliance in Europe. We help companies get and stay ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, and SOC 2 fast and easy and reduce hundreds of hours of manual work. Secfix is run by a 100% remote team, with an office in Munich and team members across Europe. We’re a high-performing team looking for passionate, execution-focused, owners to help us automate security and compliance for modern companies and become the European compliance automation leader. jobs.description: About the Role Our flight-control system is already flying Skyron400. Now we want to make it faster, sharper and more capable. As our Senior Flight Control & State Estimation Engineer, you will take technical ownership of the control and estimation capabilities that determine how precisely our interceptor estimates its state, how quickly it reacts and how aggressively it can operate without compromising stability or robustness. From advanced estimation and control algorithms to embedded Rust optimization and flight-test analysis, you will set technical direction, make decisions based on real flight data and drive measurable improvements in aircraft performance. What is your Day to Day Mission: Take technical ownership of flight-control and state-estimation architecture, priorities and validation. Improve state estimation using Kalman filters, IIM, particle filters and model based approaches. Fuse IMU, radar, camera and ToF data into robust vehicle and target-state estimates. Increase the accuracy of velocity and position estimation in GPS-denied environments. Optimize sensor filtering, synchronization, outlier rejection and latency compensation. Own the design, implementation and tuning of flight-control algorithms for maximum agility, precision and stability. Identify real flight dynamics from recorded data and use them to improve models, estimators and controllers. Improve sensor and vehicle models used in simulation, SIL and HIL environments. Profile and optimize flight-critical Rust code for deterministic execution and minimum latency. Plan and lead flight-test analysis, identify performance limits and turn every flight into the next improvement. What You Bring to the Team This is a senior flight-control role. We are looking for deep expertise in flight-control design and tuning, together with a strong understanding of how control, state estimation, sensing and embedded implementation interact as one complete system. At least four years of professional experience developing and tuning flight-control systems, including implementation and testing on real systems. Experience with drones or other UAVs is strongly preferred. Exceptional candidates coming directly from university may be considered only if they can demonstrate at least three years of substantial hands-on flight-control experience through projects, research programs, student teams or comparable work, including implementation and testing on real systems. Deep foundations in control theory, state estimation, sensor fusion and flight dynamics. Hands-on experience with Kalman filters, nonlinear estimation or probabilistic filtering. A proven track record of designing, tuning and validating controllers for highly dynamic systems. Strong implementation skills in Rust, C++ or another systems programming language. A strong understanding of real-time execution, numerical stability, sensor timing and latency. Hands-on experience with simulation, system identification, flight-log analysis and flight testing. The drive to challenge existing performance limits, test ideas quickly and keep iterating until the data proves the improvement. Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. Why Join Quantum-Systems? The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in the defense, security, and public sectors. Prendre en charge la dimension géographique · Industrialiser les traitements géospatiaux : géocodage, appariement d'adresses, jointures spatiales, agrégations par mailles administratives, gestion des projections et des référentiels. · Être le point de contact de l'équipe sur les référentiels géographiques et leurs évolutions. Assumer un rôle de leadership technique · Être garant·e de la cohérence technique des solutions produites par l'équipe. · Animer les choix d'architecture, arbitrer et documenter les décisions. · Accompagner et faire monter en compétences les autres membres de l'équipe (revues de code, pair programming). Stack technique · Environnement : Databricks · Langages : Python, SQL · Framework : Spark · Databases : ElasticSearch, Postgres · DevOps : Github Action (CI/CD), Docker · Monitoring : Grafana, Prometheus La rémunération annuelle fixe sur ce poste sera entre 55K€ et 60K€ en fonction du profil que nous recruterons. Clarté et transparence dans la communication Leadership, référent au sein d'une équipe. Expérience : 5 ans et plus d'expérience en data engineering, sur des pipelines en production. Très bonne maîtrise de Python et de SQL. Très bonne maitrise du traitement de données distribué : Spark (PySpark). Solide expérience de développement de pipelines de données sur Databricks Pratique des standards d'ingénierie logicielle : Git, CI/CD, tests automatisés, revue de code, performance. Compréhension des systèmes de projection (WGS84, Lambert 93) et des formats géospatiaux (GeoJSON, Shapefile, WFS etc). Connaissance de PostGis (SQL Spatial) et QGIS. We are looking for a Staff System Architect to be fully dedicated to the SNSPD product line, with a strong focus on leading the technical architecture and roadmap for our next-generation rack-mountable SNSPD (Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detector) platform. This role is critical to defining and guiding the technical evolution of our cutting-edge cryogenic photon detection systems, ensuring architectural coherence across hardware, software, and integration domains while supporting our product vision and market requirements.

This includes defining system structure, interfaces, and key architectural decisions, as well as driving critical trade-offs across performance, cost, scalability, and integration. You will also align engineering execution with the architectural vision, guiding system integration and resolving complex cross-domain design challenges.

In addition, you will play a key role in shaping the technology roadmap and driving the evolution of the platform, continuously evaluating and introducing new technologies where relevant to maintain innovation and competitiveness.

This is a hands-on development role at the heart of applied cryptography, working with some of the most experienced cryptographic engineers in the field.

Responsibilities:

You will implement and maintain reference and bit-accurate models of ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS in C/C++/Rust and Python, develop constant-time software implementations of cryptographic functions, and build out the known-answer-test and test-vector tooling (NIST ACVP) used for verification and CAVP certification. You will contribute to the decomposition of algorithms into hardware-friendly building blocks (Keccak, NTT and polynomial arithmetic, samplers, encode/decode), support RTL and firmware engineers with algorithm questions and debugging, and help evaluate third-party cryptographic libraries, working under the guidance of our senior cryptography engineers.

You have solid understanding of modern cryptographic primitives and ideally first exposure to post-quantum schemes (lattice-based or hash-based) and their underlying mathematics.

You care about correctness and write well-tested, readable code; you understand what constant-time implementation means and why it matters. Familiarity with NIST test-vector formats, CAVP/ACVP or certification-oriented development is a plus. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

  • Hands-on developer of cryptographic or security-critical software with strong C/C++/Rust skills
  • Solid cryptographic foundations with the ambition to build deep post-quantum expertise

Preferred Qualifications:

You want to grow into a world-class applied cryptographer by working on real products with demanding correctness and security requirements, and you enjoy the discipline of code that must be provably right.

  • A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts

Real-world quantum-safe systems are hybrid systems: classical and post-quantum algorithms operating side by side, with careful key management, crypto agility and migration paths. The role demands fluency on both sides of the transition: deep classical mastery combined with a solid working command of the post-quantum algorithms and standards the products are built around.

You will own the architecture and implementation strategy of the classical cryptographic functions of the product line: symmetric ciphers and modes (AES/GCM and beyond), hash functions (SHA-2/SHA-3, HMAC/KDF constructions), RSA/ECC offload, and true random number generation and entropy architecture (SP 800-90A/B/C).   • Define crypto-agility and migration mechanisms that let customers move to quantum-safe deployments without breaking existing infrastructure

We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s or PhD in Cryptography, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field and at least twelve years of experience implementing and architecting classical cryptography in real products, in hardware, software or both. You have deep command of symmetric and asymmetric primitives, modes of operation, key management and entropy generation, and you have taken cryptographic subsystems through FIPS 140-3 or Common Criteria evaluation. You understand the practical constraints of deployed security infrastructure (HSMs, PKI, TLS and IPsec ecosystems) and how hybrid classical/post-quantum schemes are standardised and deployed in practice. You write precise specifications, guide implementers effectively, and make sound architecture decisions under real-world interoperability constraints.   • Proven architect of classical cryptographic subsystems with certification experience (FIPS 140-3, CAVP, Common Criteria)

The Role:

We are looking for a Distinguished Leader to provide the overall technical leadership for our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration programme, part of our quantum-safe product portfolio targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. As the most senior technical authority of the programme, you will own the end-to-end architecture, from cryptographic algorithm and standards strategy to an FPGA-based product architecture with a clear path to ASIC, and you will set the technical direction across the cryptography, hardware, software and security disciplines involved. This is a rare opportunity to shape a strategic security product line at one of the few companies where quantum-safe security is the core business.

Responsibilities:

You will define the system architecture and microarchitecture of a multi-algorithm PQC accelerator implementing ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS: hardware/firmware partitioning, throughput and lane sizing derived from real customer traffic models, and a stable core-interface specification that lets cryptographic cores evolve behind a frozen contract. You will own the algorithm and standards strategy (NIST FIPS 203/204/205, CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3), drive make/buy and IP-licensing decisions, and shape the security and certification architecture together with our side-channel and compliance specialists. You will set the technical roadmap, arbitrate the hardest cross-domain design decisions, mentor the senior engineers who own each domain, and represent the programme externally with customers, standards bodies, certification laboratories and executive stakeholders.

  • Act as the programme’s most senior technical authority: set direction across disciplines, mentor senior engineers, and represent the technology with customers, standards bodies and executives

Requirements:

We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Cryptography or a related field and fifteen or more years of experience architecting complex digital security hardware, including deep, hands-on exposure to cryptographic implementation with genuine post-quantum depth. You are a recognised authority in your field, evidenced by shipped market-defining security products, contributions to standards, publications or patents, and you have taken accelerators, secure elements or HSM-class systems from specification to production more than once.

You make well-reasoned build/buy/partner decisions under uncertainty and raise the technical bar of everyone around you. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

  • Distinguished-level technical leadership: sets direction across domains, mentors senior specialists, and represents the company externally

You thrive on ambiguity and ownership, turning a strategic mandate into an architecture, a plan and a working product. jobs.title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Founding Full-Stack Engineer Build the software systems around planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape a greenfield product spanning Python backend, data, visualization, frontend, infrastructure, and integration with our optimization core. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews. The opportunity Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for. We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one. About us planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next. What you'll own The product layer: Turn complex optimization systems into software planners can actually use. Backend and data: Build Python services, APIs, data models, and pipelines around our optimization engine. Interfaces and visualization: Make schedules, bottlenecks, dependencies, and alternative decisions understandable and interactive. Integration: Connect native C++ components, factory data, and product workflows into one coherent system. Infrastructure: Own CI/CD, containers, deployment, observability, and the supporting services we need. The team: Grow into leading software engineering at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, and setting direction. You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement. How we build Our product sits at the boundary between algorithms, software systems, and real industrial operations. We care about building systems that are easy to integrate, responsive, understandable, and maintainable as both the product and the underlying algorithms evolve. We use GenAI extensively to prototype, implement, and explore alternatives. But generating code is not the hard part. The value lies in designing the right system, choosing good abstractions, validating behavior, and knowing what is worth building. There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins. What you'll bring Strong Python and backend engineering. You are comfortable designing APIs, services, libraries, and maintainable system boundaries. Full-stack product skills. You can work with TypeScript, React, or similar technologies and build interfaces that make complex systems understandable. Data and integration. You can design data models and pipelines, work with databases, and connect messy external systems to clean internal interfaces. Systems thinking. You think beyond individual services or screens: how data, algorithms, product, and infrastructure fit together. Infrastructure fundamentals. You are comfortable with Docker, CI/CD, deployment, observability, and operating services. Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec. Fluent English. German and experience in manufacturing or industrial planning are useful but not required. Bonus: C++ and native Python bindings such as pybind11 or nanobind; data visualization; optimization, scheduling, simulation, or other algorithmic systems; enterprise integrations such as ERP / SAP. What you'll get Real ownership: shape the product architecture from line one, working directly with our CTO. A clear growth path into leading the software engineering team. A real problem worth solving. We equip you with the hardware, compute, and tools you work best with. Remote-first or from our Munich office, with regular in-person workshops. Competitive pay + VSOP. The process (fast, real conversations, no puzzles) Send your CV. Talk with our CTO about your work and how you approach hard problems. Meet our CEO and selected investors. jobs.description: Founding Optimization Engineer Build the algorithmic core of planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape the optimization architecture on a greenfield: custom algorithms, heuristics, OR and simulation, fast C++ with Python on top. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews. The opportunity Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for. We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one. About us planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next. What you'll own The algorithmic core: Design how planqor.ai represents, propagates and optimizes schedules, resources and constraints, and how it repairs them when disruptions hit. Performance: Make it fast. Profile and optimize the C++ core and expose it cleanly. Evidence: Build the benchmarks, instances and experiments that show what actually works and where it fails. The path to production: Work with our systems engineer to turn algorithms into decisions planners trust. The team: Grow into leading optimization at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, setting direction. You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement. How we build Our goal is not to build the most impressive optimization algorithm on paper. It is to build decision systems that remain useful when the real world changes. A strong solution that can be updated, repaired and explained quickly beats closing the last optimality gap on a static model. So we are neither a solver wrapper nor a research lab. We use whatever works (MIP, CP, heuristics, local search, simulation, learning or something purpose-built) and let the evidence decide. Generative AI makes this loop dramatically faster. We use it to implement ideas, explore alternatives and evolve algorithms against our benchmarks. Empirical engineering judgment. You design experiments, challenge assumptions, measure performance, and abandon approaches when the evidence says they are wrong. Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec. Fluent English. jobs.title: Senior Facility Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Infos zur Position

Als Senior Facility Manager (m/w/d) arbeitest du vornehmlich an unserem Büro in München und bist wichtiger Teil unseres kleinen aber effizienten Inhouse Facility Management Teams. Bei der Vielfalt an täglichen Themen und Betreuung mehrerer Agile Robots Gebäude ist dir Abwechslung garantiert.

Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben

  • Betreuung mehrerer Agile Robots Gebäude in München und gelegentliche Unterstützung in der Gebäudebetreuung an unseren Standorten in Kaufbeuren und Augsburg
  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung, dass im Gebäude alles funktional ist und gebäudetechnisch reibungslos abläuft
  • Dabei kümmerst du dich um verschiedenste Kleinreparaturen im Gebäude oder an Möbeln
  • Auf- und Abbau von Möbeln fällt genauso in deinen Aufgabenbereich wie der Auf- und Abbau von Events
  • Du kümmerst dich um die Warenannahme sowie Lagerhaltung des Office Management (Getränke, Papier, Möbel, Materialien etc.)
  • Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Dienstleister und interne Mitarbeitenden in Hausmeisterfragen
  • Abhängig von den anfallenden Aufgaben besteht eine gewisse Flexibilität bei der Arbeitszeitgestaltung, diese Rolle umfasst keine Schichtarbeit & keinen Bereitschaftsdienst

Passend zum Profil

  • Du bringst ein gutes technisches Verständnis und handwerkliches Geschick mit, das du idealerweise bereits im Berufskontext unter Beweis stellen konntest
  • Eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung in einem handwerklichen oder technischen Beruf ist von Vorteil
  • Organisationsfähigkeit und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Problemlösungskompetenz, Belastbarkeit
  • Teamfähigkeit und selbstständiges Arbeiten
  • Du verstehst dich als "Feel-Good Manager" auf gebäudetechnischer Ebene
  • Die Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen internen Abteilungen und externen Dienstleistern macht dir Spaß
  • Fließende Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse, idealerweise bringst du Kenntnisse in beiden Sprachen mit
  • Führerschein Klasse B
  • Bereitschaft regelmäßig innerhalb von München zwischen den Gebäuden und gelegentlich nach Kaufbeuren/ Augsburg zu pendeln

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient.

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry.

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.
