jobs.title: Optical Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Focused Energy is a fusion energy startup with the goal of generating unlimited clean energy to responsibly meet future global demand. With the use and commercialization of laser-induced inertial fusion, a clean and highly efficient power generation technology is coming within reach, suitable to ensure a secure and scalable future energy supply. We are seeking a skilled and driven Optical Engineer to design, analyze, and help realize the next generation of high-energy and high-average-power laser systems that underpin Focused Energy’s fusion program. In this role, you will be responsible for turning advanced optical concepts into robust, manufacturable, and operable experimental and production laser systems. Your work will directly enable the performance, stability, and scalability of our fusion laser infrastructure — ensuring that optical designs meet extreme power, precision, and reliability requirements while remaining practical to build, integrate, and operate. What you’ll do Optical System Design: Design, model, and optimize complex optical systems for high-energy and high-average-power laser applications, balancing performance, robustness, and manufacturability. Simulation & Analysis: Use advanced optical modeling tools (e.g., Zemax / OpticStudio) to perform ray tracing, tolerance analysis, stray light analysis, and wavefront propagation to predict and validate system behavior. Performance Specification: Define detailed optical specifications including component selection, materials, coatings, and tolerances to meet demanding power, fluence, and stability requirements. Integration & Commissioning: Partner closely with technicians, laser engineers, and mechanical and electrical teams during assembly, alignment, testing, and commissioning of optical systems, troubleshooting issues as they arise. System Optimization: Identify and resolve performance limitations related to aberrations, thermal effects, alignment sensitivity, and stray light to ensure stable, repeatable operation at high power. Documentation & Communication: Produce high-quality technical documentation, analyses, and design reviews to support internal development, knowledge sharing, and external collaboration. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work across disciplines to ensure optical designs integrate cleanly into larger laser, mechanical, electrical, vacuum, and control system architectures. Who you are A degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with professional experience designing and analyzing optical systems for laser or photonics applications. Deep hands-on experience with Zemax (OpticStudio) or comparable optical design and simulation tools, including tolerance and stray light analysis. Strong understanding of classical optics, Gaussian beam propagation, laser physics, and material behavior under high-intensity or high-fluence conditions. Comfortable moving between modeling and the lab — supporting alignment, testing, debugging, and iteration of real optical hardware. You bring rigor to your designs, anticipate failure modes, and care deeply about accuracy, documentation, and long-term reliability. You can work effectively with scientists, engineers, and technicians and communicate complex optical concepts clearly across disciplines. Preferred: Experience with MATLAB, Python, or similar tools for analysis, modeling, or automation of design workflows. Preferred: Familiarity with cleanroom practices, vacuum-compatible optical design, large-aperture optics, or advanced components such as adaptive or deformable optics. Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits. jobs.title: Working Student, Export Control/ International Trade Compliance (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

In a dynamic international trade environment, compliance is the key to sustainable success. As a Working Student (m/f/d) in Export Control/ International Trade Compliance, you will actively support our International Trade Compliance team in the operational implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of our global export control processes. You will apply your theoretical knowledge directly to complex cases involving German, European, and US export regulations (EAR/ITAR).
In this role, your work is the vanguard of our integrity. By rigorously enforcing export controls, managing licenses, and conducting thorough due diligence, you ensure that our advanced satellite technologies and sensitive data do not fall into the wrong hands. Your daily vigilance directly upholds Planet’s core values of global transparency, ethical business practices, and global security—allowing us to continue democratizing access to space while remaining a trusted, responsible partner on the global stage.

Because compliance touches every aspect of our global operations, this role acts as a central hub. On a day-to-day basis, you will collaborate closely with: Product Managers & Engineering, Sales & Go-to-Market Teams, Logistics & Supply Chain, Purchasing/ Procurement, Internal IT & Operations, Physical Security & Lab Management.

This is a temporary, part-time position and is expected to last 12 months. This hybrid position will require you to work from our Berlin office approx. 2 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Classification & Screening: Assist in determining and assigning export control classification numbers (ECCN, national list numbers) as well as conducting systemic sanction list screenings, with Product Manager.
  • Licensing Processes: Conduct preliminary checks of licensing requirements (BAFA, EU regulations) and US re-export regulations (EAR / ITAR) and support with preparation of license applications and license management, as needed.
  • Documentation: Ensure transparent and audit-proof documentation of decision-making processes and audit trails.
  • Contract Review: Review and evaluate export control-relevant clauses in customer and supplier agreements.
  • Legal Monitoring: Monitor legal changes in national and international foreign trade law and prepare their implications for day-to-day business operations.
  • Processes & IT: Support process modeling, identify optimization potential, and coordinate interfaces with internal IT systems (e.g., ERP/NetSuite/Oracle).
  • Communication: Act as a central link and point of contact for internal departments such as Sales, Purchasing, Logistics, and IT.
  • AccessControls Lab/ Visitor Requests: Evaluate and approve visitor requests and laboratory access permissions to mitigate deemed export risks, ensuring compliance with physical security protocols and technology transfer controls in sensitive areas.
  • Review international Shipments: Perform export compliance reviews and release holds on international outbound shipments, verifying end-use, licensing coverage, and documentation prior to dispatch.
  • Anti-Bribery/KYC/DueDiligence: Conduct risk-based third-party due diligence and Know-Your-Customer (KYC) assessments on business partners, evaluating red flags and enforcing adherence to anti-bribery and anti-corruption (ABAC) policies.

What You Bring:

  • Actively enrolled in an accredited university program in Business Law (LL.B.), International Trade, Logistics/Supply Chain Management with a focus on Customs, or a comparable degree program.
  • Fluent written and spoken German and English (essential for navigating legal references).
  • Interest in foreign trade issues, ideally paired with initial exposure to EU Dual Use Regulation or US export control regulations like Export Administration Regulation (EAR)/ International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR).
  • Detail-oriented with solid analytical capabilities; equipped with the ability to pragmatically translate complex legal texts into actionable corporate workflows.
  • Proficiency in Google Office Application; familiarity with ERP systems or process modeling tools is an advantage.

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Export Control Requirements:

Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by German, EU, or U.S. authorities.

jobs.city: Berlin; Cologne; Frankfurt am Main; Hamburg; Munich

jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager

At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.

As our Retail business continues to grow, we’re looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You’ll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich .

What you’ll be doing

In this role, you’ll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You’ll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt’s selection, coverage and long-term growth.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.
  • Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners’ businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt’s long-term business objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.
  • Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.
  • Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.
  • Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.
  • Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.

Our humble expectations

  • You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.
  • You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.
  • You’re an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.
  • You’re comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.
  • You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.
  • You’re highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • You’re comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.
  • You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English.

What we offer

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt’s Retail growth. You’ll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.

You’ll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.

You’ll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.

Next steps

If this sounds like an opportunity you’d be excited about, we’d love to hear from you.

After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach.

Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We’ll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.title: Lead Performance Marketing & User Acquisition (m/f/d)
jobs.description: We are Whow Games – and YOU could be part of it! At WHOW Games, we develop, publish and market social casino games for web and mobile that are played by millions of people. We’re an international team of more than 50 people, and our Marketing team works closely with Product, CRM and Business Intelligence. As Lead Performance Marketing & User Acquisition , you’ll lead and develop our Performance Marketing team. You’ll set a clear direction, agree on goals together and give people the support and autonomy to take ownership and grow. You’ll lead by example when it’s time to test a new idea, make a difficult call or learn from a setback. You’ll also own our UA strategy and budget across web and mobile, working with your team to grow our core markets profitably and identify which new markets are worth entering. Tasks Lead and develop the team. Set clear goals, delegate responsibility and give regular feedback. Get to know each team member’s strengths, support their development and coach them to make decisions independently. Give the team direction and keep people motivated. Help team members see how their work contributes to the business and recognise their progress. When priorities shift or campaigns underperform, clarify what matters most, remove obstacles and agree on next steps together. Own UA strategy and budget. Set acquisition goals for web and mobile and allocate spend across platforms, channels and markets based on cohort ROAS, payback and lifetime value (LTV). Stay hands-on with key campaigns and experiments. Grow core markets and test new countries. Work with your team to reach new audiences and find promising channels. Define success criteria for new markets, lead the tests and recommend where further investment makes sense. Manage channels and partners. Own the mix across Google, Meta, Apple Search Ads, ad networks, programmatic, TikTok and affiliates. Negotiate directly with agencies and partners and decide which work your team handles in-house. Improve testing and measurement. Prioritise experiments for ad creatives, app store listings and landing pages with Design and Content. Work with BI and technical teams to improve tracking, attribution and reporting so that results inform campaign and budget decisions. Represent the team across the business. Align acquisition goals with Product, CRM and BI so we bring in more players who stay active over time. Present your team’s results to management and explain where you recommend increasing, reducing or reallocating spend. Requirements At least eight years of experience in performance marketing or user acquisition , with a substantial part of that time in gaming or a similarly data-driven B2C environment. Experience leading a marketing, growth or UA team. You can share concrete examples of how you’ve set goals, delegated responsibility and helped people develop. jobs.title: Customer Success & Operations Coordinator - 6 Month Contract
jobs.description:
Pourquoi Verifone

Depuis plus de 40 ans, Verifone s'est imposé comme un leader incontesté de l'industrie des technologies de paiement électronique. Verifone est l'une des marques de référence en matière de solutions de paiement électronique et l'un des plus grands fournisseurs de systèmes de paiement électronique au monde.

Verifone offre un environnement de travail diversifié, dynamique et rythmé, dans lequel les collaborateurs sont orientés résultats et disposent d'opportunités pour se dépasser. Nous sommes fiers de travailler avec les principaux commerçants, enseignes, banques et partenaires tiers afin de concevoir et de déployer des solutions de paiement innovantes à travers le monde. Nous visons l'excellence dans nos produits et nos services, et nous sommes obsédés par la satisfaction de nos clients. Partout dans le monde, les collaborateurs de Verifone font avancer l'industrie du paiement grâce à leur expérience, leur sens de l'innovation et leur esprit ambitieux. Qu'il s'agisse de développer la prochaine plateforme de systèmes de paiement sécurisés ou de chercher de nouvelles façons d'amener le paiement électronique vers de nouveaux marchés, l'équipe de Verifone se consacre à la réussite de ses clients, de ses partenaires et de ses investisseurs. C'est cette passion pour l'innovation qui anime chacun de nos collaborateurs dans sa réussite personnelle et professionnelle.

Verifone est fière de sa culture du travail en présentiel, car nous sommes convaincus que la proximité physique de nos collègues apporte d'immenses bénéfices pour le développement des carrières et les résultats de l'entreprise. Nous autorisons actuellement un mode de travail hybride, mais nous réexaminons régulièrement notre politique de présence.

À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Coordinateur(trice) Customer Success & Opérations très organisé(e), proactif(ve) et orienté(e) service, à recruter dans un premier temps dans le cadre d'un contrat de 6 mois.

Il s'agit d'une excellente opportunité de rejoindre une équipe centrée sur le client, où vous jouerez un rôle central pour garantir la réussite de projets et de relations clients stratégiques. Vous travaillerez de manière transverse, en collaboration avec les équipes Opérations, Finance, Technique et avec des partenaires externes, afin de faire avancer les projets, de résoudre les difficultés et d'offrir une expérience client exceptionnelle.

Aucune journée ne se ressemble. De la coordination des initiatives clients et du suivi des jalons de projet jusqu'au soutien en matière de reporting, de facturation et d'amélioration opérationnelle, vous serez exposé(e) à un large éventail d'activités et développerez une solide compréhension du fonctionnement d'une organisation dynamique, tournée vers le client.

Ce poste vous offre la possibilité de bâtir des relations durables avec les clients, de prendre en charge des processus importants et d'avoir un impact visible sur la satisfaction client et la performance de l'entreprise. Il est idéal pour une personne qui aime l'organisation, la résolution de problèmes et le travail avec des interlocuteurs variés, tout en développant des compétences précieuses en customer success, en opérations et en coordination de projet.

Principales Responsabilités

Support opérationnel quotidien et demandes clients

  • Assurer le suivi opérationnel des projets clients : calendrier, jalons, livrables, points d'avancement
  • Être l'interlocuteur(trice) quotidien(ne) des clients attribués : demandes, escalades, suivi des engagements
  • Coordonner les équipes internes et externes (Opérations, support, technique, finance, partenaires)
  • Suivre les commandes, les contrats et la facturation associée, et signaler les écarts
  • Produire des rapports et des tableaux de bord (avancement, KPI, SLA)
  • Documenter les processus et tenir à jour les outils de suivi (CRM, tickets, Excel)

Support à la facturation

  • Contribuer à la préparation et à la validation des factures clients.
  • Extraire et tenir à jour les données de facturation à partir des systèmes internes.
  • Mettre à jour et rapprocher les enregistrements de facturation et les tableaux de suivi.
  • Participer à la résolution des écarts de facturation, sous la supervision de l'équipe.
  • Apporter un soutien administratif aux activités de facturation client.

Assistance aux réunions et administrative

  • Contribuer à la préparation des supports, de la documentation et des présentations destinés aux réunions clients.
  • Coordonner la planification des réunions et veiller à ce que les informations utiles soient transmises aux participants.
  • Préparer et diffuser les comptes rendus de réunion lorsque nécessaire.
  • Tenir à jour les tableaux de suivi des actions afin de garantir le suivi dans les délais des engagements pris.
  • Soutenir la planification et la coordination des ateliers clients et des revues opérationnelles.

Compétences et expérience requises

  • Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans un poste en contact avec la clientèle, en opérations, en coordination de projet ou en support administratif.
  • Très bonne organisation et grand souci du détail, capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités et flux de travail simultanément tout en assurant la responsabilité des activités de suivi courantes.
  • Esprit d'équipe, à l'aise dans un environnement transverse, capable d'établir des relations de travail efficaces avec des interlocuteurs variés.
  • Réactivité et adaptabilité, avec la capacité de gérer des priorités concurrentes et de rester serein(e) dans un environnement dynamique.
  • Sens du client, excellentes compétences de communication et capacité à gérer avec professionnalisme les demandes, les attentes et les escalades.
  • Solides compétences en coordination de projet, notamment en planification, suivi des jalons, identification des risques, priorisation et rigueur dans le suivi jusqu'à l'aboutissement.
  • Maîtrise de Microsoft Office, de Microsoft Teams, des plateformes CRM, des outils de ticketing et des outils d'IA tels que Claude.
  • Maîtrise professionnelle de l'anglais écrit et oral.

Notre engagement

Verifone s'engage à créer un environnement diversifié et est fière d'être un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances. Toutes les candidatures qualifiées seront examinées sans distinction de race, de couleur, de religion, de sexe, d'identité ou d'expression de genre, d'orientation sexuelle, d'origine nationale, de caractéristiques génétiques, de handicap, d'âge ou de statut d'ancien combattant. Verifone s'engage également à respecter toutes les pratiques d'emploi équitables relatives à la nationalité et au statut d'immigration.

jobs.title: Supply Data Analyst
jobs.description: Location: Any MSF office* Contract: 100% Duration: 12 months Starting date: 04th of January 2027 Deadline to apply: 01st of December 2026 Compensation and Benefits: MSF practice is to offer the compensation and benefits package in line with the MSF entity offering the contract *By default, the successful candidate will be offered a contract in the MSF office, able to issue a contract, of their country of residence at the time of application. If no MSF office exists in their country of residence, the successful candidate will be expected to relocate to a country where an MSF office can issue a contract, provided the local legislation allows for that. At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics. MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. The successful candidate will be expected to comply with the organisation’s safeguarding policies and standards of professional behaviour. We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process. MSF International Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested. I. CONTEXT MSF consists of 6 Operational Centres (OCs) and 3 European Supply Centres (ESCs). In the supply domain there is a joint Supply Tansformational Topics Roadmap composed by several inter-OC and inter-ESC projects, and their number is growing due to the need to increase cooperation between MSF entities while improving the quality of MSF's supply chain. The capacity to measure performance and analyse data across different entities is therefore essential and is contributing to MSF ambitions on interoperability and climate. The role of the International Office is to foster cooperation and coordination between MSF entities. The Supply Data Analyst will therefore act as a facilitator between the OCs and ESCs: bringing their representatives together, helping them build shared approaches on supply data and performance, and turning these agreements into concrete deliverables. The Global Supply Data & Analytics (GSDA) team (previously SCPM) has been actively working to build the analytical and data foundations needed to support a global approach to supply chain performance management, and to contribute to the governance of supply data across entities. The team is led by the Supply Chain Analytics Manager and includes one Data Analysts and one data governance specialist; the Supply Data Analyst will join it as an additional analyst. Reporting hierarchically and functionally to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager, the Supply Data Analyst will: collaborate closely with the supply chain professionals responsible for BI and performance management within the 6 OCs and 3 ESCs; work in close link with the ShARP (Shared Analytics and Reporting Project) team in SITS (Shared IT Services); on the existing UniField intersection reports; work alongside the GSDA team and the IO Supply team on projects related to supply chain data analytics; and interact with stakeholders across MSF, including finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics and operations teams. II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB The Supply Data Analyst supports supply chain performance analysis and decision making across MSF by delivering reliable data, KPIs, reports and actionable recommendations. The position also fosters cooperation between the OCs and ESCs around shared supply data, turning agreements into concrete deliverables. Within GSDA, the Supply Data Analyst will support the growing need for data management, reporting and analytics from the supply chain teams, including the monitoring of KPIs and the analysis of data coming from MSF information systems (such as UniField, Isystock or Akiba). III. ACCOUNTABILITIES The Supply Data Analyst is accountable for the following expected results and the activities deployed to achieve them. 1. UniField intersection reports are reliable, relevant and meet the needs of the OCs a. Take over the existing UniField intersection reports in close link with the ShARP team and improve them (reliability, relevance, usability) based on users' feedback and identified gaps b. Collect the reporting needs of each OC and consolidate them into a clear, prioritised set of requirements c. Design and deliver new intersection reports in coordination with the ShARP team, with validation from the OC representatives 2. Supply data is available and of reliable quality for analysis a. Extract, clean and consolidate supply data from UniField and other information systems b. Check data consistency and quality, and report anomalies to the relevant teams c. Document data sources, definitions and calculation methods 3. KPIs and reporting solutions support decision making a. Calculate and update a set of KPIs on a regular basis, in coordination with the teams concerned b. Build and maintain ad hoc data reporting solutions (Power BI) providing visuals that accurately summarise supply chain activities while providing actionable insights c. Support the teams in the definition of additional KPIs as needs arise 4. Stakeholders receive relevant data analysis and actionable recommendations a. Support stakeholders on supply data analysis b. Respond to ad hoc data and analysis requests using supply data from different stakeholders (supply, finance, medical…) c. Present analysis results and recommendations in a clear way to non-technical audiences 5. Cooperation between the OCs and ESCs on supply data produces concrete deliverables a. Convene and facilitate working groups and meetings with representatives of each OC and ESC, from preparation (agenda, pre-alignment of positions) to follow-up (minutes, actions, deadlines) b. Lead discussions between entities with different needs and practices, and build compromises and consensus on shared definitions, KPIs and ways of working c. Turn agreements into concrete deliverables (e.g., shared KPI definitions, dashboards, documentation) and follow their delivery 6. Data-related tools and processes improve continuously and stakeholders are kept informed a. Contribute to the improvement of data-related tools and processes within the team b. Proactively identify data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and propose solutions autonomously c. Manage stakeholders and expectations: identify their needs, keep them informed, and escalate blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY Challenges and decisions that the job faces to achieve the accountabilities: Autonomy to think and act: works with limited supervision; takes initiative, prioritises and drives work to completion, proactively identifies data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and escalates blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed. Complexity of the environment: works across 6 OCs and 3 ESCs with different needs, practices and information systems (UniField, Isystock, Akiba); builds compromises on shared definitions and KPIs, handles multiple priorities at once, and interacts with technical and non-technical stakeholders (finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics, operations) in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment. SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others. Education Bachelor's level or above in data analytics, statistics, business management, supply chain or a related field, or a combination of relevant education and professional experience (essential) Experience Minimum of 2 years of experience as Data Analyst (essential) Direct work experience involving significant data management (essential) Experience in facilitating meetings or working groups involving multiple stakeholders and in delivering concrete outputs from them (essential) Supply chain, logistics and Finance experience in NGO's operational settings (desirable) Previous work experience with UniField, MSF's main ERP software (desirable) Skills Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills: ability to bring together representatives of different entities, lead effective meetings, negotiate compromises and deliver concrete outcomes Strong analytical skills Good organisational skills, ability to handle multiple priorities at one time Autonomous and proactive: ability to take initiative, prioritise and drive work to completion with limited supervision Good level skills in Excel, Power BI and database management Ability to work in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment Drive for change, improvement and innovation Languages Fluent spoken and written English (essential) Good command of French (strongly desirable) Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. jobs.title: Chief Business Officer (gn) @ Clean Data Centres Venture, France (hybrid)
jobs.description: This is an Atlantic porfolio company. The opportunity Demand for AI compute is outrunning the infrastructure to deliver it, and the environmental bill is growing with it: more fossil power, more freshwater, more land. New capacity on land also means waiting years for power, sites and permits. We take a different route: we bring compute to the power. Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on land, and no grid will ever reach it. Using it lets AI scale without adding carbon or competing with communities and nature for water and land. We're building fleets of autonomous ships that turn that wind into AI compute at sea. Each ship carries its own wind turbines and computing on board, and navigates on its own across the open ocean, following the strongest and steadiest winds. No mooring, no cables to shore: the fleet goes where the energy is. It's AI infrastructure built from the ground up for the open ocean, from power systems and autonomy to high-density computing, engineered to run in one of the harshest environments on Earth. No grid queue. No freshwater. No land. Zero-carbon compute that scales with the fleet. Firm, low-carbon power at a target cost of ~€50/MWh, one of the biggest costs in running AI compute 70%+ capacity factor: offshore wind that behaves like baseload First demonstrator at sea in late 2027 Founded in 2025 by repeat entrepreneurs and industrial leaders. Backed by major international investors. The mandate You'll work directly with the CEO and the board and own the company's business strategy as we go from first demonstrator to fleet. Our platform opens several paths to value across compute and infrastructure, from capacity to hardware to the services around them. You'll decide which to pursue first, build them into the core of the company, and open new ones as the fleet grows. What you'll own Business model & strategy. Shape the business model and evolve it as we scale: products, markets, pricing and unit economics. Turn a breakthrough technology into a bankable one. Strategic partnerships. Decide which partners and customers we build the company with, from AI labs and cloud providers to chipmakers and sovereign compute programmes, and secure the relationships that shape our first fleet. Capital strategy. Work with the CEO on how the business case underpins project finance and fundraising, and own that story with investors and the board. Product direction. Make sure what we build at sea is shaped by where the market is going, working hand in hand with our marine, power and systems engineers. Ecosystem & alliances. Build the partnerships a new infrastructure class needs: chip and systems vendors, cloud platforms, data center operators, ports and financiers. Category leadership. Be our external voice on summit stages, with policymakers and in the press, and make us the reference for AI infrastructure at sea. The business organisation. Build and lead the team across strategy, partnerships and commercial that takes us from demonstrator to fleet. Who you are You've built businesses in deep tech or infrastructure. You've led strategy, business development or a P&L in AI, cloud, data centers or semiconductors, and shaped large, multi-year partnerships. You've taken frontier technology to market. You've brought new, capital-intensive technology to its first major customers and closed the off-take agreements, capacity reservations or long-term contracts that made it bankable. You build, not just run. You've built something from zero, whether a company, a business line or a market, and you're at your best when the playbook doesn't exist yet. You see the whole board. You move between unit economics, partnerships, financing and long-term strategy in the same afternoon. You know AI infrastructure from the inside. Compute economics, workload constraints, and where the market is heading. Compute and infrastructure are your world. GPUs, data centers, power and the economics that tie them together. You hold your own with engineers and turn technical depth into business strategy. The mission matters to you. A business built on AI infrastructure at sea excites you, and you want your work to help AI grow without costing the planet. You work in English. Fluent English is required; French is a plus. How you operate Ownership. You treat the company's outcomes as your own, well beyond your remit. First principles. You reason from the economics and the physics, not from how the market has always worked. Bold and rigorous. You make big bets and do the work to back them. AI-native. You use modern tools to think, decide and move faster. Why this role A C-level mandate across strategy, product and capital, working directly with the CEO and the board The chance to define how compute infrastructure at sea becomes a business, and to keep redefining it as it scales An uncompromising team of repeat entrepreneurs and industrial leaders, backed by top-tier international capital Based wherever you do your best work, with a global mandate and flexible hours. Our home port is Nantes. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Autonomous Drone Software Engineer to join a swarming programme. As an engineer on a lean, high-impact team, you will have the opportunity to drive development of new features, have a say in architecture and design decisions and have real impact across all the team’s projects.

You will not be siloed; this role spans the entire autonomy lifecycle, from developing autonomy capabilities to investigating real-world flight-test data.

The ideal candidate is someone who’s a self-starter, can work independently, can work with ambiguity, can take decisions on their own and not be afraid to drive and push towards getting the project across the finish line.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Take ownership and drive the development of new features across the autonomy stack and partner integrations
  • Collaborate closely with hardware engineers, product managers, and external partners to define system requirements and translate them into robust software architecture
  • Design and implement robust distributed state machines, leader election protocols, and fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Deliver clean, readable and maintainable code while confidently managing complex concurrency and contention scenarios
  • Develop and run rigorous tests utilizing SITL/HITL simulation environments to validate code prior to physical deployment
  • Actively participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and technical documentation to elevate the team's engineering standards
  • Act decisively during flight-test investigations, applying strong engineering judgment to physical failure modes and release safety

Qualifications and Skills

  • 3+ years of professional engineering experience in robotics, embedded systems, or distributed systems.
  • Deep proficiency in modern C++, with practical experience designing, reasoning about, and debugging highly concurrent systems.
  • Embedded systems experience working close to hardware on real-time or safety-critical platforms (e.g., avionics, automotive, robotics).
  • Strong architectural understanding of distributed systems, with the ability to deliberately evaluate and select consensus designs.
  • Familiarity with robust release management, versioned artifacts, and pinned dependencies.
  • Experience with PX4, MAVLink, and related drone software ecosystems is a plus
  • EU citizenship required

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Company pension plan
  • Car parking
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

jobs.title: Senior PMO Analyst
jobs.description: About the Role Imagine this. You are joining Destinus at a pivotal moment, helping build a Project Management Office (PMO) from the ground up while supporting multiple fast-moving aerospace and defense programs. As a Senior PMO Analyst, you will play a key role in bringing structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex programs, ensuring our Program Managers can focus on delivering groundbreaking technologies. Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth. Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization. At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. What You'll Do Program Planning & Execution Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control. Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs. Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early. Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution. PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use. Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery. Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow. Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity. Risk, Issue & Performance Management Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges. Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time. Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership. Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention. AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking. Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate. Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs. Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making. Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned. Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders. Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration. Requirements What You'll Need Required Qualifications & Experience At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls. Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management. A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace. Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment. Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken. Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms. Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations. Eligibility to work in Switzerland. Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations. Strong Plus Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies. Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms. Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes. Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management. Nice to Have Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe. Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries. Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations. Who You Are You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results. You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle. You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture. You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans. You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations. You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward. You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation. You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables. You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company. You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues. You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs. What We Offer A founding role in building the PMO of a fast-growing aerospace company, with the opportunity to shape its structure and future direction. The freedom to develop and influence the tools, processes, standards, and ways of working that will support our continued growth. Direct access to senior leadership, including close collaboration with the Head of PMO and C-level executives, and the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple programs. The chance to join a high-performing, international team working on advanced aerospace and defense technologies that matter. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

  • Professional English; German or another relevant operating language is an advantage.

Strongly preferred

  • Working knowledge of IEC 62443, NIS2 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act in mixed IT/OT environments.
  • Experience with Azure networking and security, Microsoft Sentinel / Defender XDR and enterprise firewall platforms (e.g. Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point).
  • Familiarity with industrial protocols and secure integration patterns, including Modbus TCP, OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs, API gateways and certificate/PKI management.
  • Experience with backup and DR solutions for cloud and hybrid environments, including immutable and offline backups.
  • Recognized credentials such as CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, GICSP, PMP, PRINCE2 or ITIL are advantageous

Decision-making authority: Approves infrastructure and security changes, firewall and access rules and security exceptions within the agreed policy framework and budget; may isolate systems or accounts during a security incident; escalates risk acceptance and major investments to the Head of IT.

Container and image security in practice - building, scanning, and remediating. Comfortable scripting in Python and Bash , and reading other people’s code. What you bring (optional) 4+ years in DevOps, SRE, platform, or cloud security, with real production ownership. Production experience with an OIDC / identity provider . Exposure to privacy-enhancing technologies (secure multi-party computation, confidential computing). Relevant certifications (e.g. GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CKA / CKS, OSCP). jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo’s growth at scale.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us build and operate the event streaming infrastructure that powers business-critical workflows across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.

Get to know our Engineering team, what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Event Streaming Systems team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions(internally called EventBus) and future streaming platform technologies. These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Design, build and operate large-scale event streaming infrastructure that supports critical production workloads.

  • Improve the reliability, scalability, observability and automation of Kafka, EventBus and related streaming platforms.

  • Debug complex distributed systems issues, including performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints and production reliability challenges.

  • Build infrastructure automation and self-healing capabilities that reduce operational toil and improve platform resilience.

  • Contribute to incident response, operational readiness and continuous improvement for Tier-0 infrastructure.

  • Partner closely with EventBus, Storage, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure teams across US and EU regions.

  • Help shape the long-term architecture and evolution of Deliveroo’s event streaming platform.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Strong hands-on experience building or operating distributed systems in production.

  • Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming systems, either as a platform, infrastructure service or critical production dependency.

  • Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable production systems.

  • Experience operating scalable production infrastructure, including debugging, troubleshooting and improving reliability.

  • Strong understanding of infrastructure automation, observability, capacity management and operational excellence.

  • Good fundamentals in Linux, networking and JVM-based systems, or curiosity to deepen expertise in these areas.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across platform, infrastructure and product engineering teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.

  • Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.

  • Experience with JVM tuning, broker tuning, partition management or Cruise Control.

  • Experience with tiered storage, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.

  • Experience operating Tier-0 infrastructure at large scale.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale
Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast
Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership
Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders
High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create
Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine, our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide to help you feel confident at each stage.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

Privacy

Deliveroo will process your personal information in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

jobs.title: Customer Education
jobs.description: About Peec AI AI search is changing how brands are discovered and chosen. People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google’s AI answers what they used to search for, and AI assistants increasingly shape the journey from discovery to purchase. Winning customers now means winning over the AI systems that influence their decisions. Peec AI is an AI search platform that helps marketing teams understand and improve how their brands are discovered, represented, and recommended. We show them where they stand, what’s shaping it, and where to act. Since launching in January 2025, Peec AI has passed $20M ARR and 4,000+ paying customers. We’re a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, with 100+ people across our Berlin HQ and our New York office. About the role Peec ships something new almost every week. Most customers hear about it late, and some never do. We're hiring a Customer Education Manager to own how customers learn Peec. You'll own the product docs, the changelog, product updates and in-app communication, and turn every release into something a busy marketer understands in a minute. You'll sit in product marketing and report to our founding product marketer. You'll work every day with product managers and engineers to understand what's shipping, with customer success to see where customers get stuck, and with the growth team to see what actually changes how people use the product. What you'll do Own the product docs. Rebuild them around the jobs customers come to do, not around the menu. Keep them current with every release, and make them easy to read for people and for the AI assistants our customers now ask first. Run the changelog and product updates. Every release gets a clear entry the day it ships. You write the regular product update and the announcement for bigger launches, and decide what deserves which. Write in-app communication. You write the copy for announcements, tooltips, empty states, onboarding steps and feature nudges. The growth team runs the nudges themselves (who sees what, when, and the tests); you make sure every message is clear, accurate and sounds like one product. Make product content that teaches. Short how-to videos, walkthroughs, use-case guides and templates that get a new user from signup to their first useful insight, and an existing customer to the feature they're missing. Get in early. Sit with product and engineering before launch, early enough to shape naming, setup and the first-run experience, not just document them afterwards. Fix questions at the source. Read support tickets and customer calls, find the questions we keep answering, and make sure the product, docs or messaging answer them before anyone has to ask. Measure what you ship. Track docs usage, support deflection and feature adoption after each update. Keep what works, cut what doesn't. What we're looking for You come from product. Product management, product ops, technical writing, solutions or support engineering, or customer success with a strong product bent. You learn software deeply by using it and can get a straight answer from a busy engineer. You've owned docs, a help center or release communication for a B2B SaaS product. Show us a before and after. We'll ask for recent work where your part is clear. You like to ship a lot. Many small, useful pieces over one perfect one, and you care as much about keeping them up to date as about publishing them. You're comfortable with data. jobs.title: UI/UX Designer mit Product-Design-Erfahrung im SaaS-Umfeld
jobs.description: Über Cannaleo Digital Wir gehören zu den führenden Softwareanbietern im Bereich Medizinal-Cannabis. Über 400 Apotheken nutzen bereits unsere Lösungen und mehr als 3 Millionen Bestellungen wurden über unsere Systeme verarbeitet. Wir entwickeln digitale Produkte für Apotheken, Ärzt:innen, Großhändler und weitere Partner und gestalten damit die digitale Zukunft der Medizinal-Cannabis-Versorgung. Deine Aufgaben: Gestaltung und Optimierung digitaler Produkte: Du entwickelst und optimierst moderne, intuitive und benutzerfreundliche Benutzeroberflächen für unsere digitalen Softwarelösungen im Bereich Medizinalcannabis. Dabei gestaltest du komplexe Funktionen und Prozesse so einfach und übersichtlich wie möglich und sorgst für ein ansprechendes Nutzererlebnis. Entwicklung von Wireframes, Prototypen und Design-Systemen: Du erstellst Wireframes, interaktive Prototypen und hochwertige UI-Designs. Außerdem entwickelst und pflegst du unsere bestehende Figma-Library sowie unser Design-System weiter. Gestaltung komplexer Software-Oberflächen und Workflows: Du konzipierst und gestaltest übersichtliche Dashboards, Tabellen, Filter, Formulare und digitale Workflows. Dabei hast du ein gutes Gespür dafür, komplexe Daten und Prozesse verständlich darzustellen und die täglichen Arbeitsabläufe von Arztpraxen und Apotheken durch intuitive digitale Lösungen zu vereinfachen. Analyse von Nutzerbedürfnissen und User Experience: Du versetzt dich in die Perspektive unserer unterschiedlichen Nutzergruppen, insbesondere Ärzt:innen, Apotheken und deren Mitarbeiter:innen. Du analysierst deren Bedürfnisse und Arbeitsabläufe und entwickelst daraus nutzerzentrierte Lösungen, die funktional, intuitiv und visuell ansprechend sind. Zusammenarbeit mit Product & Development: Du arbeitest eng mit Product Ownern, Entwicklern und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen. Dabei bringst du eigene Ideen ein, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und begleitest die Umsetzung deiner Designkonzepte bis zum fertigen Produkt. Du verstehst die technischen Rahmenbedingungen und stellst sicher, dass Design und Funktionalität optimal zusammenspielen. Usability-Tests und kontinuierliche Produktoptimierung: Du führst Usability-Tests durch, sammelst und analysierst Nutzerfeedback und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungsmaßnahmen ab. Du denkst produktorientiert, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und entwickelst unsere digitalen Lösungen kontinuierlich weiter. Responsive Design und Designqualität: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Anwendungen auf unterschiedlichen Bildschirmgrößen und Endgeräten optimal funktionieren. Dabei achtest du auf eine konsistente visuelle Sprache, Benutzerfreundlichkeit, Barrierefreiheit und eine hohe Designqualität. Das bringst du mit: Erfahrung im UI/UX- bzw. Product Design: Du hast bereits über 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Gestaltung digitaler Produkte, Webanwendungen oder komplexer Softwarelösungen gesammelt. Sicherer Umgang mit Design-Tools: Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in Figma und Erfahrung mit Wireframing, Prototyping, Components, Auto Layout und Design-Systemen. KI-Affinität: Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools wie Claude, ChatGPT oder vergleichbare Anwendungen, um Designprozesse zu optimieren, Ideen zu entwickeln und deine tägliche Arbeit effizienter zu gestalten. Fundiertes UX/UI-Verständnis: Du kennst die wichtigsten Prinzipien der User Experience, Usability und des visuellen Designs und weißt, wie man komplexe Funktionen in intuitive Benutzeroberflächen übersetzt. Erfahrung mit komplexen Benutzeroberflächen: Idealerweise hast du bereits mit Dashboards, datenintensiven Anwendungen, B2B-Plattformen oder SaaS-Produkten gearbeitet. Produktorientiertes Denken: Du verstehst nicht nur Design, sondern auch die dahinterliegenden Nutzerbedürfnisse und Geschäftsprozesse. Du denkst lösungsorientiert und bringst eigene Ideen und Verbesserungsvorschläge ein. Kreativität und analytisches Denken: Du verbindest ein gutes Gespür für modernes Design mit analytischen Fähigkeiten und einem strukturierten Vorgehen bei der Entwicklung von Lösungen. Teamfähigkeit und Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest gerne interdisziplinär mit Product Ownern und Entwicklern zusammen, kommunizierst klar und bringst deine Aufgaben selbstständig und zuverlässig voran. Lernbereitschaft und Innovationsgeist: Du interessierst dich für neue Technologien, Designtrends und digitale Entwicklungen und hast Freude daran, bestehende Produkte kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau. Gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Das bieten wir dir : Innovatives Umfeld: Wir entwickeln Softwarelösungen, die die digitale Healthcare- und Cannabis-Branche voranbringen. Vielfältige Projekte: Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben, spannende Herausforderungen und viel Gestaltungsspielraum statt Routine. Flache Hierarchien: Offene Kommunikation, kurze Entscheidungswege und Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe. 30 Tage Urlaub: Für deine Erholung und neue Energie. Corporate Benefits: Exklusive Vergünstigungen bei zahlreichen Partnern. 100 % remote & flexible Arbeitszeiten: Bei uns arbeitest du vollständig remote und kannst deine Arbeitszeit flexibel und eigenverantwortlich gestalten. Feedback & Entwicklung: Regelmäßige Gespräche und konkrete Möglichkeiten für deine persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung. Strukturiertes People Onboarding: Ein persönlicher und gut organisierter Start mit klaren Abläufen und festen Ansprechpartnern. jobs.title: Warehouse Specialist
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT At Proxima Fusion, we are building the future of clean energy - and we need an experienced Warehouse Specialist who thrives in a fast-paced, hands-on environment. In this role, you will ensure the smooth and efficient flow of materials and equipment, supporting our engineering, R&D, and operational ambitions. You’ll be responsible for managing incoming and outgoing goods, maintaining accurate inventory records, coordinating shipments, and ensuring the safe handling and storage of materials. With a strong focus on reliability, precision, and continuous improvement, you’ll play a key role in building efficient and scalable warehouse operations that support our mission to make fusion energy a reality. WHAT YOU WILL DO Goods receipt and inspection: Receive deliveries from suppliers, carriers and couriers. Check each one against the purchase order and delivery note for quantity, part number and condition. Look for transport damage, moisture, contamination or tampering. Verify labels, batch and serial numbers, and shelf life. Non-conformance and claims: Photograph and document any findings. Move non-conforming goods to blocked or quarantine stock and raise non-conformance reports. File claims with carriers, inform Purchasing, and hand parts that need detailed inspection to Quality. Release or return them based on Quality’s decision. System accuracy (ERP/WMS): Post goods receipts and goods issues accurately and on time, including labels, barcodes, and batch and serial numbers. Book goods in only after they pass the receipt checks. Keep physical stock and system stock in sync. Dispatch and shipping documents: Pick, pack and prepare shipments according to packing instructions. Create delivery notes, labels, CMR consignment notes and packing lists. For non-EU shipments, prepare proforma invoices and export documents with the logistics team. Prepare ADR transport documents for hazardous goods. Carrier coordination and returns: Book and coordinate pickups, and track shipments until they’re delivered. Handle returns and re-shipments to suppliers through the RMA process. Loading, unloading and transport: Load and unload trucks and vans safely with forklifts and pallet jacks, and secure loads correctly. Handle heavy, bulky, sensitive or high-value components with care. Run scheduled milk runs between company sites and local suppliers using company vehicles. Storage, replenishment and inventory: Sort, label and store goods in the correct locations. Replenish production and line-side stock (Kanban or min/max) in time for manufacturing. Take part in the annual stocktake and resolve stock differences. Manage packaging materials: stock levels, reordering, reuse and recycling. Housekeeping and safety: Keep receiving, storage and dispatch areas clean and organised with a 5S mindset. Separate and dispose of waste according to German recycling rules. Follow health and safety rules and wear PPE. Report hazards, near-misses and accidents, and carry out daily checks on forklifts and handling equipment. Cross-functional coordination: Work with Purchasing, Production, Quality, Engineering and Finance on material availability, priorities and urgent shipments, and keep internal customers informed. Continuous improvement and travel: Suggest and support improvements to warehouse processes, layout and digital tools. Travel within the EU when needed, for example to suppliers, partner sites or with special shipments. WHO YOU ARE Completed vocational training as Fachkraft für Lagerlogistik, Fachlagerist/in or a comparable qualification, or equivalent hands-on experience. At least 5 years of experience in goods receipt, dispatch or warehousing, ideally in a manufacturing environment. Valid EU/German driving licence, class B. Valid forklift licence (Staplerschein per DGUV Grundsatz 308-001) and confident operation of counterbalance forklifts. Fluent German and English, spoken and written (at least B2 in both). Tech-savvy: confident with ERP/WMS systems (e.g. SAP or similar), barcode scanners, Google Workspace, and email. Good knowledge of shipping documents and processes (delivery notes, CMR, Incoterms basics). Knowledge of load securing and safe handling of goods. Willingness to travel within the EU when required. INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-60 min) Technical Screening (30 min) Technical Panel (3x60 min) *This role sits at "L2" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information. At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table. Analytics first: Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind für dich Analytics. Du iterierst schnell über Hypothesen, A/B-Tests und Kohortenanalysen, statt lange an der perfekten Gestaltung zu feilen. Gute Kenntnisse in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder einer vergleichbaren CRM-Plattform: Du weißt, was technisch möglich ist, und konzipierst Segmente und Journeys entsprechend. Ein Plus ist Erfahrung mit Omnichannel-Journeys über App, Push, In-App und Mail. Technisches Verständnis und Lust auf enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product: Du kennst die Abläufe zwischen CRM-Systemen, Plattformen und Datenquellen und achtest auf Performance, Sicherheit und Datenschutz. jobs.description: This role is located in Munich, Germany. TULIP is a hybrid work environment and we are in the office 3+ days/per week. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Today, these companies face similar pressures: fewer skilled workers, rising quality and compliance demands, and the need to modernize existing plants without stopping production. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value. TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP's headquarters in Europe. The team covers sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, customer success, and R&D. Local customers trust our product in regulated, high-precision environments. You'll take over a small, strong team and own how the world's most demanding manufacturers authenticate, provision, and govern access for their people and, increasingly, the AI agents acting on their behalf.
