Durchführung von Geldtransfergeschäften Du unterstützt unsere internationalen Kunden dabei, ihre Transaktionen zuverlässig und sicher abzuwickeln. Kassenein- und -auszahlungen Du verantwortest die korrekte und sorgfältige Bearbeitung von Bargeldgeschäften. Beratung und Betreuung am Schalter Du bist der erste Kontakt für unsere Kunden und sorgst für einen freundlichen, kompetenten Service. Dokumentation und Kassenabschluss Du übernimmst die ordnungsgemäße Erfassung aller Vorgänge und führst den täglichen Abschluss der Kasse durch. Reporting an die Regional- und Filialleitung Du hältst die Führungskräfte über relevante Kennzahlen und Entwicklungen auf dem Laufenden. Einhaltung von Richtlinien und Compliance-Vorgaben Nach erfolgreicher Schulung achtest Du auf die Umsetzung aller bankinternen Vorgaben sowie auf höchste Sicherheits- und Integritätsstandards. Deine Arbeitszeiten Wir bieten Dir ein flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell, das sich gut mit Deinem Alltag vereinbaren lässt: Schichtdienst mit Monatsplanung für maximale Transparenz und Planbarkeit Arbeitszeit Montag bis Samstag bei einer 5 Tage/Woche Teilzeit: ab 20 Stunden pro Woche je nach Verfügbarkeit 25 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr zur Unterstützung einer gesunden Work‑Life‑Balance Qualifikation Das bringst Du mit Ausgeprägte Service- und Beratungskompetenz Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen, gehst auf ihre Anliegen ein und unterstützt sie mit Deinem Fachwissen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse Du kannst Dich in Wort und Schrift sicher, präzise und professionell ausdrücken. Gute Fremdsprachenkenntnisse (Englisch und eine weitere Fremdsprache) Du kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch; weitere Sprachen wie Türkisch, Spanisch, Französisch, Afrikaans oder andere sind von Vorteil. Routine im Umgang mit PC-Programmen Du beherrschst MS Office und bewegst Dich sicher in digitalen Anwendungen und Systemen. Freundliches und wertschätzendes Auftreten Du begegnest Kunden offen, höflich und empathisch und findest Dich gut in unterschiedliche Situationen ein. Hohe Kundenorientierung Du behältst die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden stets im Blick und sorgst für einen professionellen Ablauf. Belastbarkeit und Ruhe in stressigen Momenten Auch bei höherem Kundenaufkommen arbeitest Du strukturiert und konzentriert. Einwandfreies polizeiliches Führungszeugnis Du handelst verantwortungsbewusst und erfüllst die erforderlichen Sicherheitsanforderungen. Benefits Das bieten wir Dir Verantwortung und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten Dich erwartet eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit Perspektive. Wir bieten Dir die Chance, Dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln – in einem internationalen Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Starkes Team und wertschätzende Arbeitsatmosphäre Du arbeitest in einem kollegialen Umfeld, in dem Zusammenhalt, gegenseitige Unterstützung und ein respektvolles Miteinander selbstverständlich sind. Attraktive Sozialleistungen Du profitierst von umfassenden Zusatzleistungen, unter anderem einer vollständig finanzierten betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Essensgutscheinen, kostenfreien Getränken, einem steuerfreien Sachbezug sowie weiteren Vorteilen. Wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket Wir bieten ein attraktives Grundgehalt ergänzt durch ein Bonusmodell – ganz ohne aktiven Vertrieb. Motivierende Mitarbeiteraktionen Regelmäßige Challenges und interne Aktionen stärken nicht nur das Teamgefühl, sondern bringen zusätzliche Motivation in den Arbeitsalltag. Ideal für Quereinsteiger Auch ohne Branchenerfahrung erhältst Du bei uns die Möglichkeit, erfolgreich in den Finanzdienstleistungsbereich einzusteigen. Eine umfassende Einarbeitung ist selbstverständlich. Professionelles Kennenlernen vor Ort Dein Vorstellungsgespräch findet direkt in einer unserer Filialen statt – so bekommst Du gleich einen authentischen Einblick in Dein zukünftiges Arbeitsumfeld. Wer wir sind Die Western Union Retail Services Germany GmbH ist Teil der Western Union Gruppe im Bereich Geldtransfer und Finanzdienstleistungen. In unseren deutschen Filialen unterstützen wir täglich Menschen aus aller Welt dabei, Geld sicher, verlässlich und schnell zu bewegen – sei es durch Geldwechsel, internationale Transfers oder weitere Services rund um Bargeld. Unser Team besteht aus engagierten Mitarbeitenden unterschiedlichster Herkunft, die gemeinsam dafür sorgen, dass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden jederzeit kompetent beraten werden und ihre Anliegen professionell bearbeitet werden. Dabei legen wir großen Wert auf Servicequalität, Integrität und ein respektvolles Miteinander. Unser Erfolg basiert nicht nur auf unserer internationalen Ausrichtung und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Dienstleistungen, sondern vor allem auf den Menschen, die bei uns arbeiten. Deine Ideen, Dein Engagement und Dein Verantwortungsbewusstsein tragen maßgeblich dazu bei, unseren Service weiter zu stärken und auszubauen. Wenn Du Teil unseres Teams werden möchtest, freuen wir uns auf Deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung – inklusive Lebenslauf, relevanter Zeugnisse, Deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin sowie Deiner Gehaltsvorstellung. Auch eine Vollzeitstelle ist bei entsprechender Verfügbarkeit möglich – wir bieten flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle. Bei Fragen steht Dir Frau Isabel Günther gerne zur Verfügung. jobs.title: Offre de stage Développement et optimisation des mesures automatiques d’ammoniac réalisées en air ambiant
jobs.description: Unité : CERI Energie Environnement - DEMO MERA/LCSQA Responsables : Emmanuel TISON, Anthony LAGACHE Catégorie : Stagiaire de Master 2 ou de fin d’études ingénieur (6 mois) Lieu de travail : Douai – Bourseul, Bâtiment Curie Contexte : École sous tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle, énergétique et numérique, et école de l’Institut Mines Télécom, IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital. Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20000m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les domaines suivants : Systèmes Numériques Energie Environnement Matériaux et Procédés Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr . Le stage est à pourvoir au sein du Centre d’Enseignement, de Recherche et d’Innovation Energie Environnement (CERI EE) de l’IMT Nord Europe. Une partie des missions du CERI EE (https://recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr/energie-environnement-ceri/) est de réaliser des travaux techniques et scientifiques pour le Ministère chargé de l’Environnement dans le cadre du Laboratoire Central de Surveillance de la Qualité de l’Air (LCSQA, https://www.lcsqa.org/fr) et de l’observatoire de Mesure et Évaluation en zone Rurale de la pollution Atmosphérique à longue distance (MERA, https://www.lcsqa.org/fr/le-dispositif-mera). En concertation avec les Associations Agréées de Surveillance de la Qualité de l'Air (AASQA), le CERI EE est chargé de proposer et qualifier les méthodes de mesure à déployer, de définir les protocoles, d’évaluer la qualité des données et de piloter l’observatoire MERA intégré au dispositif français de surveillance réglementaire de la qualité de l’air. Contexte : L'ammoniac (NH3) est un polluant atmosphérique nocif pour la santé humaine, les écosystèmes et l'environnement, mais aussi un précurseur de particules fines inorganiques notamment responsables de forts épisodes de pollution printaniers en Europe. En France, la source dominante d'ammoniac (environ 95%) est attribuée aux activités agricoles (épandage de fumier, utilisation d'engrais azotés, élevage). À partir de 2027, la directive européenne 2024/2881 exige que le NH3 soit mesuré spécifiquement sur les supersites implantés dans des lieux caractéristiques de la pollution de fond rurale. La France répond à cette obligation en déployant 6 supersites de surveillance de typologie fond rural, répartis dans des zones représentatives de la pollution longue-distance, et sélectionnés au sein des stations de l’observatoire MERA. Ces supersites sont équipés d’analyseurs automatiques en continu pour mesurer le NH3 à une très haute résolution temporelle. Ces méthodes permettent une mesure en temps réel, pour capturer la variabilité temporelle du NH3. Cependant, le NH3 est un polluant particulièrement complexe à mesurer notamment en raison de difficultés métrologiques (absence de méthode standardisée, interférences etc.) et de ses propriétés physico-chimiques (grande réactivité avec les surfaces, volatilisation, formation de particules etc.). Objectif : L'objectif de ce stage est d’apporter des éléments méthodologiques qui permettront d’établir des recommandations nationales concernant la sélection et les pratiques de mise en œuvre des préleveurs automatiques, afin d’améliorer la fiabilité et l’harmonisation des mesures de l’ammoniac. Livrables : · Synthèse bibliographique ciblée sur les difficultés métrologiques de la mesure du NH₃ et les solutions à évaluer · Production d’un plan d’expériences détaillé à suivre durant le stage et d’un protocole d’assurance et de contrôle qualité des données. · Jeu de données documenté, fichiers ou scripts de traitement reproductibles et bilan des performances observées. · Présentation des résultats au groupe de travail national pour la mesure de NH3 · Projet de note de recommandations pour le prélèvement de NH₃ en zone rurale, soumis à la validation des encadrants et du groupe de travail national. Les conclusions distingueront les points établis des points restant à confirmer. Profil du candidat : Ce stage est destiné à un.e étudiant.e en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou M2 universitaire avec un profil en analyses physico-chimiques, en instrumentation, mesure et assurance qualité appliquées à l’environnement, avec un goût prononcé pour les approches expérimentales. De grandes qualités d’analyse, de rédaction, d’organisation, de communication et d’autonomie sont attendues. Curiosité scientifique, rigueur et aptitude au travail en équipe sont recherchées. Un bon niveau d’anglais scientifique est souhaité pour la lecture bibliographique. Des compétences en traitement de données (Python, R ou Matlab) seront appréciées. Une première pratique de la chimie analytique et des notions de métrologie et d’assurance qualité seront des atouts. Conditions : Le poste est à pourvoir à compter du 01/03/2027 pour une durée de 6 mois Renseignements et modalités de dépôt de candidature : Pour tout renseignement sur le poste, merci de vous adresser à Emmanuel TISON ----- et Anthony LAGACHE ----- class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast"> Pour tout renseignement administratif, merci de vous adresser à la Direction des Ressources Humaines : Pour faire acte de candidature, merci de vous connecter sur notre plate-forme de recrutement via le lien suivant : Date limite de candidature : 15/12/2026 Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer 80–100%
jobs.description: As our Software Test Engineer at machineMD in Bern, you’ll bring your engineering skills to a practical challenge: making complex systems easier to test. You’ll design and build test automation, connect tools and technologies, and explore how agentic workflows can improve the way we work. Our existing infrastructure gives you a starting point, with the freedom to extend it and introduce new approaches. You’ll work alongside developers, requirements engineers, and testers, taking responsibility for solutions from design to daily use. About machineMD We’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our signature product, neos™, is the world’s first non-invasive neuro-ophthalmoscope for fast, automated assessment of eye movements and pupils. Founded at the University Hospital of Bern, Switzerland, we’ve grown into a startup of 25 engineers, clinicians, scientists, and specialists working side by side. We aim to bring the diagnostic quality of highly trained specialists into secondary and primary care settings everywhere. The Role You’ll help us understand how neos™ behaves when its components work together—and where they fail. You’ll design and build the test systems, agentic workflows, and tooling that make complex behaviour reproducible and failures easier to diagnose. You’ll work alongside developers and use the domain expertise and manual testing provided by requirements engineers and testers. Pragmatic Improvements – assess our current testing setup with the team, identify the biggest weaknesses, and tackle them step by step. Build on what works, try useful approaches, and let a broader test concept grow from the improvements you put into practice. Engineer the Next Generation of Test Automation – build intelligent, agent-powered systems that redefine how complex software is tested. Go beyond UI testing, architect autonomous workflows, experiment with cutting-edge AI technologies, and turn bold ideas into production-ready solutions. Own the test automation stack. Build, break, innovate. Test Infrastructure – build on and improve our physical and software-based test environments. Introduce tools and setups where they make testing more effective, and keep them documented so tests remain repeatable and usable by others. Coordination & Code Quality – work hands-on with developers to implement automation, coordinate contributions, and review the quality of test code. Connect individual improvements so our testing becomes more consistent and easier to extend over time. Verification & Validation – contribute to V&V plans, protocols, reports, and evidence, and coordinate activities with the relevant specialists. Help keep testing, requirements, and documentation aligned in a medical device environment. What We Look For Experience Solid practical experience in software engineering, including designing, implementing, debugging, and maintaining software. You can understand existing codebases and develop clear, well-structured solutions that others can maintain and extend. Experience with some of our core technologies (Python, C#/.NET, C++ and Flutter/Dart) is a plus. Python and pytest are particularly useful for test automation, and you’re willing to learn the technologies needed for the task. Practical experience developing automated tests across different system levels, with the programming skills to implement, understand, and review test code. Experience building or integrating agentic workflows is a plus. Experience with verification and validation of medical devices or familiarity with ISO 13485 is a plus. Qualifications Solid software testing fundamentals at ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent knowledge, including test planning, test design, and requirements coverage. Vocational training or a higher degree in computer science, software engineering, medical informatics, or a related technical field. Fluent English (minimum strong B2, ideally C1); German or French language skills are a plus for on-site collaboration. Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss/EU/EFTA work permit). How You Work Systems Thinker – you want to understand how neos™ works as a whole, from its software and hardware to the tests and data behind it. You choose practical improvements as our product and testing continue to develop. Curiosity & a Detective’s Instinct – you notice when something doesn’t quite add up and enjoy following the clues. You question assumptions, explore unusual scenarios, and keep digging until you can explain and reproduce what you’ve found. Close the Gaps – you enjoy getting your hands dirty and following a problem across disciplines. When progress depends on something outside your usual remit, you’re willing to learn and lend a hand. Collaborative Spirit – you work closely with colleagues, share what you know and what you’re unsure about, and address difficult topics openly. You listen with curiosity, give and receive candid feedback, and make room for different perspectives. Shaper Mentality & Growth Mindset – you want to shape how testing works, take responsibility, and build missing skills quickly. You’re curious about neurodiagnostics and ready to learn from experts and real-world use cases. Working at machineMD Located in Bern, Switzerland, we thrive on collaborative, in-person energy, while offering the flexibility you need to do your best work. Available for roughly 80% of your time on-site in Bern and committed to our weekly anchor day on Monday. We are united by the Four Pillars of Integrity: Radical Responsibility, Feeling Our Feelings, Candor and Clear Agreements. These are not just words on a wall; they guide how we: Own our choices (Radical Responsibility) Name and honour our emotions (Feeling Our Feelings) Speak and listen with honesty (Candor) Make and keep clear commitments (Clear Agreements) Living these principles keeps us “whole”, fully alive, and brimming with the energy needed to build world-class diagnostic tools. Life’s too short to work on boring stuff. If you want to connect ideas, people, and technology to advance brain diagnostics at the frontlines in a dynamic startup environment, let’s talk! How to Apply Send your CV and a short note about a project or task from your career that you enjoyed a lot, and explain why. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, age, background, or orientation. Direct applications only. No recruiters, please. We’re excited to meet you! jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will build software that runs on real drones. You will take Auterion’s platform into a specific customer program and make it work on their hardware, for their mission, in the field.

This is a software engineering role. You will design, write, integrate and debug C++ and Python code on a Linux-based autonomy stack, working with AuterionOS, our operating system for autonomous vehicles, and Skynode, our flight and mission computer running PX4 and AuterionOS. Your work will span autonomy, computer vision, video streaming and long-range radio links, on partner platforms across aerial, maritime and ground vehicles. What sets this role apart is that your work isn’t finished when the code is merged; it’s finished when the system flies.

You will join a forward deployed team dedicated to a single customer program, which owns the outcome from first requirement to deployed system. You will work directly with partners and customers, as well as with Auterion’s core platform, hardware and flight test teams. Between trips, you will work from our Munich office, both at your desk and on the bench.

No drone experience is required. If you have integrated software on cars, robots, industrial machines or other embedded systems, you already have the right foundation, and we will teach you the drone side.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design and implement software for customer programs on AuterionOS and Skynode, including features, integrations, payload and sensor drivers, and tooling.
  • Bring up complete systems on real hardware, including compute, sensors, payloads and radios, and get them working end to end.
  • Debug across the full stack, determining whether an issue stems from software, configuration, hardware or RF, and then resolving it.
  • Translate customer mission requirements into technical solutions and working demonstrations.
  • Work on site with partners and customers to run flight tests, trials and demonstrations, solving problems directly in the field.
  • Deploy software releases to customer systems, including flashing, configuration and calibration.
  • Report field learnings back to core engineering in a form they can act on, and help shape the product roadmap with real customer input.
  • Document what you build so that future teams can repeat it.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software, Electrical, Robotics or Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • Solid experience developing software in modern C++, plus Python for tooling, automation and data analysis
  • Strong Linux skills, including the command line, logs, Docker and networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Experience getting software running on embedded or physical systems, including comfort with UART, CAN, I2C and SPI, wiring, and using a multimeter on the bench
  • A structured approach to debugging and the ability to stay methodical under time pressure
  • Clear communication in English with customers, operators and engineers alike
  • Eligibility for German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink or QGroundControl
  • Experience with video pipelines, computer vision, or radio and datalink systems
  • Integration or field engineering experience in automotive, robotics or aerospace
  • Experience working with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan
  • Extended social security package
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Wellpass membership

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

Mobilität: Ob mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder dem Auto – profitiere von einem bezuschussten Jobticket oder kostenlosen Parkplätzen direkt am Büro. Data Engineering: Konzeption, Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung moderner Datenpipelines in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Fabric. Datenqualität: Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenqualität, Vollständigkeit und Reproduzierbarkeit sowie Implementierung effizienter inkrementeller Datenladeprozesse. Datenintegration: Entwicklung und Pflege effizienter ETL-/ELT-Prozesse sowie API-basierter Datenintegrationen. Plattformbetrieb: Entwicklung robuster Monitoring-, Logging- und Fehlerbehandlungskonzepte sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung von Performance, Kosten und Datenworkflows. Data Architecture: Mitarbeit am Aufbau einer skalierbaren Datenarchitektur inklusive Test-, Staging- und Produktionsumgebungen sowie moderner Technologien wie CI/CD, Fabric Pipelines, dbt oder Airflow. Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit dem Head of Data & Analytics und den Data Analysts zur Bereitstellung hochwertiger Daten für Power BI Dashboards und Machine-Learning-Modelle. Dein Profil als Data Engineer Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von Datenpipelines oder Datenplattformen – idealerweise auf Senior-Level, motivierte Mid-Level-Profile sind ebenfalls willkommen. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Azure Data Services , insbesondere Data Factory und/oder Azure Synapse ; idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric . Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL und Python , insbesondere im Bereich ETL-/ELT-Prozesse und Automatisierung. Erfahrung in der Datenmodellierung , idealerweise mit Bronze-, Silver- und Gold-Layer-Architekturen . Kenntnisse im Datenqualitätsmanagement sowie in Monitoring, Logging und Performance-Optimierung . Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Umsetzung technischer Projekte sowie eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. Ausgeprägte Teamorientierung sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld. Fließende Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse. Bei geringeren Deutschkenntnissen (ab B1) werden dafür sehr gute Englischkenntnisse vorausgesetzt. Nice-to-haves – jedes zusätzliche Know-how ist ein Pluspunkt: Erfahrung mit inkrementellen Ladeprozessen und Delta-Verarbeitung . Erfahrung in der Datenintegration für Power BI sowie im Umgang mit semantischen Modellen. Kenntnisse im E-Commerce- oder Amazon-Umfeld . Erfahrung mit API-basierten Datenintegrationen . Kenntnisse in CI/CD , z. B. mit GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps . Interesse an Machine Learning und dem Aufbau datengetriebener Organisationen. Erfahrung mit Openbridge . jobs.title: Staff Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business. As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine leveraging AI and data to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. We are looking for a Staff Data Platform Engineer to join our Data Platform team. Our team builds and operates the shared foundation that powers analytics, machine learning, business intelligence and AI-driven experiences across the entire company. As a senior individual contributor, you will shape how we move, store, govern, and serve data at scale, enabling every downstream team to build faster and with greater confidence. If you enjoy turning ambiguity into clear technical direction and durable solutions, we’d love to hear from you. This role will be required to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week. In this role, you will: Design and evolve the architecture of KAYAK’s shared Data Platform, including near-real-time streaming, lakehouse storage, schema management, semantic layer, and distributed query infrastructure. Make thoughtful trade-offs between latency, correctness, cost, and long-term maintainability. Deliver high-impact platform initiatives end-to-end — from problem framing and architecture design through implementation, rollout, and operational handoff. Define and promote technical standards for data contracts, schema evolution, ingestion patterns, and production readiness across platform and domain teams. Lead high-impact platform initiatives from problem framing and architecture design through implementation, rollout, and operational handoff. Develop reusable patterns and reference architectures for streaming ingestion, compaction, retention, schema governance, observability, and other recurring data engineering challenges. Establish reliable observability across the platform, including pipeline monitoring, consumer lag tracking, data quality checks, and alerting. Collaborate closely with Operations, Security, Engineering, Data Engineering, and Data Science, and Analytics to evolve the platform, build cross-functional support, and ensure the platform meets the needs of its users. Drive the semantic layer and metadata strategy that supports consistent and trusted self-service analytics and AI-driven data access. Evaluate technologies and approaches across streaming, storage, query, orchestration, and cloud infrastructure, balancing scalability, operational complexity, cost, and maintainability. Coach and mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pairing, and reusable technical guidance. Own the most complex architectural and operational challenges on the data platform, including failure recovery, schema drift, partition management, and performance degradation. Please apply if you have: 7+ years of professional experience in data engineering, with meaningful time spent at a senior or staff level with domain-wide technical scope. Experience designing and operating lakehouse architectures at scale — including open table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg), columnar storage (Parquet) and cloud object storage (e.g. S3) Experience building and operating streaming data pipelines — including event-driven ingestion, exactly-once delivery semantics, consumer lag management, checkpoint and recovery strategies, and failure handling in production environments. Hands-on experience with data contracts, data governance, metadata, or semantic-layer systems. Strong Python skills and a track record of writing maintainable, testable production code. Experience deploying and operating data workloads on Kubernetes — including managing containerized infrastructure, resource tuning and health checks. Proven ability to influence multiple teams, communicate architectural trade-offs, and drive adoption. Experience mentoring engineers and raising technical standards through code reviews, documentation, and reusable patterns. Comfort taking ownership of broad, ambiguous problem spaces. To stand out: Distributed query engines such as Trino. Experience with Kafka, Flink, or comparable streaming technologies. Workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow. Experience with AWS or an equivalent public cloud provider. CI/CD and deployment automation (e.g., GitHub Actions). Working knowledge of Java or another JVM-based language, given the JVM-based nature of several frameworks in this domain. Benefits and Perks Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year Focus on mental health and well-being: Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace Company-wide week off a year – the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!) No meeting Fridays Paid parental leave Paid volunteer time Focus on your career growth: Development Dollars Leadership development Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings Travel Discounts Employee Resource Groups 6 weeks paid vacation + a day off for your birthday Free lunch 2 days per week Pension plan contributions Public transportation subsidies Bike leasing program Monthly social events, Thursday happy hours, sports teams An awesome office in Friedrichshain, Berlin Inclusion At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That's why we're focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here. jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description: ÜBER UNSERE COMPANY freiheit.com wurde 1999 in Hamburg gegründet und entwickelt seitdem custom large-scale Softwareprodukte. Unsere Mission ist: “Ship great software”. In mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten haben wir immer das ausgeliefert, was wir versprochen haben – “always on time, on budget, on target and on quality”. 85% unserer Members sind Software Engineers mit Abschlüssen in Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik, viele auch mit fundierten Kenntnissen in Maschinellem Lernen und Künstlicher Intelligenz. Seit über einem Vierteljahrhundert arbeiten wir für das „Who’s Who“ der deutschen und europäischen Industrie- und Handelsunternehmen. Retail, Automotive, E-Commerce, Healthcare und mehr. Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz. Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”. Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat. Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein. Technology never rests. Neither do we. ÜBER DEINEN JOB Wir sind eine Engineering Organisation – auf jeder Ebene sind bei uns Engineers verantwortlich – auch in der Sicherheit. Deshalb kann nur ein echter Engineer unsere Security verantworten. Als Senior Security Engineer bist Du Primus inter Pares: Du beherrschst das Handwerk exzellent und steuerst gemeinsam mit Deinem Team die Compliance bei freiheit.com über Code und Automation. Deine Rolle & Perspektive: Führung mit Ziel: Du steigst an der Seite der aktuellen Leitung ein, lernst unsere Systeme tiefgreifend kennen und übernimmst mittelfristig die vollständige Führung des Security-Teams (direkt unter dem CEO). Strategischer Weitblick: Du planst technologische und regulatorische Anforderungen für die nächsten 6 bis 24 Monate proaktiv voraus. Engineering & Automation: Du entwickelst Infrastruktur selbst und automatisierst manuelle Aufwände konsequent durch Code. Compliance & Governance: Du trägst die Hauptverantwortung für unser ISMS (TISAX), steuerst das Incident Handling und prüfst Verträge rund um IT-Sicherheit und Datenschutz (unterstützt von Fachanwälten & HiSolutions). Enablement: Du schulst unsere Entwickler:innen und hilfst ihnen, von Beginn an sichere Projektarchitekturen zu bauen. ÜBER DICH Du bist erfahrener Software Engineer und hast bereits erste oder fundierte Schritte in den Bereichen Führung, Strategie, Security und Compliance gemacht? Bei uns übernimmst Du die Verantwortung, diese Themen auf das nächste Level zu heben. Dazu bringst du folgendes mit: Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Mathematik, Physik oder Elektrotechnik (Master/Promotion von Vorteil). Leadership & Strategie: Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau und der Führung von Engineering-Teams sowie in strategischer Planung und Incident Handling. Security & Compliance: Erfahrung in der Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung eines ISMS (ideal VDA/ISA bzw. TISAX). jobs.description: Are you a seasoned construction planner that is a bit tired of the standard old-fashioned wayof doing things in the construction industry? People who join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. ( Read more about our vision and missions .) This approach has allowed us to grow from just two people in 2017 to over 220 today. We have a stable, repeat client base across infrastructure and complex building projects in the UK and internationally, and we’re still growing fast. Joining us isn’t just some “job”. It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it. ( Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos. ) Core values for a good life A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has: - Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself - Care about people – your relationship with others around you - Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team - Build civilisation – your relationship with humanity and the world We enshrined our values in our vision: We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that: - Connects us with meaningful relationships - Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans - Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world. And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions: - To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation - To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society ____________________________________________________________ The Role Purpose of the role You will be enhancing the delivery of the most complex and interesting projects in the world through the power of project planning. You will be a senior leader in our team pushing the discipline to new heights not only within Laminar but within the industry in general. Your Team This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy which focuses on: - Understanding what the real problems of projects are - Implementing the best solutions to those problems - Developing scalable best practices, tools and technology More specifically you will be part of our Project Planning Discipline Team who are industry leaders in the planning of complex construction projects. Your initial leader will be one of our planning discipline directors. Your top 3 objectives 1. To make construction projects deliver to near perfection 2. To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems 3. To develop yourself and everyone around you Your top 5 responsibilities 1. Own the plan: Own the project plan for one or more projects and ensure that the project isworking to it eff ectively. Ensure delays are mitigated and managed commercially. 2. Own the outcome: You may not be the project manager ultimately responsible for the resultsbut you are sure as heck responsible for putting in your best eff ort to ensure the project’sunderstanding and focus on the plan no matter how stubborn they are! 3. Report and inform: Provide simple actionable reports to stakeholders at all levels that helpthem deliver their part of the project more effi ciently and eff ectively. 4. Make scalable solutions: Develop scalable and repeatable best practices and tools incollaboration with the team so that long-term impact is achieved. 5. Develop everyone: Maximise the development of your team personally and professionallyand educate our clients to improve as well. Must-Have (The fundamentals) - Mastery : Solid construction project planning capability in all aspects that take into accountstrategic objectives and the broad context you are operating in - Communication : The charisma, infl uence and presence to get construction people to do newthings and take the best approach - Leadership : A proven leader/coach/developer of teams - Impact : A track record of implementing scalable and repeatable solutions in projects that hada signifi cant positive impact Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true: - You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge - You like to be the smartest person in the room - You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback - You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team ____________________________________________________________ Frequently Asked Questions What kinds of projects would I be working on? It’s common for people to be exposed to several projects in their first year with us. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting environments in the world. We’ve delivered over 100 data centres internationally, many of them fast-tracked and multi-package. Our teams have supported flagship infrastructure programmes like HS2 through integrated planning and digital delivery, contributed to over $30bn in power generation and transmission projects, and played a key role in the development of high-containment labs and R&D campuses for some of the world’s most advanced industrial and life sciences clients. You might find yourself working in sectors such as data centres , infrastructure (including defense, rail, and highways), high tech (such as advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors), or complex building projects . These aren’t hands-off assignments. They’re dynamic, hands-on environments designed for people who want to be challenged. We bring back the lessons from every project to help our team grow and deliver the highest levels of value. ( Check out our case stories .) Who are our clients? Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally. Where would I be working? One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. Maybe you’ll pop into our London office for a workshop or a beer. Maybe you’ll fly out to exotic (and sometimes not!) locations in Europe or the Middle East to visit clients. It really depends on what you want to get involved in and what fits with your life. How does what I do connect with the long-term impact on the construction industry? You’re tasked with understanding and solving common problems. You’ll constantly test those products in the field, so we can rapidly iterate and improve them for anyone in the industry to use. ____________________________________________________________ Benefits The standard stuff: - Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance - Professional body membership. Work where it makes sense - most of our team works from home, visiting sites or clients regularly. We care about outcomes, not clock-ins - Relentless development. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up ____________________________________________________________ Important! Applying properly We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining: - Why you want to join us - What you’ll bring to the team We aren't a giant, faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team, so your letter will be read carefully. After that, we’ll reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you get to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. Our Perception and AI team is responsible for how STARK's unmanned systems perceive their surroundings and know where they are. As a member of this team, you will collaborate closely with sensor, autonomy and test engineers in a fast-paced, hands-on environment. Together, we make sure our systems navigate and operate reliably in contested environments, even when GNSS is not available.

As a Senior Radar Navigation Engineer at STARK, you will lead the development of radar-based navigation and mapping: estimating how our systems move and what surrounds them, without relying on GNSS. Your ultimate goal is to deliver motion estimates and 3D maps that our autonomy stack can depend on in the most demanding conditions.


WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

- Develop radar odometry and radar-inertial state estimation for position, velocity and orientation in GNSS-denied environments.
- Build real-time 3D mapping of the surroundings from radar detections and extract the information our autonomy needs for obstacle avoidance.
- Apply SLAM, factor-graph and probabilistic estimation methods within the constraints of embedded, real-time systems.
- Define the measurement interface with our radar signal processing engineers and integrate your work with autonomy, embedded software and test teams.

- Deep understanding of state estimation â€” SLAM, Kalman filtering, Bayesian estimation, factor graphs â€” and of 3D geometry, coordinate frames and kinematics.
- Strong C++ for real-time systems; Python or MATLAB for prototyping and analysis.
- Master's degree or PhD in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a comparable field.
- Fluent English; German is a plus.
- Citizenship of a NATO member state.

NICE TO HAVE

- Radar odometry or radar-based mapping; lidar or visual odometry also counts
- GTSAM, Ceres or similar optimization libraries
- Deployment on resource-constrained embedded compute
- Alternative navigation methods and navigation sensor calibration
- ROS2 and experience with field testing

Our Background Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material. Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans. Why It Matters Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives. But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI. Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have: Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Omniwatt Energy ist die Strom-Unit von Enpal und macht saubere Energie für jeden Haushalt zugänglich – vom günstigsten Stromtarif Deutschlands bis hin zu intelligenten Energielösungen, die Erzeugung, Speicherung und Verbrauch optimal vernetzen. Mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen und einem schnell wachsenden Kundenstamm bauen wir ein Team, das den deutschen Energiemarkt aktiv mitgestaltet. Deine Aufgaben Du willst nicht nur Konzepte entwickeln, sondern Lösungen selbst bauen? Bei Omniwatt bauen wir konsequent neue Geschäftsbereiche aus und entwickeln bestehende Bereiche weiter. In dieser Rolle baust du neue Prozesse, automatisierst bestehende und verantwortest deine Themen von der ersten Idee bis zum Go-live, von der konzeptionellen Strategie bis zur operativen Ausführung. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Business, Operations und Tech und siehst direkt, was deine Lösungen bewirken. Du analysierst unsere Prozesse bis ins Detail, erkennst die größten Hebel und baust Lösungen, die im Alltag wirklich funktionieren. Du entwickelst KI-Agents, Workflows und Automatisierungen mit Low-Code- und No-Code-Tools und bringst sie in den Betrieb. Du denkst Kundenkommunikation neu, testest neue Ansätze in kleinen Schritten und machst ihren Erfolg mit Daten messbar. Du bringst Customer Support, Operations und Tech zusammen und treibst Themen über Teamgrenzen hinweg voran. Dein Profil Du bringst erste Berufserfahrung oder relevante Praktika mit, z. B. aus einem Startup, Scale-up, der Beratung oder dem Venture Building. Du verbindest Business-Verständnis mit Begeisterung für Technik und Automatisierung. KI-Tools wie Claude gehören für dich ganz selbstverständlich zum Arbeitsalltag. In Low-Code- und No-Code-Tools wie Airtable oder Make sowie SQL hast du Erfahrung oder arbeitest dich gern ein. Du denkst analytisch und findest dich schnell in neue Themen ein. Du arbeitest eigenständig und bringst Ideen zügig in die Umsetzung, auch wenn der Weg noch nicht vorgezeichnet ist. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen. Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt. Dein Kick-Start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt. Dein Extra-Boost - 29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heilig Abend & Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. jobs.description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. The Role As Technical Delivery Lead, EMEA, you will own how Legora's customers across the region go live and scale. You will lead and grow a team of Technical Delivery Managers who run end-to-end implementations, from SSO to document-management integrations, and you will stay close enough to the work to step into the projects yourself. jobs.title: Senior People Operations Engineer
jobs.description: Qdrant is an open-source vector search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real-time recommendations. Trusted by global leaders like Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom , we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising $50M in Series B funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data. As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI. The Team and Your Impact Hi, I'm Gio , and I lead People & Culture at Qdrant. I joined in April 2026 to build the People function from scratch. We have laid the foundations: went live with Ashby and with a new HRIS, launched our first engagement survey, a leveling framework, and our first review and compensation cycles are coming in 2027. Our colleagues are spread across about 30 countries, and our People team is small by design. We need systems that scale as Qdrant does. As our Senior People Operations Engineer, you’ll build how People Ops runs, write the policies behind it, and automate every process that doesn’t need a human touch. You don't need "People Operations Engineer" in your title to apply. If you are an HR generalist who automates everything, or an HR systems person who has handled multi-country cases, we want to hear from you. What you will own About 60% of your time goes to running People Ops, and about 40% to building. The mix will shift with what the business needs. Your first year has four main areas: AI-native People Ops Use Claude and MCP frameworks every day to build agents and automations that take repetitive work off the team, starting with request triage and policy questions Get the process and documentation right before you automate it, and decide what should stay human Share what you learn, so the rest of the team picks up the same tools People platforms, data, and analytics Own our HRIS and people stack, including integrations, access, and data quality Build people analytics and reporting, and work with me to turn the data into decisions leadership can act on, from attrition and engagement trends to headcount planning Global employment and payroll Lead our move to a single global payroll provider , replacing today’s mix of US PEO, EOR, and local payroll setups with one platform, and make sure employment contracts, visas, and Finance coordination carry through the transition without gaps. Design onboarding, mobility, and offboarding so they work the same way in every country Be the go-to person for tricky cases like relocations, with external counsel behind you Policies and benefits Own our employee policies end to end, from drafting and legal review with counsel to rollout and upkeep Design and launch a global benefits offering, country by country Build a self-service documentation library, so people can find answers without asking Who you are You've spent 5 or more years in People Ops, HR operations, or People Systems, including time in a scaling, remote-first People function with EU and US presence You've employed people in several countries across entities, EOR, and freelancers, with hands-on US and EU experience , and you know how to keep it compliant You've worked with EOR, PEO, and global payroll platforms and can spot what looks off in payroll inputs before it goes out You've owned an HRIS and people stack hands on, from setup to integrations and data quality, and you have real people analytics experience You have strong Claude and Claude Code skills and use AI and MCP daily. You've built agents, skills, automations, or integrations that took real work off a team, ideally on HR or business systems. You know how to use AI with people data safely and in line with GDPR You know your way around HR and automation tools : ideally Ashby and Leapsome (or HiBob, Greenhouse, or Personio), Deel or Remote, Jira, and n8n, Zapier, or Make Nice to have Comfort with APIs, webhooks, or light scripting Knowledge of German or Spanish employment law, and a working grasp of US labor and employment rules You have built a benefits offering across countries or consolidated EOR and payroll vendors This role is probably not for you if you: Need to be told what to fix first, or wait for a playbook before deciding Want the process designed before you run it Would rather someone else figure out the solution, and just implement it Struggle with ambiguity and change. We're scaling and adapting as the market evolves, so priorities will shift Prefer a quick call to writing things down, since we work async first Interview process A 45-minute call with me (Gio). We talk about Qdrant, the role, and your background, and I am your point of contact throughout. A practical exercise: show us how you’d approach a real People Ops challenge Technical interviews: A deeper conversation with me and the team (45 min) A call with another colleague, so you get to know us too (30 min) A final call with one of our leaders. I review every application myself after the application deadline, so take the time to tell us why you're a fit! Why join us A remote-first, international team working on cutting-edge AI infrastructure. A competitive salary with additional perks. Flexible working hours and async-friendly culture. High ownership and real impact. Open-source, engineering-driven culture. Choose your own laptop equipment. For US-based full-time employees, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k match, health, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible PTO policy. Qdrant is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe the best ideas come from diverse teams, and we actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If this role excites you but you don't check every single box, we'd still love to hear from you! We don't want to miss out on great people because of a checklist. Come build with us! jobs.title: Senior Design Manager (Mensch) New Business
jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.
  • Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.
  • Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.
  • Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.
  • More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
  • Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.

Das bewegst du:

Als Senior Design Manager (Mensch) bist du Teil unseres 6-köpfigen Design-Teams innerhalb der WPP Media Growth-Unit. Gemeinsam mit den Kolleg*innen aus New Business, Marketing, Strategie und Responsible Media übersetzt du strategische Kernbotschaften in visuell bestechende Geschichten und trägst maßgeblich zu erfolgreichen Pitches sowie hochkarätigen Vorstandspräsentationen bei.

  • Pitch- & Vorstands-Design: Du entwickelst und gestaltest wirkungsstarke, erstklassige Präsentationen (Schwerpunkt PowerPoint) für nationale und internationale New-Business-Pitches sowie Entscheidungsvorlagen auf GF- und Vorstandsebene.
  • Motion & Video Content: Du konzipierst und produzierst bewegte Inhalte, Animationen und Video-Assets (z. B. Case-Videos oder dynamische Pitch-Intros) mithilfe von Adobe Premiere und After Effects.
  • KI-Integration & Innovation: Du nutzt moderne generative KI-Tools (z. B. für Bild-, Konzept- und Content-Erstellung) eigeninitiativ im Arbeitsalltag, um kreative Prozesse zu bereichern und Workflows zukunftssicher weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Brand- & Kampagnengestaltung: Du verantwortest die visuelle Umsetzung von Marketingmaterialien und Initiativen – von digitalen Kampagnen bis hin zu Assets für den Bereich Responsible Media.
  • Schnittstelle & Sparring: Innerhalb der Growth-Unit arbeitest du eng auf Augenhöhe mit den Fachbereichen (New Business, Strategie, Marketing) zusammen und berätst Stakeholder stilsicher von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Master-Folie.

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige, fundierte Erfahrung im Präsentations- und Kommunikationsdesign mit – idealerweise gesammelt im Agenturumfeld oder in einem dynamischen, pitch-getriebenen Setup.
  • PowerPoint-Exzellenz: PowerPoint ist dein kreatives Zuhause. Du beherrschst das Tool bis ins Detail und beweist, dass anspruchsvolles Design und PowerPoint Hand in Hand gehen.
  • Adobe Creative Suite: Du bist absolut versiert im Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Cloud – insbesondere mit Photoshop, Illustrator und InDesign sowie Premiere und After Effects im Bewegtbildbereich.
  • KI-Affinität: Du brennst für neue Technologien, experimentierst aktiv mit aktuellen Generative-AI-Tools und verstehst es, diese produktiv und qualitätsbewusst in deine Designprozesse zu integrieren.
  • Fundierte Ausbildung: Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Design / Kommunikationsdesign oder eine vergleichbare qualifizierte Ausbildung (z. B. Mediengestaltung).
  • Kommunikations- & Sprachkompetenz: Du bewegst dich stilsicher und verhandlungssicher in deutscher sowie englischer Sprache (in Wort und Schrift).

Darüber hinaus bist du: #kreativ #lösungsorientiert #eigeninitiativ #stressresistent

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Arbeiten bei WPP Media:

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.

WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen. #LI-Promoted (ID:13706)

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Android Engineer- Hardware
jobs.description:
Team description

SumUp's Hardware Development team builds the physical products millions of small businesses rely on every day, and this role sits right at the start of a new chapter: moving our in-house hardware onto the Android platform for the first time. This isn't a typical Android device, it's a highly customised, security-first product built from scratch, which means the person joining will help define how the operating system, drivers, and secure processor come together rather than inheriting someone else's setup. The team works closely with hardware, software, and QA engineers across the bring-up process, so this role offers a rare chance to shape a product's foundations while working alongside experienced embedded and secure processor leads.

What you'll do

  • Support system bring-up for the new Android embedded platform, from bootloader through to kernel and framework
  • Integrate and maintain kernel modules and drivers, including power management and connectivity components
  • Contribute to build system integration across the platform
  • Debug hardware and software issues at the protocol level and help resolve critical issues found during testing
  • Carry out testing and validation to confirm the platform is stable and secure before release

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Experience developing embedded systems with a strong focus on Android OS, gained over several years in a professional setting
  • Strong knowledge of the Android OS architecture, from bootloader (U-Boot, Little Kernel) and kernel through to framework and services
  • Hands-on experience debugging hardware interfaces at protocol level, including I2C, SPI, UART, and SDIO
  • Solid understanding of embedded security concepts such as Secure Boot, TrustZone (TEE), dm-verity, encryption, and hardware-backed key storage
  • Comfort working with Qualcomm Snapdragon or MediaTek platforms, and expert-level C programming for embedded Linux environments

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, DashOS EMEA
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

DashOS is DoorDash's merchant technology platform. It brings together the products restaurants and local businesses use to run their own business, sell on their own channels and keep their guests coming back, including online ordering, websites and apps, and loyalty. DashOS connects these tools with the demand and growth learnings of the DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo marketplaces, so merchants can grow both on our marketplaces and on their own channels.

In EMEA, we are building DashOS market by market. The team is small and works like a startup within the larger DoorDash. When joining DashOS, you will help shape a new business from an early stage: what we offer merchants to fuel their growth, how we take it to market and how we support merchants once they are live.

Our Strategy & Operations team builds the DashOS business end to end in EMEA: what we focus on, how we measure success, and the playbooks that make growth repeatable. We work in small cross-functional pods that find improvement opportunities, launch and iterate, together with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Legal, Marketing, our merchant and consumer teams.

About the Role

We are now looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Operations to build the commercial engine behind DashOS. You will own the systems, numbers and operating rhythm that turn a multi-product strategy into predictable revenue, across all DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo markets in EMEA.

What you'll be doing

As the Senior Manager, Revenue Operations for DashOS EMEA, you will partner directly with DashOS commercial leadership to co-own the go-to-market plan and run the operating cadence for the sales and account management teams selling DashOS. This is a senior individual contributor role for a builder: you will set up the tracking and planning foundations, then use them to make the sales organisation measurably better.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

  • Build the revenue tracking infrastructure: own our CRM setup and the data flows into our BI stack, so pipeline, activities and revenue for every DashOS product live in one place
  • Run the commercial operating cadence, including pipeline tracking, pacing and weekly forecasting with sales and account managers, and own the DashOS commercial narrative to EMEA leadership
  • Own sales planning across markets: set targets and quotas through bottom-up and top-down allocation, and design books of business, territories and coverage models that match our growth goals
  • Turn sales performance data into action by building dashboards that act as the single source of truth for account-level performance and risk, and surfacing insights that managers and sellers can act on
  • Design and roll out incentive systems, including MBOs, SPIFFs and variable compensation, together with Finance, so sales and account managers own DashOS revenue alongside marketplace revenue
  • Make DashOS part of the core commercial motion, so it shows up in every account manager's book of business, account plans and business reviews rather than running on the side
  • Automate and scale with AI, removing manual work for sellers and managers (e.g. pre-populated account plans, automated pipeline views) so teams spend their time with merchants

Our humble expectations

  • Significant experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy & Operations or a similar commercial role, ideally in a fast-growing tech company. A management consulting background is a plus.
  • A track record in sales planning: quota and target setting, territory and book-of-business design, and forecasting cadences for a multi-market sales organisation.
  • Hands-on with data and systems. You are comfortable with SQL and BI tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau) and have worked deeply in a CRM such as Salesforce. You build things yourself rather than only writing specs.
  • Experience designing incentive models, variable pay structures, SPIFFs and performance tracking across commercial teams.
  • A builder and generalist who is comfortable with ambiguity, can take a broad mandate and turn it into concrete outputs, and doesn't need a fully built stack to deliver.
  • A clear communicator and trusted partner to senior leaders, able to translate data into a commercial narrative and build alignment across Sales, Finance and Product.
  • Strong understanding of distinct sales motions, including Enterprise Sales, SMB Sales and Account Management. Experience with multi-product or platform sales is a plus.
  • Bonus: experience using AI and automation to scale commercial operations.

Why join us

You will do work that matters and help build one of DoorDash's next big bets. Working here, you can expect to:

  • Make a visible impact every day, directly improving how merchants run and grow their business.
  • Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment, with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
  • Build a career, not just a role, as DashOS grows across EMEA.
  • Deliver together in an inclusive, diverse and values-driven culture, with big hearts and small egos.

Next steps

If you are excited about building a new business from an early stage and taking real ownership, click below to apply, add your CV and get the conversation going! We review applications on an ongoing basis. 💙

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

jobs.title: Lead Business Development Representative (m/f/d)
jobs.description: YOUR JOB Ready to lead from the front and still get your hands dirty? We are looking for ambitious BDR Leader who has mastered outbound and now wants to build, coach and carry a BDR team - while still owning a personal number. Start-up mode: you write the playbook, not just follow it. In this role, you will build and lead our BDR Team qualified pipeline for our Upper Mid-Market segment through targeted outbound, account-based prospecting, multi-touch sequencing, and close collaboration with Marketing and Account Executives. This is a true player-coach role: roughly half your time goes into your own outreach, the other half into making the team around you better: hiring, onboarding, call coaching, 1:1s and setting the standards. No layers, no lengthy approval loops - you test fast, share what works and own the team's results, from activity to pipeline. As the team grows, so does your scope: this role is the springboard into a full BDR leadership position. WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Lead, coach and motivate a team of BDRs (stand-ups, call reviews, 1:1s) and lead by example by creating qualified pipeline yourself for our Upper Mid-Market segment through structured outbound prospecting, cold calling, email, LinkedIn, social selling and other creative engagement tactics. Execute marketing-owned outbound and ABM motions, including targeted account research, multi-touch sequencing and personalised outreach. Use tools such as Gong Engage, Salesforce and other sales technologies to manage sequences, track activity, improve messaging and prioritise the right accounts. Research target accounts, understand buying signals and create relevant first conversations with senior stakeholders. Qualify opportunities based on fit, urgency, business need and buying potential, then work closely with Account Executives to ensure a high-quality handover. Own and evolve the BDR playbook: test new messaging, account angles and prospecting approaches where you see opportunity. Set and track team KPIs, keep CRM data clean and use insights to steer prioritisation and individual performance. Help hire and onboard new BDRs, and collaborate closely with Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations and Enablement to improve outbound strategy, messaging, conversion and feedback loops. Gain strategic insights into management topics with the opportunity to actively contribute, working closely alongside leadership and executive peers. Rapid development opportunities, attractive performance bonuses, and the opportunity to strengthen your leadership skills and business expertise Step into a stable, forward-looking role within a dynamic scale-up poised to shape the fast-growing Security & Compliance industry THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD 2+ years’ experience as a BDR/SDR, ideally in B2B SaaS, with a consistent track record of hitting or beating quota. Outbound fundamentals you could teach in your sleep, including cold calling, email sequencing, account research, objection handling and qualification. Confidence engaging with decision-makers and creating meaningful first conversations. Strong written and verbal communication skills in German and English. A builder mindset: you create structure where there is none and balance your own pipeline with the team's priorities. Lead-by-example energy: resilience, accountability and a strong drive to hit ambitious team targets. Comfort using sales tools, CRM systems and modern outbound technologies to improve productivity and quality. Interest in Security, Compliance, SaaS and AI-enabled sales approaches. First experience coaching, onboarding or mentoring peers – and the ambition to grow into people leadership. LAST BUT NOT LEAST.
