jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock. As Applied AI Engineer (all genders), you work like a forward deployed engineer, embedded with our internal teams. AI is reshaping how we work: you find where it has the highest impact, decide what is worth building, and then build it. You work closely with team leads across departments and within our Data & AI team. The role combines discovery and hands-on engineering: you split your time between working with teams and building the solutions yourself. User pain points are often vague at first, and priorities change as we learn which use cases hold up. Once a solution works, you hand it over and move on to the next problem. Pure coding, pure advisory work or polishing a single system for months are not part of the job. If turning unclear problems into working AI solutions is your thing, you’ll feel at home here. As we are looking for a hands-on engineer, a coding interview is an integral part of our interview process. What to expect Discovery: Shadow processes and interview the people doing the work. Quantify and validate where time and quality are lost. Prioritization: Prioritize use cases across departments by impact, not by what is easiest or needs the most advanced tooling, and say no to the ones that don’t hold up. Make or buy: Test existing tools and new AI providers against our use cases before building. Build and ship: Build the solution yourself: LLM based systems, traditional ML, rule based automation, or a combination, depending on the problem. Ship a first usable version within weeks, integrated into the tools people already use, and iterate based on feedback. Measure success: Define success upfront: business outcome, adoption and metrics that measure output quality. Own the outcome: Own each solution until it has a clear outcome: handed over to our Platform team or the domain team, or shut down. Platform: Build on our AI & Data platform and feed back what it needs next. Inspire us by Background: 3-5 years in software engineering, data science or ML engineering, including at least 1 year shipping LLM based products. Scale-up experience and close work with business teams such as operations or sales are a plus. Discovery experience: You have found and scoped problems yourself, working directly with users, and turned them into a quantified case for or against solving them. Technical skills: Good Python skills and a solid understanding of core GenAI concepts and building blocks, including RAG, tool calling, MCP, agent frameworks, and evaluation (Evals). Experience with traditional machine learning techniques (e.g., XGBoost) and SQL is a plus. End-to-end delivery: You have taken at least one AI project from an unclear business problem to production, implemented it end to end and can show how you measured its output quality. Analytical thinking & communication: You bring structure to ambiguous problems and explain technical trade-offs to non technical teams. You defend your decisions on which use cases to pursue and work as an equal with stakeholders. Mindset: Proactive and comfortable driving topics in unclear situations. You don’t wait for requirements, you find the problem worth solving. Language skills: Fluent English (C1); German is a plus. What we offer Flexibility & Responsibility: Your workday, your performance – Our hybrid model empowers you to focus from home, get fresh perspectives during workation, and connect in person during our Anchor Days (Tuesday to Thursday) Tailored Mobility: Full speed ahead – Whether it’s sustainable bike leasing or a public transport subsidy, we keep you flexible and on the move Measurable goals: Our agile methods allow you to directly measure your impact on our product and company success Team Culture & Networking: Real connections – also beyond the day-to-day. Celebrate successes with us at legendary team events and OKR parties Productive Environment: Brainfood deluxe – Whether it's portafilter coffee, Bella&Bona online cafeteria, fresh fruit or our muesli bar – your wellbeing fuels your performance Health & Balance: Stay in balance with EGYM Wellpass or Urban Sports Club – access 1,000+ gyms and wellness spots across Germany Top Equipment & Ergonomics: Mac or Windows, in the office or remote – we make sure you’re set up for efficiency and comfort Dress Code? Your Code: What you do matters more than what you wear – dress in whatever makes you feel your best Innovation through diversity Regardless of your background, origin, gender identity, or individual circumstances, it's your personality that interests us. That's why we're committed to building a culture of collaboration and respect, where every team member has a voice, can grow, and feels valued with us. Still here? Then we might be the perfect match! It’s best to apply through our application portal - this way, your application lands directly with our team and we can review it quickly and easily. Ready to own (y)our growth? Real-world experience using AI tools to drive software engineering workflows, not only writing code snippets . The ability to navigate undefined problems and align other teams without needing formal authority. It’s great if you have: Experience with Investment products or the Fintech domain, in general. Experience building operational or back-office tooling for business users. Experience with identity platforms such as Auth0, or with multi-tenant isolation. jobs.title: Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Kurz und knapp

Du hast dein Studium in der Tasche, sprühst vor Energie und willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern echte Verantwortung übernehmen?

Bei Picnic startest du direkt in einer Führungsrolle durch! Als Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) in unserem teilautomatisierten Fulfillment Center (FC) in Falkensee bist du der Motor des Standorts. Unterstützt von Investoren wie der Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas.

Sei von Anfang an dabei: Im August 2027 eröffnen wir unser neues teilautomatisiertes FC in Falkensee. Du kannst aber schon früher bei uns starten und dein Onboarding an einem unserer bestehenden Standorte absolvieren - zum Beispiel in unserem manuellen FC in Ludwigsfelde oder unserem vollautomatisierten FC in Oberhausen. So bekommst du einen umfassenden Einblick in unsere Operations und bist bestens vorbereitet, wenn wir in Falkensee an den Start gehen.

Das erwartet dich

  • Teamleitung: Du bist Coach und Vorbild – mit deinem echten, intrinsischen Interesse an Menschen führst und inspirierst du dein Team aus 5 Lead Shoppers und über 150 Shoppers.
  • Schichtleitung: Im FC behältst du stets den Überblick, priorisierst Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich rausgeht.
  • Abwechslung: Du erlebst den perfekten Mix aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (4 Tage pro Woche) und strategischem Deep Dive im FC Office (1 Tag pro Woche).
  • Prozessoptimierung: Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast Ideen? Hier entwickelst du eigene Logistikprojekte und hebst unsere Abläufe durch deinen Tatendrang aufs nächste Level.
  • Ownership: Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, auch wenn Dinge mal außerhalb deines unmittelbaren Bereichs liegen. Du schaust über den Tellerrand hinaus und nimmst die Dinge proaktiv selbst in die Hand.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Logistikmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
  • Du brennst für die Logistik und bringst idealerweise erste Einblicke aus dem Lagerbereich mit (z. B. durch Praktika oder ein Werkstudium).
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch & Englisch und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für die Arbeit in zwei Schichten (6:00 – 14:30 Uhr & 14:30 – 23:00 Uhr, auch samstags) mit.
  • Ein extrem hohes Maß an Eigenantrieb. Du siehst Dinge von selbst, nimmst sie proaktiv in die Hand und übernimmst Verantwortung – auch über deinen eigenen Tellerrand hinaus.
  • Ein echtes, intrinsisches Interesse an Menschen. Du bist empathisch, nahbar und liebst es, dein Team zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Individuelle Mobilität: Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung. Dazu bieten wir ein „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an.
  • Lebensmittelretter: Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden!
  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.
  • Absicherung für morgen: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.

jobs.title: Commercial Lead, DACH
jobs.description: We’re Heidi. We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties. Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart. We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again. We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years. To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund. If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in. The role We’re looking for an experienced seller with an entrepreneurial mindset to help build Heidi’s next stage of growth across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. There’s already momentum: clinicians using the product, customers recommending us and healthcare organisations coming to us with interest. You’ll build on that foundation by closing strategically important deals, creating new pipeline and turning individual adoption into broader organisational relationships. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a broad commercial remit. You’ll personally own opportunities from first conversation to signed agreement, while helping us develop partnerships, strengthen our market presence and figure out where to focus next. You might spend one day building a business case with a hospital group, the next prospecting into a priority account, and another working with a potential partner or helping shape a local event. You’ll bring the judgement to choose what matters and the follow-through to make it happen. What you’ll do Own strategically important deals: Lead opportunities with practice groups, MVZs, clinics and hospital groups from discovery and demos through business case development, negotiation and close. Build relationships with clinical champions, operational leaders and executive decision-makers. Build your own pipeline: Identify the accounts and segments worth pursuing, develop a clear approach and do the outreach yourself. Use targeted prospecting, introductions, local networks and creative approaches to open conversations. Convert the demand coming to us: Respond quickly to inbound interest and use product adoption signals to uncover larger opportunities. Recognise when an enthusiastic clinician could become the starting point for a practice-wide or group-wide rollout. Help buyers reach a decision: Understand their workflows, priorities and buying process. Bring the right stakeholders together, coordinate internal support on technical, security and procurement questions, and give pilots clear success criteria and a route to rollout. Help build the wider market: Develop relationships with software providers, professional associations, clinical advocates and other potential partners. Work with colleagues on conferences, webinars, customer stories and commercial initiatives that create trust and qualified demand. Improve how we sell: Turn what you learn into better messaging, account prioritisation and sales processes. Use AI and commercial tools to improve your effectiveness, keep the CRM accurate and maintain a realistic view of your pipeline and forecast. Bring the market back into Heidi: Share clear evidence about why customers buy, what slows adoption and where product improvements or localisation could unlock growth. Work closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success and the wider DACH team. What you'll need A proven record of selling and closing: You’ve personally owned a revenue target and can explain the deals you originated, how you won them and the results you delivered. Experience in B2B software or a similarly complex commercial environment is particularly relevant. Strong sales craft: You know how to run discovery, build a compelling business case, develop champions and navigate opportunities involving several stakeholders. You can earn credibility with both a clinician and a CFO. The ability to create opportunities: You’ve built pipeline through your own efforts and know how to turn an account list or a promising introduction into meaningful commercial progress. A generalist’s range and judgement: You enjoy work beyond the immediate deal: testing a channel, developing a partnership, organising a customer session or solving a problem that is holding growth back. You can balance that breadth with delivering your number. Independence and pace: You create structure when the playbook is still being written, make sensible decisions with incomplete information and follow through without being chased. Fluent German and strong English: You can lead nuanced commercial conversations in German and work effectively with a global team. Curiosity about healthcare and AI: You’ll learn the product properly, take clinicians’ concerns seriously and use AI thoughtfully in your own work. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Products & Agentic Hospitality (f/m/d)
jobs.description: About the role At Apaleo , we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, and the first AI agent marketplace for hospitality in our Agent Hub, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. We're looking for a senior Product Manager to ownin our AI product domain. You'll turn our AI capabilities into coherent, commercially viable products that solve real operational problems for hoteliers. Your goal is to help hotels move towards genuinely autonomous operations, not to ship isolated automations or AI assistants. This is not a backlog role. You'll take an ambiguous opportunity, find the right customer problems, define the proposition, build it with Engineering, bring it to market and drive adoption. You'll also play a central role in turning our AI capabilities into a meaningful and growing source of revenue. This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it along our vision, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and in close collaboration with our other value stream teams. What you'll be up to Productising and commercialising our AI capabilities . Define the proposition, target customers and use cases, and shape packaging and launch with commercial teams. Building the foundations for AI across our ecosystem. Shape how our AI capabilities understand each hotel's context and work reliably with Apaleo and connected systems across operational areas. Productising hospitality knowledge. Turn hospitality expertise and operational processes into scalable product experiences, with appropriate human oversight. Driving autonomy and measurable value. Think in complete outcomes, such as staff hours saved and manual work removed. Show hoteliers tangible ROI. Driving adoption. Run discovery, shape onboarding and usability, measure adoption and improve from real-world feedback. Keeping AI products reliable and viable. Define good agent performance, understand cost and latency, set up evaluation and monitoring with Engineering, and trade off autonomy, reliability, human intervention and cost. Owning strategy, roadmap and delivery in your scope , with clear specs, a definition of done and impact analysis. Working with Engineering on trade-offs, dependencies, quality and our API-first AI-first architecture. Balancing ambition with reality. Weigh the roadmap against operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and say no to good ideas that aren't great ones. Spotting dependencies early with Hotel Operations and other engineering teams, since our AI capabilities build on the core platform. Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering. What you'll bring 6+ years as a Product Manager, owning products from discovery through launch and adoption with limited day-to-day direction. Proven zero-to-one experience. You've taken a new B2B product, not a feature, from an ambiguous problem to paying customers, driving discovery, validation, definition, prioritisation and launch. Ownership after launch. You've owned a revenue, adoption or retention number and can tell us what moved and what you killed, pivoted or repriced. Commercial thinking. You've defined propositions, packaging and pricing, validated willingness to pay and worked with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market. Systems and process thinking. You break processes into steps, decisions and handoffs, and understand how systems with different data models and sources of truth affect the reliability of agents. Meaningful AI product experience. You've built and launched AI-powered products or capabilities used by real customers, understand what makes a product agentic, and can discuss context, tools, latency, cost and evaluation, with a view on human-in-the-loop design. Customer centricity and product judgement. You turn interview patterns into opportunities, make tough trade-offs and prioritise ruthlessly. Platform thinking. You weigh customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency and long-term platform evolution. Stakeholder alignment. You align Engineering, commercial teams and peers, manage cross-team dependencies and communicate trade-offs with confidence. Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, raise risks early and make progress through ambiguity. Strongly preferred Agentic AI products in production. You've taken an agentic AI product beyond prototype to paying customers, and dealt with reliability, permissions, exceptions, human intervention and evaluation. This is different from AI-powered features such as chatbots, summarisation or copilots. Nice to have Hospitality technology or hotel operations experience. Experience with PMS, RMS, CRS, channel managers, OTAs or hospitality distribution. Experience in B2B SaaS platforms, ecosystems or integration-heavy products. Experience with AI governance, permissions, identity, orchestration or enterprise AI adoption. Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up. Comfort with AI-assisted engineering processes. Don't tick every box? Hospitality experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite. A strong zero-to-one B2B product builder from another domain, with real AI product experience and a commercial mindset, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you. Who you are You take high ownership. You answer for product outcomes, not just delivery commitments. You're strategic and hands-on. You can set a product vision and still get into customer discovery, operational processes and detailed product decisions. You're comfortable with ambiguity. You make progress when the problem or the solution isn't fully defined. You think commercially. You ask what customers will buy and why, not just what Engineering can build. You're customer obsessed. You understand real operational pain and test your assumptions with customers. You're technically curious. You know enough about AI and agentic systems to hold meaningful discussions with engineers and make informed product decisions. You measure what matters. You judge success by customer outcomes, adoption and commercial impact, not features shipped. What we offer Culture and growth A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech. Growth and development. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency. Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. Perks and lifestyle Flexible and remote work options. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup. Free public transport. Travel across Germany with a fully covered Deutschland Ticket. Paid time off. 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. Health and wellbeing. Access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership. jobs.description: Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform. We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. Role We are looking for a Regional Sales Director to join our team. This is a remote role based in Germany, with a preference for Frankfurt or Munich, reporting to the RVP in the Germany Sales department. As the Regional Director, you will be responsible for recruiting, coaching, and scaling a high-performing team of Enterprise Account Executives, driving strategic growth and flawless execution across the German enterprise market. What you’ll do (Role Expectations) Embed MEDDIC / MEDDPICC as the core operational language of the team and drive rigorous execution of the sales process by coaching AEs on identifying Economic Buyers, mapping Decision Criteria, and validating Business Value Lead strategic account expansion by building long-term business transformation roadmaps and partnering with AEs and Technical Architects to co-design customer-centric Zero Trust architectures Maintain highly accurate forecasts (monthly, quarterly, and yearly) backed by clean pipeline hygiene, explicit deal next steps, sales stage linearity, and weekly pipeline generation cadences Orchestrate a unified field execution model across Sales, Field Marketing, Sales Development, and Channel Partners to maximize regional market penetration Participate directly in critical field-level customer discovery meetings to support AEs in building champions and driving large-scale digital transformation agreements Who You Are (Success Profile) You are a sales process and MEDDPICC practitioner. You believe a repeatable sales process is key to scaling revenue, enjoying deal diagnosis, qualification analysis, and coaching AEs to build structured close plans. You are a transformation strategist. You understand the big picture and excel at analyzing customer objectives to lead teams in building comprehensive technology roadmaps that unlock massive account value. You possess dynamic range. You pivot seamlessly between high-level regional growth strategy and hands-on, active coaching with your team in the field. You are a high-trust collaborator. You hold yourself and your team to high execution standards while collaborating seamlessly across channel, marketing, and engineering ecosystems. You are a learner. You have a growth mindset, actively seeking feedback to continuously refine leadership capabilities and better serve your team and customers. What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications) Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain 3+ years of experience directly leading and scaling successful Enterprise sales teams in the software and security industry (Cloud Security or SaaS preferred) Deep, practical mastery of MEDDIC / MEDDPICC qualification methodologies alongside a demonstrated understanding of structured sales processes, pipeline execution, and driving account expansion to over-achieve targets Experience working closely with the partner ecosystem, including VARs, Global Systems Integrators, and Cloud Marketplaces Native or professional fluency in German and English What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications) Expertise in driving high-value platform-selling motions and designing multi-year business transformation roadmaps for major enterprises Experience utilizing modern conversational intelligence, sales enablement, or predictive forecasting tools to optimize regional pipeline execution #LI-MM5 #LI-Hybrid Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and determined by role and level. jobs.title: Senior Partner Solutions Architect (Pan-EMEA GSI)
jobs.description: The Team: We are Datadog's in-house product experts. The technical solutions team enables Datadog's worldwide growth by educating potential clients and ensuring that existing customers are happy and successful. We share our technical and product expertise with customers through demos, presentations, technical evaluations, and ongoing support. Technical solutions is a growing global team that collaborates constantly to share knowledge and continuously advance our technical skillset. The Opportunity: The Partner Solution Architect (PSA) is a Datadog expert who will work closely with Datadog’s Director, Adoption Services, and is aligned to our Channels & Alliances business segment. Our SaaS product is used by organizations of all sizes across a wide range of industries to enable digital transformation, cloud migration, and infrastructure monitoring of our customers’ entire technology stack, allowing for seamless collaboration and problem-solving among Dev, Ops and Security teams globally. Given the resilience of cloud technologies and importance placed today in digital operations and agility, Datadog continues to innovate and is well positioned for the long term. #LI-Remote About Datadog: Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. Über die Position Bei Veeam arbeiten unsere Systems Engineers (m/w/d) eng mit dem Vertrieb zusammen und helfen dabei, unser Produktangebot bei unseren Partnern, Resellern und Endanwendern bekannt zu machen. Reisebereitschaft bis zu 50% innerhalb der Region Bonus Skills: Bereitstellung von Softwarelösungen in komplexen Umgebungen Tiefgreifendes Verständnis von Veeam und/oder ähnlichen Technologien Ausgezeichnete mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten; Sie müssen in der Lage sein, vor Gruppen in Englisch und Deutsch zu präsentieren Branchenrelevante berufliche Zertifizierungen sind wünschenswert Das bieten wir: Umfassende finanzielle Sicherheit – Vom Unternehmen geförderte Altersvorsorge, Lebens- und Unfallversicherung, um dich und deine Familie abzusichern. jobs.title: Product Manager - AI Investing
jobs.description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Investing. This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release. What You'll Own Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services. Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans. Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams. Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys. Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions. Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations. Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity. What We're Looking For Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role. Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows. Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products. Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning. Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management. High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance. Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage. The Kind of Builder We Want Starts from user problems, not feature lists. Can make decisions with incomplete information. Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch. Works well with engineering without hiding behind process. Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort. This Role Is Not For People who only write decks and do not drive execution. PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering. Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions. People who launch features and then stop caring. PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: The Role BJAK builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them. The Principal Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems . This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production. What You'll Own Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives. Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure. Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving. Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability. Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans. Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices. Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams. What We're Looking For 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems. Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure. Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems. Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on. Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production. Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems. Nice to have Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth. Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries. Location This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. jobs.description: Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. Overview We are looking for an exceptional full-stack software engineer who will act as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to serve as the critical interface between the central AI Application Modernization Factory and our application teams. The FDE will be temporarily embedded within delivery teams to directly drive the modernization of key applications, ensuring technical success, accelerated adoption of AI-assisted SDLC practices , and lasting upskilling of team members. This is a high-impact, hybrid role requiring advanced software engineering skills, deep knowledge of cloud-native patterns, and proven expertise in consultation, change management, and building strong rapport with diverse teams. Key Responsibilities Application Modernization Execution: Embed with application teams to provide hands-on technical leadership, driving the design, development, and delivery of modernization efforts (re-platforming, microservices adoption) to AWS cloud-native architectures. AI-First SDLC Adoption & Upskilling: Act as the subject matter expert on the AI Modernization Factory's tools and processes (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code). Drive the adoption and change management necessary to embed AI-assisted software development practices into the team’s daily workflow. Consultative Engineering & Change Management: Build trust and rapport with new, diverse teams quickly. Identify team-specific technical and process bottlenecks, recommending and implementing solutions, and effectively managing the people/process side of technical change. Hands-on Software Development: Make significant code contributions, focusing on setting up architectural scaffolding, CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform), and solving complex, blocking integration challenges for the embedded team. Feedback Loop: Serve as the primary feedback channel, relaying practical challenges, tool deficiencies, and necessary process adjustments back to the central Principal Engineer and Architect to continuously improve the factory's capabilities. Standards & Quality: Ensure embedded teams adhere to the central factory's engineering standards, including Twelve-Factor App principles, DevSecOps practices, and high-quality coding standards. Required Qualifications & Experience Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, with a focus on enterprise applications and application modernization. Full Stack Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience across the full application stack (front-end, back-end, database, infrastructure). Expert proficiency in one or more modern technology languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript, C#, Java). Cloud Native & IaC: Deep practical experience building and deploying scalable applications on AWS. Strong proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), specifically Terraform. Consulting & Change Management: Proven ability to onboard rapidly, assess team dynamics and technical landscapes, influence technical direction without formal authority, and drive organizational/process change within established engineering teams. DevSecOps & CI/CD: Hands-on mastery of setting up and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and integrating DevSecOps best practices. Architectural Understanding: Solid understanding of modern architectural patterns (microservices, serverless, event-driven architecture) and the principles of Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication, presentation, and listening skills. Ability to articulate complex technical issues and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively. Preferred Skills (A Plus) Prior experience in a consulting, Staff Engineer, or Forward Deployed role, specifically focused on technical adoption or modernization. Direct experience training or mentoring other software engineers in new technologies or methodologies. Hands-on experience with modern UI frameworks like React, NextJS, or similar. Experience utilizing AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) in a professional development environment. Familiarity with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and serverless architectures (AWS Lambda). jobs.title: Account Manager, DACH (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About Plasmidsaurus Plasmidsaurus is on a mission to accelerate new cures and promote a healthier planet by unlocking a new level of productivity for scientists. Our sequencing services are used daily by thousands of innovators, including Nobel laureates, Fortune 100 pharma, and over 70,000 scientists. We began by revolutionizing plasmid sequencing, making it exponentially cheaper and faster, with innovative sequencing technologies and a global network of laboratories that turn samples into answers in hours, not weeks. Now we are expanding that same disruptive model across all of genomics. With the launch of our new RNA-seq service, we are taking a bold step toward our vision to sequence everything, providing scientists everywhere with faster, simpler, and more affordable access to the data that powers discovery. Every team member at Plasmidsaurus plays a crucial role in driving the future of biotech research. Together, we are building the world’s most efficient sequencing engine that operates overnight, scales globally, and helps scientists make breakthroughs faster than ever before. Role Overview Build and grow Plasmidsaurus's business across academic, biotech, government, and pharmaceutical customers in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. You own the growth of your territory: developing priority accounts, expanding existing relationships, finding new opportunities, and positioning Plasmidsaurus as the preferred sequencing partner for scientists and organizations doing important work. This is an individual contributor role for someone who combines scientific fluency with strong commercial instincts and knows how to turn customer understanding into sustained account growth. What You'll Do Own and grow your territory Develop and execute strategies for priority accounts and customer segments across DACH. Build pipeline and drive new and expansion opportunities from identification through close. Grow adoption of Plasmidsaurus products and services within existing accounts. Maintain a clear view of territory performance, pipeline, account priorities, and forecast. jobs.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer. Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI. Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes). Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis. Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel. Requirements Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company. Strong SQL and Python , with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics. Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics. Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders , and pushing back on ill-defined asks. Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour. Bonus Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product. Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers. Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access. Growth potential We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales. Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI). Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track. Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Site Reliability Engineer (Server Infrastructure)
jobs.description: About Nebius : Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. The Role Server Infrastructure is a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team responsible for the full lifecycle of Nebius Cloud hardware: from newly delivered bare metal through provisioning, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning. Almost every Nebius service runs on servers within our domain. Our mission is to make the hardware layer fast, reliable, and invisible. We apply software engineering to infrastructure operations. We build services and automation that bring servers into the cloud, keep them healthy, recover them from failures, and retire them safely. Our work spans CPU and GPU platforms, the base GNU/Linux system, and the infrastructure supporting our hardware fleet. As a Senior / Staff Engineer, you’ll take ownership of complex infrastructure challenges and help shape the team’s technical direction. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with architecture, mentoring, and coordination across teams, turning operational needs into reliable services and automation. You’ll work closely with data center engineers, capacity managers, cloud compute developers, networking teams, and hardware suppliers. Your work will directly affect the reliability and capacity of the entire cloud platform. Y our responsibilities will include: Design, build, and operate services for netboot, provisioning, maintenance, automated recovery, and decommissioning. Lead technical initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation and production operation. Help shape the technical roadmap, balancing reliability improvements, new hardware integration, and long-term engineering work. Define meaningful reliability indicators and service level objectives, using them to guide engineering priorities. Reduce operational toil by turning recurring failures and manual procedures into reliable automation. Improve on-call practices, incident response, and learning through blameless incident reviews. Strengthen fleet observability, alerting, testing, deployment safety, and operational readiness. Drive support for new CPU and GPU platforms and improvements to the base GNU/Linux system. Mentor engineers, provide thoughtful design and code reviews, and help the team develop sound engineering practices. Coordinate delivery across teams, communicate technical tradeoffs, and resolve dependencies. We expect you to have: Strong software engineering experience in Go and a solid understanding of Linux systems. Experience designing, building, and operating infrastructure services, including distributed systems and failure handling. A track record of owning complex technical initiatives and bringing them into production. Practical knowledge of SRE principles: service level objectives, observability, incident management, capacity planning, and toil reduction. Sound technical judgment and the ability to guide architecture and investigate difficult production problems. Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices through collaboration and technical example. Clear communication and the ability to work effectively across engineering and operational teams. We welcome candidates at senior and staff levels. The scope of ownership and technical influence will reflect your experience. Experience with hardware provisioning, bare metal infrastructure , GPU platforms , or large server fleets would be valuable. Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, GitOps, SaltStack, and Terraform is also useful. We conduct coding interviews as part of the process. Benefits & Perks: Competitive compensation Career growth and learning opportunities Flexibility and ownership Collaborative and innovative culture Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects International environment and talented teams What's it like to work at Nebius: Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI Equal Opportunity Statement: Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. If you love a strategic, analytics sales process working with a variety of industries, departments and buyers, selling Qualtrics XM will always keep you learning and growing. Challenges excite us, as we view them as opportunities for growth and positive transformation. We are not merely observers of change; we actively initiate and drive it. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Data Platform)
jobs.description: About Nebius : Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. The Role We’re looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join the team building and operating Nebius Data Platform — a distributed storage and a processing platform that acts as the company’s “source of truth” and the backbone of many internal (and some external) products. Nebius Data Platform is a single multi-tenant ecosystem based on YTsaurus — instead of running separate HDFS/Kafka/HBase-style systems, we provide storage, compute, and analytics capabilities inside one platform. We operate across data centers worldwide, running YTsaurus in dedicated Kubernetes clusters with Kubernetes operators and supporting services written primarily in Go. We maintain our own Nebius distribution, develop functionality across the core and platform services, and contribute upstream where it makes sense. This gives us the ability to take improvements from design through implementation to production. At scale today, this includes ~500 servers, ~20k CPU cores and ~10 PB of compressed data in our largest production cluster, supporting workloads ranging from business-critical pipelines and financial transactions to large-scale ML/LLM training datasets and compute. As an SRE, you’ll combine software engineering with production ownership: understand how the platform behaves, identify what limits its reliability and growth, and build lasting improvements alongside the developers and teams who use it. Your responsibilities will include: Own and improve the reliability, performance, and capacity of our YTsaurus clusters, with particular attention to data durability and predictable behavior under load. Develop services, Kubernetes automation, and operational tooling in Go to simplify cluster provisioning, upgrades, and maintenance. Improve monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic tools so we can detect problems early and understand their impact on users. Investigate failures across Linux, networking, Kubernetes, and distributed storage and compute. Participate in on-call, lead incident investigations, and turn findings into lasting fixes. Improve resource utilization and workload isolation as the platform grows and serves more teams. Work with platform developers and users to make architectural decisions, deliver changes safely, and reduce repetitive operational work. We expect you to have: Experience operating distributed, stateful systems in production and taking responsibility for their reliability. Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including the ability to investigate resource bottlenecks and failures beyond the application layer. Practical Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads. Strong programming skills and experience building maintainable software. We primarily use Go; experience in another language and a willingness to learn Go are welcome. A systematic approach to troubleshooting, using evidence from logs, metrics, traces, and system behavior. The ability to drive improvements from problem identification through delivery, communicate trade-offs clearly, and collaborate with developers and platform users. It will be an added bonus if you have: Experience with Big Data systems (YTsaurus/Hadoop/Spark/ClickHouse/Kafka-like ecosystems). Experience developing Kubernetes operators or controllers. Experience with performance analysis, capacity planning, or resource management in multi-tenant systems. We conduct coding interviews as part of the process. Benefits & Perks: Competitive compensation Career growth and learning opportunities Flexibility and ownership Collaborative and innovative culture Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects International environment and talented teams What's it like to work at Nebius: Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI Equal Opportunity Statement: Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Data Lakes
jobs.description: From Fivetran ’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. We’re seeking a Principal Software Engineer to contribute to the technical architecture, design and development of Fivetran’s Managed Data Lake product offering. As part of a senior engineering team, you’ll partner with product and engineering teams to build scalable, high-performance systems, advance open-source technologies, and set technical standards that raise the bar across the organization. This is a full-time remote position based out of Germany. Technologies You’ll Use Java, C++, Postgres, Temporal, gRPC AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Grafana Iceberg, Polaris, Delta Lake, Parquet, DuckDB What You’ll Do Partner closely with product teams to understand requirements and design cutting-edge new capabilities that go directly into customer’s hands. Design, develop, implement, and operate highly reliable large-scale data lake systems in cooperation with a dedicated data lake engineering team. Contribute to open-source projects such as DuckDB and Polaris. Embrace Fivetran innovations with open-source standards and toolsets. Analyze fault-tolerance and high availability issues, performance and scale challenges, and solve them. Ensure operational excellence of the services and meet the commitments to our customers regarding security, reliability, availability, and performance. Set technical directions and influence cross-functional teams. Skills We’re Looking For 6+ years of hands-on or research experience with high-performance relational data management systems. Deep understanding of infrastructure & software optimizations and performance engineering to drive significant performance, latency, and availability improvements. Proven track record of leading and delivering large and complicated projects. Strong development skills in Java and C++. Solid experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP). Demonstrated knowledge of columnar storage formats. Growth mindset and excitement about breaking the status quo by seeking innovative solutions. Excellent team player who is consistent in making everyone around you better. Bonus Skills Strongly prefer an MS or PhD in Computer Science, ideally focusing on database management and/or storage engines. #LI-IM1 #LI-REMOTE Perks and Benefits 100% employer-paid medical insurance * Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion , but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream . Read about us in Forbes . jobs.title: Expert Model Trains
jobs.location_raw: Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Spain, UK
jobs.description: At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car , a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton , Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe , we encounter exceptional objects every day. We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts. Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us. Taking ownership and driving impact Being open to change and feedback Being passionate about our mission and our customers. Your Mission As a Model Trains Expert , your mission is to bring your specialist model trains expertise to the curation of high-quality, compelling auctions that attract engaged collectors and trusted sellers. Your knowledge of brands, rarity, condition, valuation, and collector expectations is central to ensuring each lot is relevant, accurately assessed, and commercially strong. By combining deep category expertise with sound commercial judgement, you play a key role in growing the Model Trains category, maintaining transparency, and strengthening trust within the collector community. What You’ll Do Evaluate and arrange model train lots submitted by users, ensuring each auction features attractive and relevant listings Create compelling weekly lot selections using your expertise and professional network Review titles, descriptions, and images to assess quality and provide accurate estimated values Safeguard transparent and fair transactions through consistent expert evaluation Communicate rejections professionally and diplomatically, maintaining strong seller relationships Collaborate with Sales to attract new sellers and diversify the range and quality of lots Partner with Marketing to increase bidder engagement and visibility for your auctions What You’ll Bring Expert knowledge in Model Trains Strong commercial acumen and documented commercial experience An eye for trade and value within the collectibles market Excellent communication skills, with the ability to act diplomatically in user disputes A network of potential sellers and experts within your field Good computer skills and confidence working with digital tools Good command of English, written and spoken Where You’ll Be This is a 100% remote role that can be based in the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, Portugal, Spain, or the United Kingdom. Why You'll Love Working with Us Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business. Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression. A culture of connection defines us . We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work. Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion ” . We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location. Our Offices and Way of Working Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based. Interested? Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team
